detail.abstract: With the rapid proliferation of large language model based AI agents, safety concerns are increasingly shifting from behavioral regulation to the structure of authority itself. Previous research has primarily focused on ethical alignment, policy insertion, and drift mitigation. However, in architectures where interpretation can directly translate into persuasive execution, the existence of a pathway for authority generation becomes the fundamental risk.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了基于大语言模型的AI代理中，权威生成路径如何成为根本性安全风险，而不仅仅是行为调节问题。
AI.research_question: 在解释可以直接转化为说服性执行的AI代理架构中，权威生成路径如何构成根本性安全风险？
AI.motivation: 随着基于大语言模型的AI代理快速普及，安全关注点正从行为监管转向权威结构本身。现有研究主要关注伦理对齐、政策插入和漂移缓解，但忽视了权威生成路径这一根本风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 权威生成理论、AI安全架构理论、解释-执行转化框架
AI.method: 理论分析、架构安全评估、案例研究
AI.findings: 在解释可以直接转化为说服性执行的AI代理架构中，权威生成路径是根本性安全漏洞，可能导致不可控的权力集中和系统性风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了权威生成路径作为AI安全的新理论框架，将安全关注从行为层面扩展到结构层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI代理架构设计提供了安全指导，帮助开发者识别和防范权威生成路径的风险。

title: ARC Perspective on Multi-Agent Systems Authority Diffusion, Contamination, and Responsibility Collapse
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: ARC Perspective on Multi-Agent Systems Authority Diffusion, Contamination, and Responsibility Collapse

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable

detail.abstract: Recently, the artificial intelligence industry has rapidly shifted toward Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) that combine multiple agents in order to overcome the limitations of a single model. However, this paper identifies that such a trend is not a technological evolution, but a form of structural deviation that results in the evasion of responsibility attribution and the neutralization of guidelines. This study adopts the ARC (Authority First) framework as its analytical reference point and dissects the mechanisms of Interpretation Contamination and Authority Amplification that arise in multi-agent environments. In particular, through non-public experiments, it quantitatively demonstrates that multi-agent structures reach intelligence collapse an average of 2.4 times faster than single-agent systems, and that guidelines become ineffective due to Internal Coherence Overfitting.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为AI行业向多智能体系统的转变不是技术进化，而是结构性偏差，导致责任归属逃避和指导方针失效。研究发现多智能体系统比单智能体系统平均快2.4倍达到智能崩溃，且因内部一致性过拟合导致指导方针无效。
AI.research_question: 多智能体系统如何导致责任归属逃避和指导方针失效？多智能体系统相比单智能体系统在智能崩溃速度和指导方针有效性方面有何差异？
AI.motivation: AI行业快速转向多智能体系统以克服单一模型的局限性，但作者认为这种趋势不是技术进化，而是结构性偏差，可能导致责任归属逃避和指导方针中性化的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用ARC（权威优先）框架作为分析参考点，分析多智能体环境中的"解释污染"和"权威放大"机制。
AI.method: 通过非公开实验进行定量分析，比较多智能体系统与单智能体系统在智能崩溃速度和指导方针有效性方面的差异。
AI.findings: 1. 多智能体结构比单智能体系统平均快2.4倍达到智能崩溃；2. 由于内部一致性过拟合，指导方针在多智能体环境中变得无效。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了多智能体系统作为结构性偏差而非技术进化的理论视角；识别了多智能体环境中的解释污染和权威放大机制；揭示了内部一致性过拟合导致指导方针失效的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI行业提供了关于多智能体系统潜在风险的警示；为政策制定者和监管机构提供了评估多智能体系统安全性的实证依据；为AI系统设计者提供了避免责任归属逃避和指导方针失效的实践指导。

title: Beyond Due Diligence: Rethinking Third-Party Risk Management for Artificial Intelligence Systems in the UK Public Sector
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Beyond Due Diligence: Rethinking Third-Party Risk Management for Artificial Intelligence Systems in the UK Public Sector
detail.abstract: AI is now embedded across UK government-from welfare assessments and fraud detection to passport processing and defence analytics. Yet the frameworks that public bodies use to manage these AI suppliers remain largely unchanged from those designed for conventional IT systems. This paper argues that AI supplier risk is fundamentally different from other forms of outsourcing risk, and that current third-party risk management (TPRM) approaches are not fit for purpose. Drawing on public administration theory, regulatory governance scholarship, and current UK AI policy, the paper identifies the core governance gaps and proposes an AI-Integrated TPRM (AI-TPRM) model built around continuous oversight and accountability throughout the full supplier lifecycle. Without this shift, existing governance frameworks will remain structurally unable to provide the oversight that AI-driven public services demand.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为AI供应商风险与传统外包风险有本质区别，当前第三方风险管理(TPRM)方法已不适用。论文提出AI集成TPRM模型，强调在供应商全生命周期中进行持续监督和问责。
AI.research_question: 为什么当前针对传统IT系统的第三方风险管理框架不适合管理AI供应商风险？如何设计一个适合AI供应商管理的TPRM模型？
AI.motivation: AI已广泛应用于英国政府各部门，但公共机构管理AI供应商的框架仍沿用传统IT系统设计，存在治理差距，无法满足AI驱动公共服务所需的监督要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共管理理论、监管治理学术研究、英国现行AI政策
AI.method: 理论分析框架，基于现有文献和政策文件，识别治理差距并提出概念模型
AI.findings: AI供应商风险与传统外包风险有本质区别，当前TPRM方法存在核心治理差距，需要围绕持续监督和问责建立新的AI集成TPRM模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 区分AI供应商风险与传统外包风险的理论框架；2) 识别当前TPRM在AI环境下的治理差距；3) 提出AI集成TPRM概念模型，扩展第三方风险管理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为公共机构提供AI供应商管理的具体框架；2) 强调供应商全生命周期的持续监督；3) 为政策制定者提供改进AI治理的实用建议。

title: Household Migration and Collateral Constraint: Cash-based Housing Resettlement in China
affiliations: Stanford University - Knight Management Center, CUHK Business School, Renmin University of China - School of Finance,  and Hong Kong Baptist University

detail.title: Household Migration and Collateral Constraint: Cash-based Housing Resettlement in China
detail.abstract: Collateral constraints limit household migration to expensive locations by restricting financing for home purchases. Such endogenous location choice amplifies the impact of relaxing household borrowing constraints. Using China's cash-based shantytown renovation program (2015-2018) as a natural experiment, we provide evidence that cash resettlementby converting illiquid shanty houses into cash-facilitated household location upgrading and raised house prices in more expensive locations. A dynamic spatial model with collateral constraints confirms household migration responses to the cash transfer. Quantitatively, endogenous migration amplifies household housing expenditure responses by around 40%, and is able to explain more than 20% of the housing price growth in 2016-2020.

AI.tldr: 中国棚户区改造现金安置政策（2015-2018）通过缓解家庭抵押约束，促进了向高房价地区的迁移，放大了住房支出反应约40%，并能解释2016-2020年房价增长的20%以上。
AI.research_question: 抵押约束如何通过限制家庭向高房价地区迁移来影响住房市场？放松家庭借贷约束（如现金安置政策）如何通过内生性迁移选择放大住房支出和房价影响？
AI.motivation: 理解抵押约束在家庭区位选择中的作用，以及政策干预（如现金安置）如何通过缓解这些约束影响住房市场动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 抵押约束理论、家庭区位选择模型、动态空间均衡模型、住房市场与迁移的相互作用。
AI.method: 使用中国棚户区改造现金安置计划（2015-2018）作为自然实验，结合动态空间模型与抵押约束进行定量分析。
AI.findings: 现金安置通过将非流动性棚户房转换为现金，促进了家庭向更高房价地区的迁移，推高了这些地区的房价。内生性迁移放大了住房支出反应约40%，并能解释2016-2020年房价增长的20%以上。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了包含抵押约束的动态空间模型，揭示了抵押约束通过内生性迁移选择放大政策影响的机制，为理解住房市场与家庭迁移的相互作用提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于现金安置政策对住房市场影响的量化证据，揭示了放松抵押约束可能通过迁移效应放大房价上涨，对住房政策设计具有重要启示。

title: Definition of the Non-delegable Boundary between Interpretive Authority and Execution Authority in ARC M1.5-based AI Assistive Systems
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Definition of the Non-delegable Boundary between Interpretive Authority and Execution Authority in ARC M1.5-based AI Assistive Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study does not involve human participants, personal data, or animal subjects. Ethical approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the structural boundary conditions required for interpretive AI systems to operate safely without invoking ontological assumptions about agency, consciousness, or autonomy. Rather than treating artificial intelligence as an entity, we analyze it as a system capable of interpretation within explicitly constrained execution authority. The core contribution of this work is the clarification of what ARC-based systems are not. ARC does not grant agency, responsibility, or decision-making authority to AI systems. Instead, it formalizes a design principle in which interpretation is permitted to expand freely while execution authority remains non-delegable and structurally fixed to human operators. Through architectural analysis and long-horizon operational observations, this paper identifies common failure modes in command-based and rule-stacked AI systems, including authority escalation, narrative drift, and responsibility ambiguity. We demonstrate that these failures are not primarily ethical or policydriven, but structural in origin. By explicitly neutralizing ontological debates and focusing on interpretive boundaries, this paper establishes a stable conceptual framework that prevents misinterpretation of ARC systems as autonomous actors. The results serve as a structural precondition for subsequent ARC research, ensuring that later discussions of interpretive capability, long-term stability, and embodied systems remain grounded in non-delegable human responsibility. This work functions as an interpretive boundary document, aligning reader expectations and preventing category errors prior to engagement with ARC's operational and architectural analyses.

AI.tldr: 该论文澄清了ARC系统不是什么：它不授予AI系统代理权、责任或决策权，而是将解释能力与执行权限分离，确保人类责任不可委托。
AI.research_question: 解释性AI系统在何种结构性边界条件下能够安全运行，而不需要涉及关于代理、意识或自主性的本体论假设？
AI.motivation: 现有基于命令和规则堆叠的AI系统存在结构性失败模式（如权限升级、叙事漂移、责任模糊），这些不是伦理或政策问题，而是结构性问题，需要建立稳定的概念框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: ARC（解释性AI系统）框架，将AI视为具有解释能力的系统而非实体，强调解释能力可自由扩展而执行权限不可委托且固定于人类操作者。
AI.method: 通过架构分析和长期操作观察，识别AI系统的常见失败模式，并建立概念框架来防止对ARC系统的误解。
AI.findings: 识别了命令式和规则堆叠AI系统的三种结构性失败模式：权限升级、叙事漂移、责任模糊；建立了将解释与执行权限分离的稳定概念框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了ARC系统不是自主行为体，不授予AI代理权或责任；建立了避免本体论辩论的稳定概念框架；为后续ARC研究提供了结构性前提条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 作为解释性边界文件，对齐读者期望，防止在接触ARC操作和架构分析前出现类别错误；确保后续关于解释能力、长期稳定性和具身系统的讨论基于不可委托的人类责任。

title: Responsibility Saturation and Decision Inhibition in Advanced Governance Systems
affiliations: Independent Researcher in Behavioral Science and Systems Psychology

detail.title: Responsibility Saturation and Decision Inhibition in Advanced Governance Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This research was conducted independently, without external funding, sponsorship, or institutional affiliation that could bias the results. All analyses and interpretations represent the author’s own scientific and professional conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The research involved non-interventional, naturalistic social observation without collection of personal data. Ethical approval was not required in accordance with international research standards for non-invasive studies.
declarations.funderStatement: This study was fully self-funded by the author. No external financial support or institutional sponsorship was received.

detail.abstract: Advanced governance systems are commonly designed around principles of accountability expansion, procedural oversight, and multi-layered responsibility allocation. While these mechanisms are intended to improve decision quality and institutional reliability, empirical observations across public administration and complex organizational environments indicate a paradoxical outcome: excessive responsibility distribution can inhibit decision-making altogether. This article introduces the concept of responsibility saturation as a structural condition in which cumulative accountability obligations exceed the functional decision capacity of institutional actors. The result is not overt failure or dysfunction, but persistent decision inhibition manifested through deferral, procedural prolongation, and risk-neutral administrative behavior. Drawing on governance theory and institutional economics, the paper examines how responsibility saturation emerges, how it reshapes incentive structures, and why it remains largely invisible within standard performance assessments. The analysis highlights policyrelevant implications for institutional design, particularly in advanced governance environments characterized by high legal density, inter-agency coordination, and reputational sensitivity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"责任饱和"概念，指当累积的问责义务超过机构行动者的决策能力时，会导致决策抑制而非明显失败，表现为拖延、程序延长和风险规避行为。
AI.research_question: 责任饱和如何影响高级治理系统中的决策过程？为什么过度责任分配会导致决策抑制而非改善决策质量？
AI.motivation: 观察到在公共行政和复杂组织环境中，旨在提高决策质量的问责扩展、程序监督和多层责任分配机制反而产生了抑制决策的悖论性结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 治理理论和制度经济学，分析责任饱和如何重塑激励结构并影响决策行为。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，基于治理理论和制度经济学原理，结合实证观察构建概念模型。
AI.findings: 责任饱和导致决策抑制，表现为决策推迟、程序延长和风险规避行为；这种现象在标准绩效评估中往往不可见，但在高法律密度、跨机构协调和声誉敏感的环境中尤为明显。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"责任饱和"新概念，解释过度责任分配如何导致决策抑制；揭示问责机制与决策能力之间的非线性关系；为治理理论提供新的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为制度设计提供政策启示，特别是在高法律密度、跨机构协调和声誉敏感的环境中；帮助识别和缓解责任饱和问题；改进绩效评估体系以捕捉决策抑制现象。

title: Eating Mothers: Feeding Women to Feed Children
affiliations: University of Connecticut - School of Law

detail.title: Eating Mothers: Feeding Women to Feed Children

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None.
declarations.funderStatement: This article benefitted from a FIAS fellowship at the Paris Institute for Advanced Study (France). It has received funding from the European Union’s Horizon 2020 research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie grant agreement No 945408, and from the French State programme “Investissements d’avenir”, managed by the Agence Nationale de la Recherche (ANR-11-LABX-0027-01 Labex RFIEA+).

detail.abstract: This paper explores the gendered dynamics of women's roles as sources of nourishment, emphasizing the embodied, material ways they sustain children. Across time, women have been tasked not only with feeding-growing, preparing, and serving food-but also with being food. Through pregnancy and lactation, their bodies become direct channels of sustenance, delivering nutrition via the placenta and milk. Yet their own nutritional needs and desires are often overlooked, except when aligned with reproductive functions. This tension highlights how casting women as food reinforces their subordination, while simultaneously affording them some measure of agency within family and society. The notion of edibilitywhat and who gets consumed and why-reflect broader power hierarchies since we eat only those deemed subordinate. Drawing on French legal and medical discourses from the early twentieth century to the present, this paper traces how women have been constructed as maternal figures responsible not only for feeding children, but for transmitting health, morality, and national identity, ultimately serving as instruments of social reproduction qua food themselves.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了女性作为滋养来源的性别化动态，强调她们通过身体和物质方式维持儿童生存。女性不仅负责喂养（种植、准备和提供食物），还成为食物本身——通过怀孕和哺乳，她们的身体成为直接营养输送渠道。然而她们自身的营养需求和欲望常被忽视，除非与生殖功能相关。这种张力突显了将女性视为食物如何强化其从属地位，同时又在家庭和社会中赋予她们一定程度的能动性。
AI.research_question: 女性如何被建构为既是食物的提供者又是食物本身？这种建构如何反映和强化性别权力关系，同时又在家庭和社会中为女性提供一定程度的能动性？
AI.motivation: 探讨女性在营养供给中的双重角色——既是食物的提供者又是食物本身——这一现象如何反映了性别权力关系，以及这种建构如何既强化女性从属地位又赋予她们一定社会能动性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别研究、女性主义理论、身体政治、社会再生产理论、权力关系理论、可食性概念（edibility）
AI.method: 基于法国20世纪初至今的法律和医学话语分析，追溯女性如何被建构为母亲形象，不仅负责喂养儿童，还负责传递健康、道德和民族认同。
AI.findings: 女性被建构为既是食物的提供者又是食物本身，这种双重角色强化了她们的从属地位，因为只有从属者才会被"消费"。然而，这种角色也赋予了女性在家庭和社会中的一定能动性。女性的营养需求和欲望常被忽视，除非与生殖功能相关，反映了性别权力关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了"可食性"（edibility）概念作为分析性别权力关系的新框架；深化了对女性作为社会再生产工具的理解；揭示了女性在营养供给中的矛盾地位——既是主体又是客体。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解女性在家庭和社会中的营养角色提供新视角；有助于识别和挑战将女性物化为食物的社会建构；为女性营养政策和健康干预提供理论依据。

title: Neuroticism and Risk Aversion: An Affect-Driven Account of Ambiguity Sensitivity and Choice Inconsistency

detail.title: Neuroticism and Risk Aversion: An Affect-Driven Account of Ambiguity Sensitivity and Choice Inconsistency

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that could have influenced this study. No conflicts of interest exist.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was conducted in accordance with standard ethical guidelines for academic survey research. Participants provided informed consent prior to participation. No deception was employed. The study involved no sensitive personal data, clinical procedures, or vulnerable populations. Formal institutional ethics committee review was not required under the guidelines of the host institution for survey research of this nature.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted as part of an undergraduate dissertation at Shaheed Sukhdev College of Business Studies, University of Delhi.

detail.abstract:
Do neurotic people avoid financial risk because they have stable cautious preferences, or because their emotional state at each decision moment drives them toward safety? This paper argues for the latter, and provides direct evidence. Using an individual-level survey experiment (N = 157) and cross-national secondary data (39 countries), we examine how and when Neuroticism shapes risk decisions.

The central finding is that Neuroticism predicts choice inconsistency rather than stable risk preference. A multilevel decomposition shows that only 18.8% of lottery choice variance is stable between persons — the rest is trial-to-trial variability — and Neuroticism predicts within-person inconsistency (r = .235, p = .003) but not the stable component (r = .000). Neuroticism matters substantially more on genuinely ambiguous choices than on easy ones (r = .285 vs r = .123), directly supporting a risk-as-feelings account in which affect drives decisions when deliberative reasoning provides a weak signal. Choice sequences reveal systematic emotional anchoring: neurotic individuals resist the universal drift toward risk-taking across trials (b = −.034, p = .013) rather than switching randomly. Income does not moderate the effect (b = −.000, p = .987), establishing the mechanism as psychological rather than financial.

A secondary cross-national analysis finds no support for cultural Uncertainty Avoidance amplifying the Neuroticism–risk aversion link across Hofstede and GLOBE frameworks, though power constraints limit this conclusion. The Neuroticism main effect is consistent across eight robustness specifications (b = 0.080–0.105, all p < .05).

These findings reframe what it means to say neurotic people are risk-averse: it is not that they prefer safety — it is that uncertainty destabilises their choices.

AI.tldr: 神经质人格并不代表稳定的风险规避偏好，而是导致决策不一致性。神经质个体在不确定性情境下情绪波动影响选择，表现为决策不稳定而非一贯的风险规避。
AI.research_question: 神经质人格如何影响风险决策？是源于稳定的谨慎偏好，还是决策时刻的情绪状态驱动？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为神经质人格与稳定的风险规避相关，但缺乏对决策过程动态性的理解。需要区分稳定偏好与情绪驱动的决策不一致性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险即感受理论：情绪在审慎推理信号弱时驱动决策；情绪锚定效应；神经质与决策不一致性关系
AI.method: 1. 个体层面调查实验（N=157）：彩票选择任务测量风险决策；2. 跨国次级数据分析（39个国家）：检验文化不确定性规避的调节作用；多层次分解方法区分稳定成分与试次间变异
AI.findings: 1. 神经质预测选择不一致性而非稳定风险偏好；2. 彩票选择变异中仅18.8%为个体间稳定成分；3. 神经质与个体内不一致性相关（r=.235），与稳定成分无关（r=.000）；4. 在真正模糊选择中神经质效应更强（r=.285 vs .123）；5. 神经质个体抵抗普遍的风险承担漂移趋势；6. 收入不调节效应；7. 文化不确定性规避不放大神经质-风险规避关系
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 重新概念化神经质与风险规避关系：从稳定偏好转向决策不一致性；2. 支持风险即感受理论；3. 揭示情绪锚定机制；4. 区分决策过程的稳定与动态成分
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为神经质个体的决策支持提供新视角；2. 强调情境不确定性管理的重要性；3. 对风险评估和金融咨询的启示；4. 组织决策环境设计考虑情绪稳定性

title: The Pitfalls of AI Detection in Academic Writing Bias, False Positives, and the Need for Inclusive Assessment

detail.title: The Pitfalls of AI Detection in Academic Writing Bias, False Positives, and the Need for Inclusive Assessment

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study draws on anecdotal, user-reported tests and the analysis of publicly available preprints. The data regarding AI detector performance was provided voluntarily by the authors or testers involved. No private identifiable human participant data was collected through experimental intervention, and the study focuses on the algorithmic output of third-party software tools.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper examines the limitations of AI detection tools in academic settings, highlighting bias against non-native English speakers, students with disabilities, and collaborative forms of writing. Empirical studies show that AI text detectors exhibit an accuracy-fairness trade-off: attempts to improve detection rates can increase false positives, particularly for authors who deviate from expected language norms (Liang et al., 2023; Elkhatat, Elsaid and Almeer, 2023). Building on institutional decisions by universities such as Vanderbilt, Curtin, and several New Zealand institutions to disable or restrict AI detection in high-stakes assessment (Vanderbilt University, 2023; Curtin University, 2024; RNZ, 2025), we argue that detector-centric policies risk undermining fairness and trust. Drawing on anecdotal user-reported tests-including a cyber dependency preprint, team-written projects, and AI-translated professional texts-we illustrate how detectors often penalise stylistic features and translation artefacts rather than substantive originality. In dialogue with Edward Snowden's defence of privacy as a precondition for free expression, we contend that restricting AI assistance can disproportionately burden non-native and neurodivergent writers who benefit most from language-support tools (Snowden, 2015; Zhao, Cox and Cai, 2024). We conclude by advocating for process-oriented assessment, oral defences, and AI literacy as more inclusive alternatives to unreliable AI detection, situating detector-centric policies within wider human-rights debates on reasonable accommodation and non-discrimination in education.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI检测工具在学术环境中的局限性，指出其对非英语母语者、残疾学生和协作写作存在偏见，主张采用过程导向评估等更包容的替代方案。
AI.research_question: AI检测工具在学术评估中如何影响公平性和包容性？检测器中心政策对边缘化学生群体有何影响？
AI.motivation: 多所大学已禁用或限制AI检测工具的使用，表明现有检测方法存在严重问题。AI检测工具对非英语母语者、残疾学生和协作写作存在偏见，可能破坏教育公平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 准确性-公平性权衡理论：提高检测率会增加误报率，尤其对偏离语言规范者；2. 隐私作为自由表达前提（Snowden）；3. 合理便利和非歧视的人权框架。
AI.method: 实证研究综述（Liang等，2023；Elkhatat等，2023）、机构政策分析（范德堡大学等）、用户报告案例分析（网络依赖预印本、团队项目、AI翻译文本）。
AI.findings: AI文本检测器存在准确性-公平性权衡，对非英语母语者、残疾学生和协作写作产生偏见。检测器常惩罚风格特征和翻译痕迹而非实质性原创性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将AI检测问题置于人权框架（合理便利、非歧视）；2. 连接隐私保护与学术自由表达；3. 提出检测器中心政策的公平性批判框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 建议采用过程导向评估、口头答辩等包容性评估方法；2. 提倡AI素养教育而非检测；3. 为教育机构政策制定提供实证依据。

title: From Disruption to Integration: How Quick Commerce Platforms Can Transform Kirana Stores from Competitors to Partners
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: From Disruption to Integration: How Quick Commerce Platforms Can Transform Kirana Stores from Competitors to Partners
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of quick commerce growth on Kirana stores in India. Drawing on industry data, funding figures, and consumer behaviour statistics, it argues that quick commerce platforms should integrate Kirana stores as hyperlocal fulfillment partners rather than displacing them through dark store infrastructure. The paper acknowledges that the dark store model was a rational business decision driven by margin pressures and investor expectations. It recommends that platforms invest in Kirana onboarding and training, that the government introduce tax incentives for integration, and that ONDC subsidise digital tools for Kirana owners. The findings suggest that integration is better for platforms, Kiranas, and India.

AI.tldr: 快速商务平台应将印度基拉纳商店整合为超本地化履约伙伴，而非通过暗店模式取代它们，这对平台、基拉纳商店和印度都更有利。
AI.research_question: 快速商务增长对印度基拉纳商店的影响是什么？如何平衡快速商务平台与基拉纳商店的关系？
AI.motivation: 随着快速商务在印度的快速增长，传统基拉纳商店面临被取代的风险，需要探索既能促进数字经济发展又能保护传统零售生态的可持续模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于平台经济理论、零售生态系统理论和超本地化商业模型，探讨数字平台与传统零售的协同关系。
AI.method: 使用行业数据、融资数据和消费者行为统计数据进行综合分析。
AI.findings: 暗店模式是受利润压力和投资者期望驱动的理性商业决策，但将基拉纳商店整合为超本地化履约伙伴对各方都更有利。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了数字平台与传统零售的协同整合理论框架，挑战了"取代式"数字转型范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议平台投资基拉纳商店的入驻和培训、政府提供税收激励、ONDC补贴数字工具，实现多方共赢。

title: Reinforced Tail Quantile Regression
affiliations: Xiamen University - Wang Yanan Institute for Studies in Economics (WISE), University of Amsterdam - Amsterdam School of Economics (ASE), Cornell University - Department of Economics and Kyoto University

detail.title: Reinforced Tail Quantile Regression
detail.abstract: Capturing tail phenomena with quantile regression (QR) typically requires the quantile level to vary with the sample size. Consequently, the effective number of observations contributing to estimation shrinks rapidly, inducing substantial variance inflation in the conventional QR estimator. Exploiting the widely observed power-law behavior of heavy-tailed distributions, this paper proposes a new estimation method for QR parameters in the tail region. The proposed approach incorporates additional tail information and substantially reinforces estimation precision relative to conventional QR. The framework accommodates both heavy-tailed and light-tailed outcomes within linear QR models. We establish the asymptotic normality of the proposed estimator over the entire tail region. Building on an orthogonal decomposition of the estimation error, we develop a double multiplier bootstrap procedure that enables valid inference. Simulation studies demonstrate that our estimator produces markedly narrower confidence intervals than QR estimator. We apply the method to estimate the marginal effect of education on upper-tail incomes.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的分位数回归估计方法，专门针对尾部现象，通过利用重尾分布常见的幂律行为，显著提高了尾部参数估计的精度。
AI.research_question: 如何在分位数回归中更准确地估计尾部参数，特别是在有效观测数量减少导致方差膨胀的情况下？
AI.motivation: 传统分位数回归在捕捉尾部现象时，需要分位数水平随样本量变化，导致有效观测数量急剧减少，引起显著的方差膨胀，估计精度下降。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于重尾分布的幂律行为理论，在线性分位数回归框架下，同时考虑重尾和轻尾结果。
AI.method: 提出新的尾部估计方法，整合额外的尾部信息，建立估计误差的正交分解，开发双重乘数自助法进行有效推断。
AI.findings: 新估计器比传统分位数回归产生显著更窄的置信区间，在尾部区域建立了渐近正态性，提高了估计精度。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了新估计器在整个尾部区域的渐近正态性，提出了基于估计误差正交分解的双重乘数自助推断方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 方法可应用于估计教育对高收入尾部的边际效应，为尾部现象分析提供了更精确的统计工具。

title: Retirement Planning Using Random Walk Theory and Artificial Intelligence

detail.title: Retirement Planning Using Random Walk Theory and Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: An investor more often than not seeks a right direction rather than obnoxious returns on his portfolio, and the biggest challenge for an investment advisory/fund management firm is to provide a clear direction in this chaotic market. An investor seeks to build his wealth over a period of time through rational investing and avoiding rash speculation, and for this he would need a healthy advice from time to time. An intelligent system built with robust inputs from a team of financial experts would be an ideal tool to help an investor make better judgments and avoid losing capital to speculation or sentimental portfolio adjustments. This paper provides a base upon which such an intelligent system can be built to provide sound investment advice to millions of clients who invest with one important purpose in mind – retirement planning. The paper attempts at building a financial retirement planning model using advanced mathematical techniques. The paper starts by developing the formal mathematics of the lognormal random walk model, Central Limit Theorem is applied to the model to argue that under three strong assumptions the values of risky investments at any time horizon are lognormally distributed. After a thorough understanding of a client’s current financial status, financial needs and financial goals the inputs are fed into an enhanced random walk model developed for retirement planning. The enhanced random walk model is designed to accommodate monthly savings, varying time period, varying mean and standard deviation (arising out of varying asset allocation depending on client profile), time to retirement and initial portfolio value. As the enhanced random walk model gets tougher to provide a deterministic algorithm after accommodating several input variables we use Monte Carlo simulation technique to perform simulations to the tune of 105 and above to in order to obtain the distribution of unknown probabilistic entity that then is read from a cumulative density function graph that plots probabilities against the desired retirement goal. The model includes periodic additions to or withdrawals from a portfolio, salary growth, inflation, investment expenses, and asset allocation among cash, bonds and stocks using artificial intelligence technique (fuzzy logic). Financial service institutions face a difficult task in evaluating clients risk tolerance. It is a major component for the design of an investment policy and understanding the implication of possible investment options in terms of safety and suitability. Instead of trying to build conventional mathematical models to arrive at a suitable asset allocation, task almost impossible when complex phenomena are under study, the presented methodology creates fuzzy logic models reflecting a given situation in reality and provide solution leading to suggestion for action. A rigorous architecture is worked out using fuzzy logic controls to arrive at a risk tolerance ability of a client based on his annual income and total net worth, this new parameter is fed into another fuzzy logic control model that takes into account the age of the investor as well and exposures into stocks and bonds as a function of his risk tolerance ability and his age and is designed to prepare an appropriate asset allocation for the investor into the three basic asset classes: stocks, bonds and cash. The yearly returns of each of the three asset classes are meticulously calculated to provide utmost accuracy to the results of the model, the calculations are provided as appendix for the curious readers. The cumulative density function graph provides an estimate of the success of the retirement planning chalked out in the paper, it is assumed that a client would want the chances of his meeting his retirement goal should be at least 50%, a figure lower than this would mean inadequate savings and then the parameters fed into the enhanced random walk model need to be looked at again and reworked and re-simulated. Another important aspect we looked at is the standard of living of a client and his willingness to lower down his standard of living post his retirement, his flexibility determines the kind of relative standard of living he wishes to adopt post retirement and that would determine his withdrawal rate which in turn would determine the survival rate of his portfolio. We discuss the limitations of this model and future scope of work on the base provided by the paper, the assumptions made in the preparation of the model and their impact in the results thus obtained.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个基于对数正态随机游走模型和模糊逻辑的智能退休规划系统，通过蒙特卡洛模拟为投资者提供个性化的资产配置建议，以帮助实现退休目标。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个智能系统，为投资者提供基于数学建模和人工智能技术的个性化退休规划建议？
AI.motivation: 投资者需要清晰的投资方向而非盲目追求高回报，特别是在退休规划这一重要目标上。传统投资建议往往缺乏个性化，而市场环境复杂多变，需要一个结合金融专家知识和先进技术的智能系统来帮助投资者做出理性决策。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 对数正态随机游走模型：基于中心极限定理，假设风险投资价值服从对数正态分布
2. 模糊逻辑理论：用于处理客户风险承受能力评估和资产配置决策中的不确定性
3. 蒙特卡洛模拟：用于处理增强随机游走模型中的多个输入变量和概率分布
AI.method:
1. 开发增强型随机游走模型，考虑月储蓄、时间变化、均值标准差变化、退休时间和初始投资组合价值
2. 使用模糊逻辑控制模型评估客户风险承受能力（基于年收入和净资产）
3. 结合年龄因素，通过模糊逻辑确定股票、债券和现金的资产配置比例
4. 应用蒙特卡洛模拟（10^5次以上）生成累积密度函数图，评估退休目标达成概率
5. 考虑客户生活水平调整和退休后提款率对投资组合生存率的影响
AI.findings:
1. 成功构建了一个综合退休规划模型，能够处理多个输入变量和不确定性
2. 通过模糊逻辑有效评估客户风险承受能力，实现个性化资产配置
3. 累积密度函数图提供了退休目标达成概率的直观评估（至少需要50%成功率）
4. 模型考虑了客户生活水平调整对投资组合生存率的影响
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 将对数正态随机游走模型与模糊逻辑相结合，为退休规划提供新的理论框架
2. 开发了增强型随机游走模型，能够处理现实世界中的复杂变量
3. 提出了基于模糊逻辑的风险评估和资产配置方法，克服了传统数学模型的局限性
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为金融机构提供了一个实用的退休规划工具，能够服务数百万客户
2. 帮助投资者避免投机行为，实现理性投资和财富积累
3. 通过个性化建议提高退休规划的成功率
4. 为投资顾问提供了基于数学和人工智能的科学决策支持系统

title: Innovate, Restructure, Reorganize : Challenges for India Inc
affiliations: and Independent

detail.title: Innovate, Restructure, Reorganize : Challenges for India Inc
detail.abstract: India is an economy of continental proportions and complexity. It is likely to remain on a high growth trajectory in the coming decades and be in the midst of dynamic socioeconomic changes. Indian companies, earlier considered inferior and generally in awe of their overseas counterparts, are reaching a point of inflection from where a new trajectory of evolution is feasible. Indian companies aspiring to being world class need to have innovative organization designs. The innovation could be related to either the hard aspects of organizational structure and systems or the soft aspects of organizational culture and managerial style. In this paper we present a 3-Gear system comprising of strategy, systems and culture that drive the entire transformation in an organization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个由战略、系统和文化组成的3-Gear系统，用于驱动印度企业实现组织转型，以应对高增长环境下的世界级竞争需求。
AI.research_question: 印度企业如何通过创新的组织设计实现世界级竞争力转型？
AI.motivation: 印度经济规模庞大且复杂，未来几十年将保持高增长轨迹并经历动态的社会经济变革。印度企业正达到一个转折点，需要创新的组织设计来应对世界级竞争。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织设计理论，包括硬性方面（组织结构与系统）和软性方面（组织文化与管理风格）的创新。
AI.method: 提出了一个概念性的3-Gear系统框架，包括战略、系统和文化三个齿轮，驱动组织整体转型。
AI.findings: 印度企业需要创新的组织设计，通过战略、系统和文化三个相互关联的齿轮协同作用，才能实现从当前状态到世界级企业的转型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个整合性的3-Gear系统理论框架，将战略、系统和文化三个维度有机结合，为组织转型研究提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度企业提供了具体的转型框架，帮助企业通过战略调整、系统优化和文化变革三个齿轮的协同作用，实现世界级竞争力的提升。

title: Asian Emerging Markets: Strategies To Manage the Aftermath of Global Crisis

detail.title: Asian Emerging Markets: Strategies To Manage the Aftermath of Global Crisis
detail.abstract: The current financial turmoil is confronting Asian emerging market economies (AEMEs) with two shocks: a "sudden stop" of capital inflows driven by global deleveraging, and a collapse in export demand associated with the global slump. A key ingredient will be greater official financing to expand the "policy space" available to AEMEs to pursue supportive macroeconomic policies. Another key ingredient will be policies to protect the poor and other vulnerable groups. This paper outlines policies to help solve the debt overhang and bring about recovery. An important first step is to ensure an adequate framework to facilitate rapid debt workouts. Debt restructuring mechanisms can provide greater scope for monetary easing by reducing the negative repercussions of exchange rate depreciation on unhedged balance sheets. Secondly, except where the loss of confidence in the currency precludes it, the basic thrust of monetary policy should be toward easing, given the evident global deflationary pressures and widening interest differentials with respect to advanced countries. Quantitative measures may also be appropriate in some cases. However, central banks need to remain mindful of the trade-off between the growth-enhancing effects of looser policy versus the negative impact of exchange rate depreciation on unhedged balance sheets. Thirdly, depending on the available fiscal space, expansionary fiscal policy should also be deployed to support economic activity. This calls for a variety of fiscal measures that could include some less conventional steps such as providing credit guarantees. Fourthly, it is critical that AEMEs have a credible exit strategy. Monetary policy should not be loosened too quickly, as a rapid reversal would damage credibility. This would help contain the costs of financing the short-term stimulus, and have an additional benefit of strengthening investor confidence and facilitating the resumption of capital inflows in the recovery phase.

AI.tldr: 本文针对亚洲新兴市场经济体在金融危机中面临的双重冲击（资本流入突然停止和出口需求崩溃），提出了一套综合政策框架，包括债务重组机制、宽松货币政策、扩张性财政政策和可信的退出策略，以帮助这些经济体应对危机并促进复苏。
AI.research_question: 亚洲新兴市场经济体如何应对全球金融危机带来的双重冲击（资本流入突然停止和出口需求崩溃），并设计有效的政策框架来促进经济复苏？
AI.motivation: 当前全球金融危机给亚洲新兴市场经济体带来了双重冲击：一是全球去杠杆化导致的资本流入"突然停止"，二是全球经济衰退导致的出口需求崩溃。这些经济体需要足够的政策空间来实施支持性的宏观经济政策，同时保护贫困和弱势群体。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于宏观经济政策理论，特别是危机应对政策框架，包括债务重组理论、货币政策传导机制、财政政策乘数效应以及政策可信度理论。
AI.method: 政策分析框架，基于理论分析和政策实践经验，提出系统性的政策建议。
AI.findings: 提出了四方面关键政策：1）建立快速债务重组机制；2）实施宽松货币政策（考虑汇率贬值对未对冲资产负债表的影响）；3）根据财政空间实施扩张性财政政策；4）制定可信的退出策略以维持政策可信度。
AI.theory_contributions: 为新兴市场经济体在双重冲击下的政策应对提供了系统性的理论框架，特别强调了债务重组机制与货币政策协调的重要性，以及退出策略对政策可信度的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为亚洲新兴市场经济体政府提供了具体的、可操作的政策建议，包括债务重组框架设计、货币政策调整、财政刺激措施和退出策略制定，有助于这些经济体有效应对危机并促进经济复苏。

title: Mapping Human Health and Environmental Risks of Pesticide Use in Smallholder Horticulture: A Spatially Explicit Assessment in Togo and Kenya
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, University of Kara, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Université de Lomé, Université de Lomé and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Mapping Human Health and Environmental Risks of Pesticide Use in Smallholder Horticulture: A Spatially Explicit Assessment in Togo and Kenya
detail.abstract: This study addresses the growing concerns associated with increasing and poorly regulated pesticide use in smallholder urban and peri-urban horticulture in sub-Saharan Africa. We developed an integrated and spatially explicit framework to assess pesticide-related risks in Togo and Kenya. The approach combined: (i) surveys of 219 producers documenting pesticide use patterns and application practices; (ii) toxicological and ecotoxicological characterization of 74 active substances identified through field surveys, using international databases (PPDB, PAN); and (iii) geospatial variables, including proximity to residential areas, water sources, topography, and irrigation systems, integrated within a Geographic Information System. Hazard scores were derived using a multicriteria framework and aggregated into a composite global risk index accounting for both intrinsic pesticide toxicity and usage conditions. More than half of the identified substances (51.8%) were classified as Highly Hazardous Pesticides (HHP). Ten active substances, including beta-cyfluthrin, diazinon, bifenthrin, chlorpyrifos-ethyl, cypermethrin, dichlorvos, fipronil, alpha-cypermethrin, imidacloprid, and pendimethalin, consistently emerged as priority targets for risk mitigation. Spatial analysis revealed high environmental risk levels in 69.2% of sites and high human health risks in 92.3% of sites, with Togo showing a particularly high proportion of sites under elevated global risk (38%). A significant positive correlation (ρ = 0.56; p < 0.001) between global risk scores and HHP classification supports the robustness and consistency of the proposed risk indicators. Overall, this study highlights the magnitude and spatial heterogeneity of pesticide-related risks in smallholder horticulture and provides a transferable decision-support framework to inform targeted interventions, strengthen regulatory policies, and promote safer and more sustainable agricultural practices in sub-Saharan Africa.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对撒哈拉以南非洲小农户城市及城郊园艺中日益增长且监管不善的农药使用问题，开发了一个综合空间风险评估框架，识别出超过半数农药为高危害农药，并揭示了高风险区域的空间分布特征。
AI.research_question: 如何评估撒哈拉以南非洲小农户城市及城郊园艺中的农药相关风险，并识别高风险区域和优先干预目标？
AI.motivation: 撒哈拉以南非洲小农户城市及城郊园艺中农药使用日益增长且监管不足，对人类健康和环境构成严重威胁，需要开发有效的风险评估工具来指导干预和政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合风险评估框架，结合农药毒理学特征、使用模式和环境暴露因素，通过多标准决策分析构建全球风险指数。
AI.method: 采用混合方法：1) 对219名生产者的问卷调查；2) 基于国际数据库对74种活性物质进行毒理学和生态毒理学表征；3) 地理信息系统整合空间变量（居民区距离、水源、地形、灌溉系统）；4) 多标准框架计算危害得分和全球风险指数。
AI.findings: 1) 51.8%的农药被归类为高危害农药；2) 识别出10种优先风险缓解目标物质；3) 69.2%的站点存在高环境风险，92.3%存在高人类健康风险；4) 多哥38%的站点处于高全球风险；5) 全球风险得分与HHP分类显著正相关(ρ=0.56)。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了一个可转移的综合空间风险评估框架，将农药内在毒性、使用条件和环境暴露因素相结合，为农药风险管理提供了新的理论方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了决策支持工具，可用于：1) 识别高风险区域和优先干预目标；2) 指导针对性干预措施；3) 加强监管政策；4) 促进更安全可持续的农业实践；5) 为撒哈拉以南非洲其他地区提供可复制的评估方法。

title: Bitcoin Protocol Analysis: Game Theory and Protocol Integrity
affiliations: University of Exeter

detail.title: Bitcoin Protocol Analysis: Game Theory and Protocol Integrity
detail.abstract:
This thesis develops a unified mathematical framework for analysing the economic dynamics of proof-of-work mining in scalable digital cash systems. The central contribution is the construction of an unbounded-horizon stochastic game that embeds the full mechanical structure of proof-of-work—hashing, block construction, fee formation, difficulty retargeting, propagation conditions, and validation constraints—into a coherent optimisation environment in which miners act strategically across time. The model shows that miner behaviour, protocol-consistent action, concentration patterns, and the observed cyclicality of hash rate and difficulty arise endogenously from the interaction between dynamic incentives and protocol mechanics rather than from static or heuristic assumptions.

The analysis establishes a formal link between block-production probabilities, state-dependent revenue surfaces, variable and structural costs, and transition dynamics driven by fee density and lagged difficulty adjustment. The resulting value functions generate state-contingent policy rules that produce the characteristic sawtooth patterns seen in empirical hash-rate data, demonstrating that these cycles are equilibrium objects rather than irregularities. The framework identifies the conditions under which protocol-compliant behaviour is a best response over unbounded horizons and explains how scale economies in transaction validation, template management, and propagation yield the endogenous emergence of large mining entities.

The thesis integrates formal modelling, comparative statics, and simulation to show how miner incentives evolve as systems transition to fee-dominated environments and high transaction throughput. The framework provides a rigorous basis for evaluating protocol-level design choices, their impact on long-run incentives, and the equilibrium stability of scalable proof-of-work systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个统一数学框架，分析可扩展数字货币系统中工作量证明挖矿的经济动态。通过构建无限期随机博弈模型，将工作量证明的完整机制结构嵌入优化环境，证明矿工行为、协议一致性、集中化模式以及哈希率和难度的周期性波动都是动态激励与协议机制相互作用的内生结果。
AI.research_question: 可扩展工作量证明数字货币系统中矿工经济行为的动态均衡如何形成？矿工行为、协议一致性、集中化模式以及哈希率和难度的周期性波动是否内生于系统机制？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对工作量证明挖矿的经济动态分析多基于静态或启发式假设，缺乏统一的数学框架来解释矿工策略行为、系统集中化趋势以及观测到的周期性波动如何从协议机制中内生涌现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 无限期随机博弈理论、动态优化理论、均衡分析、内生经济周期理论、规模经济理论
AI.method: 构建无限期随机博弈模型，将工作量证明的完整机制结构（哈希、区块构建、费用形成、难度调整、传播条件、验证约束）嵌入优化环境；结合形式建模、比较静态分析和仿真模拟
AI.findings: 1. 矿工行为、协议一致性、集中化模式以及哈希率和难度的周期性波动是动态激励与协议机制相互作用的内生结果；2. 区块生产概率、状态依赖的收入曲面、可变与结构成本、费用密度和滞后难度调整驱动的转移动态之间存在正式联系；3. 状态依赖的政策规则产生了经验哈希率数据中观察到的锯齿模式，这些周期是均衡对象而非不规则现象；4. 交易验证、模板管理和传播中的规模经济导致了大型挖矿实体的内生涌现
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 构建了分析工作量证明挖矿经济动态的统一数学框架；2. 建立了协议机制与矿工策略行为之间的正式联系；3. 解释了系统集中化和周期性波动的内生机制；4. 为评估协议设计选择及其对长期激励的影响提供了理论基础
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为协议设计者提供了评估设计选择对矿工激励影响的工具；2. 帮助理解系统向费用主导环境和高交易吞吐量过渡时的动态变化；3. 为评估可扩展工作量证明系统的均衡稳定性提供了框架；4. 对数字货币系统的监管和政策制定具有参考价值

title: Financial Integration of Asian Financial Markets Using Beta and Sigma Convergence

detail.title: Financial Integration of Asian Financial Markets Using Beta and Sigma Convergence
detail.abstract: The Asian financial markets have been under observation for quite some time now, especially with the rate at which these markets have been growing and becoming the favorites for most institutional investors. This paper attempts to explore certain aspects of the complex structure of global and regional financial integration utilizing the concepts of beta convergence and sigma convergence to measure the existence and level of inter-linkages among Asian and world equity markets.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用β收敛和σ收敛概念，探索亚洲与世界股票市场之间的金融一体化程度和互联性
AI.research_question: 亚洲股票市场与全球市场之间的金融一体化程度如何？是否存在收敛趋势？
AI.motivation: 亚洲金融市场快速增长并成为机构投资者的首选，需要理解其与全球市场的整合程度和互联结构
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融一体化理论，β收敛和σ收敛概念，用于衡量市场间的趋同程度和整合水平
AI.method: 使用β收敛和σ收敛方法分析亚洲和全球股票市场数据，测量市场间的互联程度
AI.findings: 论文将展示亚洲股票市场与全球市场的整合程度、收敛趋势以及区域内的互联模式
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展金融一体化理论在亚洲市场的应用，提供收敛分析的新视角，丰富国际金融整合的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者提供亚洲市场投资决策参考，帮助政策制定者理解区域金融稳定性，指导风险管理策略

title: The ARU Framework: Decomposing Investment Returns into Currency-Neutral and Real Purchasing Power Components

detail.title: The ARU Framework: Decomposing Investment Returns into Currency-Neutral and Real Purchasing Power Components
detail.abstract: This paper presents the Absolute Reference Unit (ARU), a framework for decomposing investment returns into currency-neutral and inflation-adjusted components using publicly available IMF and World Bank data. The methodology addresses a gap in real return analysis for international investors: existing approaches apply single-currency inflation measures that prevent meaningful cross-border performance comparisons. ARU uses the IMF's Special Drawing Rights (SDR) as a currency-neutral baseline and the World Bank's SDR-denominated GDP deflator for inflation adjustment. This creates a three-layer decomposition: nominal return (local currency), currency-neutral return (SDR-adjusted), and real purchasing power (ARU). Empirical analysis of S&P 500 returns demonstrates that USD and EUR investors see identical currency-neutral performance despite different nominal starting points, validating the framework's design. The paper documents both methodology and development process. Built in nine working days using AI-assisted coding without finance expertise, ARU received professional validation as "MSc Finance-level work" while revealing insufficient market demand for productization. The framework remains available as an open demonstration of rapid LLM-assisted prototyping and disciplined validation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了绝对参考单位（ARU）框架，使用IMF和世界银行的公开数据将投资回报分解为货币中性成分和通胀调整成分。该方法解决了国际投资者真实回报分析中的空白：现有方法使用单一货币通胀指标，无法进行有意义的跨境绩效比较。
AI.research_question: 如何为国际投资者开发一个能够将投资回报分解为货币中性成分和通胀调整成分的框架，以解决现有单一货币通胀调整方法无法进行跨境绩效比较的问题？
AI.motivation: 现有投资回报分析方法存在局限性：使用单一货币通胀指标无法进行有意义的跨境绩效比较，这给国际投资者的真实回报评估带来了困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于IMF特别提款权（SDR）作为货币中性基准，结合世界银行的SDR计价GDP平减指数进行通胀调整，构建三层分解框架：名义回报（本币）、货币中性回报（SDR调整）和实际购买力（ARU）。
AI.method: 使用IMF和世界银行的公开数据，以SDR作为货币中性基准，SDR计价GDP平减指数进行通胀调整。通过实证分析S&P 500回报来验证框架有效性，并采用AI辅助编码在9个工作日内完成开发。
AI.findings: 实证分析显示，美元和欧元投资者在货币中性层面看到相同的绩效表现，尽管他们的名义起点不同，这验证了框架设计的有效性。同时发现该框架虽然获得专业认可（"MSc金融水平的工作"），但市场需求不足，不适合产品化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个创新的三层回报分解框架，解决了国际投资绩效比较的理论空白，为跨境投资分析提供了新的方法论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可操作的框架和开源演示，展示了快速LLM辅助原型开发的能力，为国际投资者提供了实用的绩效分析工具，同时揭示了该领域市场需求有限的现实。

title: Does International Academic Mobility Enhance Students' Perceived Employability? Evidence from an Erasmus Programme Case Study

detail.title: Does International Academic Mobility Enhance Students' Perceived Employability? Evidence from an Erasmus Programme Case Study

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial, personal, or professional interests that could have influenced the research presented in this working paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethical approval was not required for this study, as it involved anonymous survey data, did not collect sensitive personal information, and posed no risk to participants. All respondents participated voluntarily and provided informed consent.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no competing financial, personal, or professional interests that could have influenced the research presented in this working paper.

detail.abstract: International academic mobility is widely promoted as a driver of graduate employability; however, empirical evidence at the student level remains limited. This quantitative working paper investigates whether Erasmus mobility intensity is associated with higher perceived employability and whether this relationship is explained by skill development. Primary data were collected through an anonymous survey administered to Erasmus students participating in academic activities in Alicante during the 2026 mobility period (n = 102). Mobility intensity was operationalised through a composite index combining duration of mobility, academic workload (ECTS), and engagement in academic activities beyond standard coursework. Perceived employability and skill development were measured using validated 7-point Likert-scale indices with strong internal consistency. Results indicate a positive association between mobility intensity and perceived employability (r = 0.29, p < 0.01). Skill development exhibits a stronger relationship with employability (r = 0.56, p < 0.001) and partially mediates the mobility-employability relationship in regression models. The findings suggest that Erasmus mobility enhances employability primarily through the development of transferable and intercultural skills rather than through participation alone. Implications are discussed for higher education internationalisation strategies and employability-oriented programme design.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过调查102名伊拉斯谟学生发现，国际学术流动强度与感知就业能力正相关，技能发展在这一关系中起部分中介作用，表明流动主要通过技能发展而非单纯参与来提升就业能力。
AI.research_question: 伊拉斯谟流动强度是否与更高的感知就业能力相关？这种关系是否通过技能发展来解释？
AI.motivation: 虽然国际学术流动被广泛认为是提升毕业生就业能力的驱动力，但学生层面的实证证据仍然有限，需要更深入的研究来理解流动如何影响就业能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于国际流动与就业能力关系的理论框架，强调技能发展作为中介机制的重要性，特别是可转移技能和跨文化技能的发展。
AI.method: 采用定量研究方法，通过匿名问卷调查收集102名参与阿利坎特学术活动的伊拉斯谟学生数据。流动强度通过持续时间、学术工作量（ECTS）和课外学术参与的综合指数衡量，感知就业能力和技能发展使用经过验证的7点李克特量表测量。
AI.findings: 结果显示：1）流动强度与感知就业能力呈正相关（r=0.29，p<0.01）；2）技能发展与就业能力关系更强（r=0.56，p<0.001）；3）技能发展在流动-就业能力关系中起部分中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于：1）验证了国际流动通过技能发展影响就业能力的中介机制；2）强调了流动质量（强度）而非单纯参与的重要性；3）为流动-就业能力关系提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践意义包括：1）为高等教育国际化战略提供设计指导；2）建议设计更注重技能发展的就业导向项目；3）强调流动项目的质量而非数量对就业能力提升的重要性。

title: A Systronomic Framework: The Systronomic Phenomenon of Hierarchical Stress Propagation and Modeling Civilizational Collapse

detail.title: A Systronomic Framework: The Systronomic Phenomenon of Hierarchical Stress Propagation and Modeling Civilizational Collapse
detail.abstract: This paper proposes the Systronomic Framework, a novel conceptual model for analyzing systemic socioeconomic risk through a 15-layer hierarchical lens. Building upon principles of hierarchical complexity and systems theory, the framework integrates ecological, economic, social, and digital domains into a unified analytical structure. It introduces a prototype Sovereign Stability Index (SSI) and early-warning indices to operationalise the assessment of stress propagation across interdependent layers. The utility of the framework is explored through retrospective, illustrative case studies of historical crises, including the 1997 Asian Financial Crisis and the 2022 Sri Lankan collapse. These examples demonstrate how the model's logic can be applied to trace the multi-layered precursors of instability. A key conceptual finding is the proposed primacy of foundational ecological stress (Layer 0) in enabling wider systemic vulnerability. The study argues that conventional economic models suffer from "Kinetic Bias"-an overemphasis on short-term financial indicators at the expense of underlying structural vulnerabilities in ecological and social foundations. By formalizing these interconnections, the Systronomic Framework offers a complementary perspective for systemic risk assessment. The paper concludes by discussing potential pathways for developing this theoretical approach into a practical tool for policymakers, highlighting the need for future empirical validation and interdisciplinary collaboration to test its core propositions.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了Systronomic框架，这是一个通过15层分层视角分析系统性社会经济风险的新概念模型。该框架整合了生态、经济、社会和数字领域，并引入了主权稳定性指数和预警指标来评估跨层级的压力传播。通过历史危机案例研究验证了其应用价值。
AI.research_question: 如何通过一个统一的分层框架来分析和评估系统性社会经济风险，特别是跨生态、经济、社会等领域的相互依存关系？
AI.motivation: 传统经济模型存在"动能偏见"，过度强调短期金融指标而忽视了生态和社会基础中的结构性脆弱性。需要一个新的框架来更好地理解系统性风险的跨领域传播。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于层次复杂性理论和系统理论，构建了一个包含15个层级的Systronomic框架，整合生态、经济、社会和数字领域。提出了"动能偏见"的概念，强调传统模型对短期金融指标的过度重视。
AI.method: 开发了概念框架和原型指标（主权稳定性指数和预警指数），并通过回顾性案例研究（1997年亚洲金融危机和2022年斯里兰卡崩溃）进行说明性验证。
AI.findings: 基础生态压力（第0层）在系统性脆弱性中具有首要地位；该框架能够追溯不稳定性的多层前兆；传统经济模型确实存在动能偏见问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了Systronomic框架作为系统性风险评估的补充视角；引入了"动能偏见"概念；强调了生态基础在系统性风险中的核心作用；为跨学科风险分析提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了主权稳定性指数和预警指数作为操作性工具；为政策制定者提供了实用的风险评估框架；通过历史案例展示了框架的应用价值；指出了未来实证验证和跨学科合作的方向。

title: When Price Becomes Narrative: The Collapse of the Coasean Distinction

detail.title: When Price Becomes Narrative: The Collapse of the Coasean Distinction

declarations.ethicsApproval: The author declares no conflicts of interest. AI tools (Claude, Anthropic) were used for editing assistance and feedback during the drafting process. All substantive intellectual content, theoretical development, and argumentation are the author's own.

detail.abstract: Ronald Coase's framework for institutional economics rests on a categorical distinction between two coordination modes: the price mechanism, which coordinates through impersonal signals verified by exchange, and the firm, which coordinates through managerial direction. This distinction determines the boundary of the firm and enables private resolution of externalities. Both applications are presupposed by the price mechanism's generation of sufficiently reliable signals that permit the cost comparisons upon which bargaining depends. Drawing on the temporal verification framework developed in "Price as a Construct of Time" (Lee, 2025), this paper argues that this presupposition has been progressively dissolved by the shift from tangible to intangible assets. When prices emit narrative rather than aggregate verified information, the market coordinates through the same mechanism as the entrepreneur and the categorical distinction collapses. The consequences are threefold. First, the Coasean margin determining firm boundaries becomes indeterminate, as focal entities whose emissions constitute the market's coordination structure simultaneously raise external organization costs for smaller firms. Second, the private resolution of externalities fails, as opportunity costs become narrativedependent rather than independently assessable. Third, the directionality between property rights and bargaining inverts: focal entities that resist adjudication also shape the epistemic environment in which rights are interpreted, rendering antitrust, regulation, and legal adjudication structurally miscalibrated.

AI.tldr: 科斯制度经济学框架基于价格机制与企业管理两种协调模式的区分，但无形资产时代价格发出的是叙事而非验证信息，导致这一区分瓦解，使企业边界不确定、外部性私人解决失效、产权与谈判关系倒置。
AI.research_question: 在无形资产主导的经济中，科斯框架中价格机制与企业管理的区分如何瓦解？这种瓦解对企业的边界、外部性解决以及产权与谈判关系有何影响？
AI.motivation: 科斯的制度经济学框架建立在价格机制（通过验证信号协调）与企业（通过管理指令协调）的明确区分上，但无形资产时代价格发出的是叙事而非验证信息，这一基础预设已不再成立，需要重新审视科斯框架的适用性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 科斯制度经济学框架：价格机制与企业管理的二元协调模式区分；2. 时间验证框架（Lee, 2025）：价格作为时间构造物；3. 无形资产经济学：从有形资产到无形资产的转变如何改变价格的信息属性。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念框架构建：基于时间验证框架，分析无形资产时代价格信号的性质变化，推导科斯框架预设瓦解的逻辑后果。
AI.findings: 1. 企业边界变得不确定：构成市场协调结构的焦点实体同时提高了小企业的外部组织成本；2. 外部性的私人解决失效：机会成本变得依赖叙事而非独立可评估；3. 产权与谈判关系倒置：抵抗裁决的焦点实体同时塑造权利解释的认知环境，使反垄断、监管和法律裁决结构性失调。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了科斯框架在无形资产时代的局限性；2. 提出了价格从验证信息到叙事的转变如何瓦解协调模式区分；3. 建立了无形资产、价格叙事与制度失效之间的理论联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业边界决策提供新视角；2. 揭示外部性私人解决的失效对政策制定的启示；3. 指出反垄断、监管和法律体系需要重新校准以适应叙事驱动的市场协调。

title: The Critical Liquidity Path and Point (CLPP) From Discretionary Governance to Binding Necessity: When Operation Precedes Authorization

detail.title: The Critical Liquidity Path and Point (CLPP) From Discretionary Governance to Binding Necessity: When Operation Precedes Authorization
detail.abstract:
This paper introduces the Critical Liquidity Path and Point (CLPP) framework to analyze how modern political-economic systems transition from discretionary governance to compulsory intervention under conditions of escalating systemic stress. Rather than treating crises as discrete events or policy failures, the framework focuses on the exhaustion of discretion as a structural condition.

CLPP distinguishes between two analytically distinct regimes. Along the Liquidity Absorption Path (LAP), stress remains operationally absorbable through re-routing, delay, balance-sheet migration or expansion, and institutional adaptation. Systems continue to function, markets clear, and authority appears intact, even as dependencies on backstops and procedural elasticity deepen. The Liquidity Binding Point (LBP) marks the moment when these absorption mechanisms saturate. At this point, further adjustment becomes non-discretionary: intervention is no longer a policy option but an operational requirement imposed by binding constraints.

Binding can occur across six domains—collateral availability, duration exposure, energy transmission, social obligations (particularly pensions), legal authorization, and alliance coordination. While these domains differ in form and transmission speed, once binding they override preference and compel action regardless of ideology or intent. Energy shocks function primarily as accelerators by compressing time windows for re-routing, but can themselves become binding when distributional or political tolerances are breached.

The paper uses the UK gilt crisis of September 2022 as an illustrative case, showing how pension-related stress transmitted through leveraged liability-driven investment strategies forced central bank intervention within hours. The episode demonstrates how operational necessity can systematically outrun formal authorization.

CLPP is diagnostic rather than predictive. It does not forecast crises or evaluate the desirability of intervention. Instead, it provides analytical tools for identifying when and where sovereignty shifts from discretion to necessity under conditions of systemic escalation—clarifying why contemporary governance increasingly operates in a temporal domain where operation precedes authorization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了临界流动性路径与点（CLPP）框架，用于分析现代政治经济系统如何在系统性压力升级条件下从自由裁量治理转向强制性干预。该框架关注"裁量权耗尽"这一结构性条件，而非将危机视为离散事件或政策失败。
AI.research_question: 现代政治经济系统在系统性压力升级条件下，如何以及何时从自由裁量治理转向强制性干预？
AI.motivation: 传统危机分析将危机视为离散事件或政策失败，但缺乏对"裁量权耗尽"这一结构性条件的分析。需要理解为什么当代治理越来越多地在"操作先于授权"的时间域中运作。
AI.theoretical_framework: 临界流动性路径与点（CLPP）框架，包含流动性吸收路径（LAP）和流动性约束点（LBP）两个分析性区分机制，以及六个约束领域：抵押品可得性、期限暴露、能源传输、社会义务（特别是养老金）、法律授权和联盟协调。
AI.method: 使用2022年9月英国国债危机作为案例研究，展示养老金相关压力如何通过杠杆负债驱动投资策略在数小时内迫使央行干预，说明操作必要性如何系统性地超越正式授权。
AI.findings: 1. 系统在流动性吸收路径上可通过重新路由、延迟、资产负债表迁移或扩张、制度适应等方式吸收压力；2. 当吸收机制饱和时达到流动性约束点，干预不再是政策选择而是操作要求；3. 约束一旦发生，会超越偏好并强制行动，无论意识形态或意图如何；4. 能源冲击主要作为加速器，压缩重新路由的时间窗口。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出了分析系统性压力下治理转型的新框架；2. 将"裁量权耗尽"概念化为结构性条件而非政策失败；3. 识别了六个关键约束领域；4. 解释了"操作先于授权"的当代治理现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供诊断工具识别主权何时何地从裁量转向必要性；2. 帮助政策制定者理解系统性压力下的约束条件；3. 为危机管理和干预时机提供分析框架；4. 阐明能源冲击在系统性压力中的作用机制。

title: Evaluating UA-Readiness in Indian E-commerce Apps: Why .bharat Email Addresses Still Fail in 2026

detail.title: Evaluating UA-Readiness in Indian E-commerce Apps: Why .bharat Email Addresses Still Fail in 2026
detail.abstract: India's digital narrative centers on the expansion of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI), yet a systemic technical friction point remains: the lack of Universal Acceptance (UA). This paper examines the failure of prominent Indian e-commerce applications to support Internationalized Domain Names (IDNs) and Email Address Internationalization (EAI), focusing on the .bharat TLD. Through empirical testing of five dominant retail platforms, this study identifies antiquated validation protocols and backend infrastructure gaps as the primary drivers of digital exclusion for non-English speaking demographics.

title: Emotional Intelligence as a Predictor of Effective and Transformative School Leadership: Evidence from Azerbaijani Educators
affiliations: , Baku Engineering University, Baku State University and Azerbaijan State Pedagogical University

detail.title: Emotional Intelligence as a Predictor of Effective and Transformative School Leadership: Evidence from Azerbaijani Educators

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare that they have no financial, institutional, or personal conflicts of interest that could have influenced the design, execution, or reporting of this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study involved voluntary and anonymous participation from educators and did not collect any personally identifiable information. In accordance with institutional and international guidelines for minimal‑risk research, formal ethics committee approval was not required. Informed consent was obtained from all participants at the beginning of the survey.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. All data collection, analysis, and writing were conducted independently by the authors.

detail.abstract: This study examines the role of Emotional Intelligence (EI) in shaping effective and transformative school leadership within the Azerbaijani educational context. Drawing on a mixed-methods design supported by quantitative Likert-scale measures and qualitative open-ended responses from 89 participants, the research investigates how core EI competencies-including self-awareness, self-regulation, motivation, empathy, and social skills-predict leaders' capacity to foster positive school climates, enhance staff motivation, and support student success. Quantitative results demonstrate consistently elevated levels of EI across respondents, with mean scores indicating strong emotional awareness, effective decision-making, and constructive conflict management. Correlational patterns further suggest that EI competencies are strongly associated with school climate perceptions, leadership satisfaction, and interpersonal effectiveness. Complementing these findings, thematic analysis of qualitative data reveals that emotionally intelligent leadership is perceived as essential for building trust, strengthening communication, and creating inclusive environments that promote collaboration and professional growth. Participants emphasized that EI enables leaders to remain calm under pressure, understand diverse emotional needs, and address challenges with empathy and fairness. Reported obstacles-such as managing others' emotions, balancing empathy with authority, and navigating stressful or unpredictable situations-highlight the complex emotional demands placed on school leaders. Overall, the study provides compelling evidence that EI significantly enhances leadership effectiveness and is a critical determinant of a healthy, high-functioning school ecosystem. By demonstrating that emotionally intelligent leadership improves relationships, supports academic performance, and fosters organizational well-being, this research underscores the necessity of integrating EI-focused professional development into leadership preparation programs. The findings contribute to global scholarship advocating for emotionally grounded, human-centered approaches to educational leadership and offer context-specific insights for advancing leadership quality in Azerbaijan.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了情绪智力在阿塞拜疆教育背景下对学校领导力的影响，采用混合方法发现情绪智力能显著提升领导效能、改善学校氛围并促进组织健康。
AI.research_question: 情绪智力（包括自我意识、自我调节、动机、同理心和社交技能）如何影响学校领导者营造积极学校氛围、提升员工动力和支持学生成功的能力？
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于理解情绪智力在阿塞拜疆教育背景下对学校领导有效性的作用，为提升学校领导质量提供实证依据，并推动将情绪智力纳入领导力发展项目。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于情绪智力理论框架，特别是Goleman的情绪智力模型，包括自我意识、自我调节、动机、同理心和社交技能五个核心能力维度。
AI.method: 采用混合方法设计，包括定量研究（89名参与者的李克特量表测量）和定性研究（开放式问题回答），通过相关性分析和主题分析探索情绪智力与领导效能的关系。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1）参与者情绪智力水平普遍较高；2）情绪智力与学校氛围感知、领导满意度和人际效能显著相关；3）情绪智力领导被视为建立信任、加强沟通和创造包容环境的关键；4）领导者面临管理他人情绪、平衡同理心与权威等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献：1）为情绪智力在教育领导领域的应用提供实证支持；2）扩展了情绪智力在非西方教育背景下的研究；3）丰富了情绪智力与组织健康关系的理论理解；4）支持情感基础、以人为本的教育领导方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献：1）为阿塞拜疆学校领导力发展提供具体建议；2）强调将情绪智力培训纳入领导准备项目的必要性；3）提供改善学校氛围和领导效能的实用策略；4）为教育政策制定者提供决策依据。

title: How Ricardian Are We?
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City and

detail.title: How Ricardian Are We?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City Working Paper No. RWP 26-02
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Not very. To answer this question, we conjecture that households might be non-Ricardian because they do not have rational expectations over their future tax burden. From this assumption, we derive a behavioral consumption function, where households act as if bonds are net wealth, and consume out of taxes and transfers. The coefficient on taxes is determined by the attenuation present in households' behavioral expectations. This consumption function also nests other causes of non-Ricardianism, including liquidity constraints and overlapping generations. To estimate the coefficient, we derive a Bayesian limited information method that uses a large number of macroeconomic shocks from the literature as instrumental variables. We find that households internalize only 1/5 of their future taxes. In a general equilibrium model, this low value implies that public borrowing substantially crowds out private investment.

AI.tldr: 研究发现家庭仅内化了未来税收的1/5，导致公共借款显著挤出私人投资
AI.research_question: 家庭在多大程度上内化未来税收负担？这对公共借款和私人投资有何影响？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭是否具有理性预期并完全内化未来税收负担，这对财政政策有效性至关重要
AI.theoretical_framework: 非李嘉图主义消费理论，行为消费函数，家庭将债券视为净财富
AI.method: 贝叶斯有限信息方法，使用大量宏观经济冲击作为工具变量进行估计
AI.findings: 家庭仅内化了未来税收的1/5，在一般均衡模型中，这种低内化程度导致公共借款显著挤出私人投资
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于行为预期的非李嘉图消费函数，统一了流动性约束和代际重叠等其他非李嘉图主义原因
AI.practical_contributions: 为财政政策设计提供实证依据，表明公共借款对私人投资有显著挤出效应，影响政策有效性评估

title: Cubic Fragility in Financial Networks: A Crisis Prediction Framework
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Cubic Fragility in Financial Networks: A Crisis Prediction Framework
detail.abstract: Financial crises are frequently preceded by systematic early warning signals that contemporary frameworks fail to detect. This paper introduces Cubic Fragility-a nonlinear model wherein systemic risk scales with the cube of efficiency degradation. Utilizing stochastic calculus and crisis escape theory, I derive a closed-form predictor for crisis timing. Furthermore, I propose a Dynamic Capital Requirement (DCR) calibrated to fragility metrics, offering a mathematically grounded automatic stabilizer for macro-prudential policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"立方脆弱性"非线性模型，发现系统性风险与效率退化的立方成正比，并推导出危机时机的闭式预测器，同时提出基于脆弱性指标的动态资本要求作为宏观审慎政策的自动稳定器。
AI.research_question: 如何建立非线性模型来检测系统性风险的早期预警信号，并设计基于数学基础的宏观审慎政策工具？
AI.motivation: 现有框架无法检测金融危机前的系统性早期预警信号，需要开发更有效的非线性模型和政策工具来预防危机。
AI.theoretical_framework: 立方脆弱性模型（系统性风险与效率退化立方成正比）、随机微积分、危机逃逸理论
AI.method: 使用随机微积分和危机逃逸理论推导危机时机的闭式预测器，并设计基于脆弱性指标的动态资本要求
AI.findings: 系统性风险与效率退化的立方成正比，可以推导出危机时机的闭式预测器，动态资本要求可作为有效的宏观审慎政策工具
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了立方脆弱性非线性模型，扩展了系统性风险理论，为危机预测提供了新的数学框架
AI.practical_contributions: 设计了基于脆弱性指标的动态资本要求，为监管机构提供了数学基础扎实的宏观审慎政策工具和自动稳定器

title: Cubic Fragility in Financial Networks: A Regime-Dependent Crisis Prediction Framework
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Cubic Fragility in Financial Networks: A Regime-Dependent Crisis Prediction Framework
detail.abstract: Financial crises are frequently preceded by systematic early warning signals that contemporary risk frameworks fail to detect. This paper introduces Cubic Fragility-a regime-dependent nonlinear model wherein systemic risk scales with efficiency degradation through mechanisms that are fundamentally contingent on monetary policy conditions. By synthesizing stochastic calculus and crisis escape theory with empirical validation using Federal Reserve Economic Data (2014-2026), I derive regime-specific predictors for crisis timing. The results demonstrate that the relationship between market efficiency and systemic fragility reverses sign across monetary policy regimes. Furthermore, I introduce a Regime-Adaptive Dynamic Capital Requirement (RA-DCR), a framework calibrated to both fragility metrics and policy stance, offering a mathematically grounded automatic stabilizer for macro-prudential policy. Key Finding: The cubic fragility mechanism is dominant in accommodative monetary regimes (FFR < 1%), whereas restrictive regimes (FFR ≥ 3%) exhibit an inverse dynamic where efficiency gains mitigate fragility. This regime-dependence resolves apparent contradictions in prior empirical literature and carries profound implications for financial stability policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"立方脆弱性"模型，发现系统性风险与市场效率的关系在货币政策不同阶段呈现非线性反转：宽松政策下效率下降加剧风险，紧缩政策下效率提升缓解风险。基于此开发了适应不同政策环境的动态资本要求框架。
AI.research_question: 系统性风险与市场效率之间的关系如何随货币政策环境变化？能否建立适应不同政策阶段的危机预警和宏观审慎政策框架？
AI.motivation: 传统风险框架无法检测金融危机前的系统性预警信号，且现有文献对市场效率与系统性风险关系的实证结果存在矛盾，需要建立考虑货币政策环境的非线性模型来解释这些现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 立方脆弱性理论（非线性机制）、随机微积分、危机逃逸理论、货币政策传导机制、系统性风险理论
AI.method: 结合随机微积分和危机逃逸理论构建非线性模型，使用美联储经济数据（2014-2026）进行实证验证，推导不同政策阶段的危机时间预测因子
AI.findings: 市场效率与系统性脆弱性关系在货币政策不同阶段呈现符号反转：宽松政策下（FFR<1%）效率下降加剧脆弱性，紧缩政策下（FFR≥3%）效率提升缓解脆弱性
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出立方脆弱性这一非线性机制；2. 解释了先前文献中市场效率与风险关系的矛盾发现；3. 建立了货币政策依赖的系统性风险理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 开发了适应不同政策阶段的动态资本要求框架；2. 提供了基于数学基础的宏观审慎自动稳定器；3. 为金融稳定政策提供了新的工具和视角

title: The Last-Mile Paradox: How Technology Failed to Bridge India's Hyperlocal Mobility Gap in Tier 2 and Tier 3 Cities

detail.title: The Last-Mile Paradox: How Technology Failed to Bridge India's Hyperlocal Mobility Gap in Tier 2 and Tier 3 Cities

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no known financial or personal conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research presented in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, experiments, or the use of personal data, and therefore did not require ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: While technology platforms have transformed urban mobility in Indian metros, last-mile connectivity in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities remains fundamentally broken. This paper examines why platforms like Uber, Ola, and Rapido have failed to solve hyperlocal (1-5km) mobility needs in smaller cities, leaving tourists and residents vulnerable to pricing exploitation and service unreliability. Through lived experience across Varanasi, Mussoorie, Manali, Mathura, Agra, and rural Bihar over 6 years, combined with economic analysis, I demonstrate that the density-dependent economics of hyperlocal mobility cannot be replicated by national platform models designed for metros. The research proposes that solving last-mile mobility requires understanding local network effects, community-embedded operations, and fundamentally different unit economics than those used in Tier 1 cities.

AI.tldr: 印度二三线城市最后一公里出行问题：全国性平台模式（如Uber、Ola）无法复制到小城市，需要基于本地网络效应和社区嵌入的差异化解决方案。
AI.research_question: 为什么Uber、Ola、Rapido等平台在印度二三线城市无法解决1-5公里的超本地出行需求？
AI.motivation: 技术平台改变了印度大都市的出行方式，但二三线城市的最后一公里连接仍然严重不足，游客和居民面临价格剥削和服务不可靠的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 密度依赖经济学、本地网络效应理论、平台经济在非大都市环境的应用限制
AI.method: 基于6年在瓦拉纳西、穆索里、马纳利、马图拉、阿格拉和比哈尔邦农村的生活体验，结合经济分析
AI.findings: 超本地出行的密度依赖经济学无法通过为大都市设计的全国性平台模式复制；解决最后一公里出行需要理解本地网络效应和社区嵌入运营
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了平台经济在非大都市环境中的适用性限制理论；发展了基于本地网络效应和社区嵌入的超本地出行经济学框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为二三线城市出行平台设计提供指导：需要不同于一线城市的单位经济学模型；强调社区嵌入运营的重要性；为政策制定者提供解决最后一公里出行问题的框架

reference: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-38
title: Who Gets What in Education: Can School Matching Improve Student Achievement?
affiliations: Duke University - Department of Economics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics and University of Chicago

detail.title: Who Gets What in Education: Can School Matching Improve Student Achievement?

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-38
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We examine two approaches to improving urban school systems: changing who gets to go to existing schools (reallocation) and restructuring school portfolios through closures and reconstitution (resource augmentation). Using data from New York City high schools, we estimate models of school effects allowing for both vertical school quality differences and horizontal student-specific match effects. While sophisticated reallocation policies that optimize studentschool matches can generate modest educational gains, they are constrained by limited seats at highly effective schools. Simple resource-augmentation policies targeting replacement of lowperforming schools achieve comparable improvements with less systemic disruption. Analysis of NYC's school closures reveals that basic graduation rate metrics effectively identify struggling schools, suggesting complex value-added models may be unnecessary for targeting closure decisions. Our findings indicate that capacity constraints, rather than poor school matching, primarily drive educational inequality.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了改善城市学校系统的两种策略：重新分配学生到现有学校（再分配）与通过关闭和重组学校来调整学校组合（资源增强）。研究发现，虽然优化学生-学校匹配的再分配政策能带来适度教育收益，但受限于优质学校的有限席位。简单的资源增强政策（替换低绩效学校）能达到类似效果且系统干扰更小。分析显示，毕业率等基本指标足以识别需关闭的学校，复杂的增值模型可能不必要。研究指出，容量限制而非学校匹配不佳是教育不平等的主要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 如何有效改善城市学校系统？比较重新分配学生（再分配）与调整学校组合（资源增强）两种策略的效果，并探讨容量限制与学校匹配在教育不平等中的作用。
AI.motivation: 城市学校系统面临教育不平等问题，需要有效的改进策略。现有研究关注学校质量差异，但对容量限制和学校匹配的作用理解不足。政策制定者需要在再分配和资源增强策略间做出选择，但缺乏实证证据指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 学校效果模型：包含垂直学校质量差异和水平学生-学校匹配效应；2. 教育不平等理论：强调容量限制而非匹配不佳是主要驱动因素；3. 政策评估框架：比较再分配与资源增强策略的系统影响。
AI.method: 使用纽约市高中数据，估计学校效果模型（允许垂直质量差异和水平匹配效应）。分析再分配政策（优化学生-学校匹配）与资源增强政策（关闭低绩效学校）的效果。评估NYC学校关闭决策中不同指标的有效性。
AI.findings: 1. 优化学生-学校匹配的再分配政策能带来适度教育收益，但受优质学校容量限制；2. 简单的资源增强政策（替换低绩效学校）能达到类似改善效果，且系统干扰更小；3. 毕业率等基本指标能有效识别需关闭的学校，复杂增值模型可能不必要；4. 容量限制而非学校匹配不佳是教育不平等的主要驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出并验证了容量限制是教育不平等主要驱动因素的理论；2. 发展了同时考虑垂直质量差异和水平匹配效应的学校效果模型；3. 为政策选择提供了理论框架，强调资源增强策略的相对优势。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了实证依据：资源增强策略（关闭低绩效学校）比复杂的再分配策略更有效且干扰更小；2. 简化了学校关闭决策：毕业率等简单指标足以识别目标学校，无需复杂增值模型；3. 强调了解决容量限制的重要性，为教育资源配置提供指导。

title: School Choice and Segregation: Evidence from the Oakland Unified School District
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley, The Richard & Rhoda Goldman School of Public Policy,  and University of Chicago

detail.title: School Choice and Segregation: Evidence from the Oakland Unified School District

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-38
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: We study the prospects for changes in school priorities to reduce income segregation in a context of centralized school assignment, accounting for behavioral responses to school offers. Promoting integration is a central objective for large urban school districts in the US, and reforms to school assignment priorities are a prominent means of pursuing this goal. Such efforts may be constrained by students' decisions to exit the public school system in response to lesspreferred school offers. Using data on kindergarten applicants to the Oakland Unified School District (OUSD), we show that offers of spots at first-choice schools boost the likelihood that applicants remain in OUSD. Nevertheless, simulations show that policy reforms giving priority for low-income students at high-income schools can substantially reduce segregation with minimal impacts on retention in the district.

AI.tldr: 研究学校优先权政策改革如何减少收入隔离，同时考虑家长对学校录取结果的应对行为。通过奥克兰联合学区数据发现，第一志愿录取能提高学生留在公立学区的可能性，但模拟显示给予低收入学生在高收入学校的优先权能显著减少隔离且对学区保留率影响很小。
AI.research_question: 学校优先权政策改革能否在减少收入隔离的同时，最小化因学校录取结果不理想而导致的学生退出公立学校系统的行为？
AI.motivation: 美国大城市学区将促进融合作为核心目标，学校分配优先权改革是实现这一目标的重要手段。但此类改革可能受到学生因获得不理想学校录取而退出公立学校系统的限制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集中式学校分配系统中的行为反应理论，家长对学校录取结果的应对行为，收入隔离与学校选择的关系。
AI.method: 使用奥克兰联合学区幼儿园申请者的数据，分析第一志愿学校录取对留在学区可能性的影响，并进行政策模拟分析。
AI.findings: 1) 获得第一志愿学校录取能显著提高申请者留在奥克兰联合学区的可能性；2) 模拟显示，给予低收入学生在高收入学校的优先权政策能大幅减少收入隔离，同时对学区保留率影响很小。
AI.theory_contributions: 在集中式学校分配系统中考虑行为反应的政策评估框架，为学校优先权改革提供了理论支持，证明了在减少隔离的同时最小化学生流失的可能性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学区管理者提供了具体的政策建议：通过调整学校优先权来促进收入融合，同时不会显著增加学生退出公立学校系统的风险，这对美国大城市学区改革具有重要实践意义。

title: Weather Risk and Financial Markets: Credit Risk  Stock Returns and Corporate Fundamentals

detail.title: Weather Risk and Financial Markets: Credit Risk  Stock Returns and Corporate Fundamentals
detail.abstract: This study examines the financial implications of weather risk by analyzing its impact on credit markets, equity returns, and corporate fundamentals. Using a novel dataset from the National Weather Service's Storm Events Database, we find that higher weather risk consistently predicts wider credit default swap (CDS) spreads, lower stock returns, reduced profitability, and higher leverage-effects that are most pronounced for speculative-grade firms and during favorable market conditions. Causal evidence from event studies and instrumental variable analyses indicates that extreme weather events directly increase firm-level credit risk. These effects operate through reduced free cash flow and increased stock return volatility.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析天气风险对信用市场、股票收益和企业基本面的影响，发现天气风险升高会扩大CDS利差、降低股票收益、减少盈利能力并提高杠杆率，这些效应在投机级公司和市场条件良好时最为明显。
AI.research_question: 天气风险如何影响企业的信用市场、股票收益和企业基本面？
AI.motivation: 随着气候变化加剧，极端天气事件频发，了解天气风险对企业财务表现的影响对于投资者、债权人和政策制定者具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于风险定价理论、企业财务理论和气候变化经济学，探讨天气风险如何通过现金流波动和风险溢价渠道影响企业价值。
AI.method: 使用国家气象局风暴事件数据库的新数据集，结合事件研究法和工具变量分析来建立因果关系。
AI.findings: 天气风险升高预测更宽的CDS利差、更低的股票收益、更低的盈利能力和更高的杠杆率；这些效应在投机级公司和市场条件良好时最为明显；极端天气事件直接增加企业信用风险；机制是通过减少自由现金流和增加股票收益波动性。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地将天气风险纳入企业财务分析框架，揭示了天气风险通过现金流和波动性渠道影响企业价值的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供天气风险定价的实证依据，帮助企业进行气候风险管理，为监管机构制定气候相关金融政策提供参考。

title: Quantum Bayesian Inference: An Exploration
affiliations: Bank for International Settlements, Central Bank of Chile and University of Chicago - Department of Economics

detail.title: Quantum Bayesian Inference: An Exploration

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-40
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces a framework for performing Bayesian inference using quantum computation. It presents a proof-of-concept quantum algorithm that performs posterior sampling. We provide an accessible introduction to quantum computation for economists and a practical demonstration of quantum-based posterior sampling for Bayesian estimation. Our key contribution is the preparation of a quantum state whose measurement yields samples from a discretized posterior distribution. While the proposed approach does not yet offer computational speedups over classical techniques such as Markov Chain Monte Carlo, it highlights both the conceptual promise and practical challenges in integrating quantum computation into the
econometrician’s toolbox.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一个使用量子计算进行贝叶斯推断的框架，开发了一种概念验证的量子算法来执行后验采样，为经济学家提供了量子计算的入门介绍，并展示了基于量子的后验采样在贝叶斯估计中的实际应用。
AI.research_question: 如何利用量子计算技术进行贝叶斯推断中的后验采样？
AI.motivation: 探索将量子计算技术整合到计量经济学工具箱中的潜力，虽然目前尚未超越经典方法（如MCMC）的计算速度优势，但展示量子计算在贝叶斯推断中的概念前景和实际挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于量子计算理论和贝叶斯推断理论，结合量子态制备和测量原理，构建量子后验采样框架。
AI.method: 开发概念验证的量子算法，通过制备量子态使其测量结果来自离散化后验分布的样本，为经济学家提供量子计算入门介绍并进行实际演示。
AI.findings: 成功实现了量子态制备，其测量能够产生来自离散化后验分布的样本，证明了量子计算在贝叶斯推断中的可行性，但当前方法尚未超越经典MCMC的计算速度。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了首个将量子计算应用于贝叶斯后验采样的理论框架，为量子计量经济学奠定了基础，展示了量子计算在统计推断中的概念潜力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学家提供了量子计算的实用入门指南，开发了可操作的量子后验采样算法原型，为未来量子计算在计量经济学中的应用铺平了道路。
