title: Household Preferences for Women's Employment: A Field Experiment in Bangladesh
affiliations: University of Chicago - Harris School of Public Policy, Harvard Business School, University of Chicago - Harris School of Public Policy and University of Chicago

detail.title: Household Preferences for Women's Employment: A Field Experiment in Bangladesh

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago, Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper No. 2026-41
publicationDetails.journalName: Becker Friedman Institute for Economics Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper investigates household preferences over who should work and whether these preferences are malleable. We document that men and women prefer that husbands work over wives. To understand why, we randomly assign a six-week job to either the husband or wife and document asymmetry: women's work improves their own wellbeing but not their husbands', while men's work improves both partners' wellbeing. One year later, we surprise households with a work opportunity. Both women and men in households where women were previously employed are more likely to prefer the woman take the job and express fewer concerns about women's employment in general.

AI.tldr: 研究家庭对谁应该工作的偏好及其可塑性。发现男女都偏好丈夫工作而非妻子工作。通过随机分配工作实验发现：女性工作只改善自身福祉，而男性工作改善夫妻双方福祉。一年后提供工作机会时，之前女性工作过的家庭更倾向女性工作，且对女性就业顾虑减少。
AI.research_question: 家庭对谁应该工作的偏好是什么？这些偏好是否具有可塑性？
AI.motivation: 理解家庭内部工作分配的性别偏好及其形成机制，探索通过实际工作经验改变这些偏好的可能性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭经济学、性别角色理论、偏好形成理论、行为经济学中的经验效应
AI.method: 随机对照实验：随机分配六周工作给丈夫或妻子，测量夫妻双方福祉变化。一年后进行追踪调查，提供意外工作机会观察偏好变化。
AI.findings: 1. 初始偏好：男女都偏好丈夫工作而非妻子工作；2. 工作效应不对称：女性工作只改善自身福祉，男性工作改善夫妻双方福祉；3. 偏好可塑性：之前女性工作过的家庭更倾向女性接受新工作，对女性就业顾虑减少。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示家庭工作分配偏好的性别不对称性；2. 证明工作经验可以改变性别角色偏好；3. 提出工作效应不对称的理论解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为促进女性就业提供干预思路；2. 表明实际工作经验比单纯宣传教育更有效改变性别偏见；3. 为家庭政策设计提供实证依据。

title: Uncovering the Root Causes of Early Marriage in Indonesia: Legal Perspectives and Evidence from a Systematic Literature Review

detail.title: Uncovering the Root Causes of Early Marriage in Indonesia: Legal Perspectives and Evidence from a Systematic Literature Review
detail.abstract: The trend of early marriage in Indonesia continues to increase, and its mitigation remains a serious challenge. This study aims to find the ideal point for the problem of early marriage in Indonesia. To answer this question, this paper is first broken down into three major sections: 1) looking at the effectiveness of Law No. 16/2019 on the number of early marriages in Indonesia, for which the Systematic Literature Review (SLR) method is used; 2) looking at the general tendency of family law scholars towards the age of marriage in the Law a quo; and 3) finding the ideal point of the problem of early marriage in Indonesia based on the literature obtained in the SLR results and analyzed using the Root Cause Analysis theory. The results of this study found that: 1) Law No. 16 of 2019 is certainly not effective in reducing the number of early marriages, 2) there is a tendency for family law scholars to see the purpose of the formation of Law No. 16 of 2019 as an effort by the state to reduce the number of early marriages; and 3) the root causes of early marriage in Indonesia are lack of education, lack of awareness of parents and society, and the lack of the role of the court in filtering incoming marriage dispensation applications whether they are free from coercion. The implications of this research are expected to make an important contribution to the development of policies that are more effective and relevant in the Indonesian social context.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析印尼早婚问题，评估2019年第16号法律的有效性，探讨家庭法学者的观点，并找出早婚的根本原因。研究发现该法律未能有效减少早婚，学者认为其旨在减少早婚，而根本原因包括教育不足、家长社会意识缺乏以及法院审查不严。
AI.research_question: 如何找到印尼早婚问题的理想解决方案？具体包括：1) 2019年第16号法律对早婚数量的有效性；2) 家庭法学者对该法律婚姻年龄规定的普遍倾向；3) 基于文献和根本原因分析找到早婚问题的理想解决点。
AI.motivation: 印尼早婚趋势持续上升，缓解这一问题仍然是严峻挑战。需要找到解决早婚问题的理想方案，为政策制定提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 根本原因分析理论（Root Cause Analysis theory）用于分析早婚问题的深层原因。
AI.method: 采用系统文献综述（SLR）方法分析法律有效性；结合文献分析和根本原因分析理论探讨早婚问题的理想解决方案。
AI.findings: 1) 2019年第16号法律未能有效减少早婚数量；2) 家庭法学者普遍认为该法律的目的是国家减少早婚的努力；3) 印尼早婚的根本原因包括：教育缺乏、家长和社会意识不足、法院在审查婚姻特许申请时未能有效过滤强迫婚姻。
AI.theory_contributions: 应用根本原因分析理论系统识别早婚问题的深层原因，为理解早婚现象提供了理论框架和分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印尼制定更有效和相关的早婚政策提供实证依据，建议加强教育、提高社会意识、完善法院审查机制，对政策制定具有重要参考价值。

title: Patently Problematic: Innovation, Access, and the Road Ahead
affiliations: and

detail.title: Patently Problematic: Innovation, Access, and the Road Ahead

publicationDetails.detailsText: GLC Mumbai Intellectual property rights journal, volume 1 (ISBN: 978-93-95033-48-0)

detail.abstract: Patents act as a catalyst for progress in the pharmaceutical industry, while also presenting problems of access to cheaper, more reasonable and fair medicines. Patents give temporary exclusive rights to the market so that pharma companies can recover the enormous costs of research, testing trials and approval. However, this exclusivity contributes to high charges for drugs, so crucial medications become unavailable to clients with low incomes. Tactics such as “evergreening” and the laying of ‘patent thickets’ extend these exclusivity periods, raising ethical concerns about their impact on affordability and fairness. High-profile examples include the EpiPen and Daraprim whose prices were hiked sharply showing that the balance between innovation push and public health demand is still being tested. Pharmaceutical patents have mixed results on an international basis. Most challenges are obvious to developing nations where cheap and effective medication is most wanted. These inequities are now being addressed by methods such as compulsory licensing and the formation of patent pools. At the same time, inventive industries such as biologics and gene therapies add new problems to patent structures, making the call for change louder. Solutions such as public financing, ‘open source’ drug innovation and company-state collaboration give feasible solutions to countercheck innovation and accessibility. This discussion outlines economic, ethical and legal issues concerning pharmaceutical patents and hence the need for crafting intellectual property policies that address the user need and technological innovation aspects in the global sphere.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了药品专利在促进创新与保障药品可及性之间的平衡问题，分析了专利制度如何既推动医药研发又导致药价高昂，特别是对低收入人群的影响，并讨论了国际层面的不平等问题及可能的解决方案。
AI.research_question: 药品专利制度如何在促进医药创新与保障药品可及性（特别是对低收入人群）之间取得平衡？
AI.motivation: 药品专利作为医药创新的催化剂，却同时导致药价高昂，使关键药物对低收入人群不可及。专利常青化和专利丛林等策略延长了独占期，引发了关于药品可负担性和公平性的伦理担忧。国际层面，发展中国家面临更严峻的药品可及性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识产权经济学理论、创新激励理论、公共卫生伦理理论，以及全球健康公平理论，分析专利制度在医药领域的多重影响。
AI.method: 采用文献综述和案例分析的方法，分析药品专利的经济、伦理和法律问题，通过EpiPen和Daraprim等典型案例说明专利制度对药价的影响，并探讨国际层面的不平等问题。
AI.findings: 药品专利制度确实促进了医药创新，但同时也导致药价高昂，特别是在专利常青化和专利丛林策略下。发展中国家面临更严重的药品可及性问题。生物制剂和基因疗法等新兴领域对现有专利结构提出了新挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于整合了知识产权经济学、公共卫生伦理和全球健康公平理论，提出了一个分析药品专利制度多维影响的框架，强调了在创新激励与公共健康需求之间寻求平衡的理论必要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献包括：1）提出了强制许可、专利池等具体政策工具；2）建议了公共资助、开源药物创新、公私合作等解决方案；3）为政策制定者提供了制定平衡创新激励与药品可及性的知识产权政策的参考。

title: Gender Dynamics and Leadership Roles in Community Development Initiatives

detail.title: Gender Dynamics and Leadership Roles in Community Development Initiatives
detail.abstract: The research investigates gender interactions together with leadership positions in community development projects across Zamboanga City through qualitative methodology. The researcher conducted in-depth interviews with 15 community leaders where eight participants were women, and seven participants were men. Multiple research methods such as focus group discussions with participants and observation of activities were used to fully understand gender interactions and social norms. Research evidence shows that female leaders enable communityto-community engagement by making social welfare programs their main priority while promoting participation from all community members in decision-making processes. Women community leaders are still encountering cultural prejudices and official exclusion from decision-making structures as well as limited possibilities to advance their leadership positions. Formal authority positions that primarily belong to men lead them toward hierarchical and directive methodologies as leadership approaches. Despite recognizing the advantages of inclusive leadership certain male officials face difficulties converting to participatory governance due to traditional leadership behavior patterns. The research shows that genderspecific training initiatives and inclusive leadership approaches should become essential for closing leadership gaps which produce equitable decision-making opportunities. The study utilizes real-world leader experiences to deliver usable strategies for developing sustainable gender-based community progress in Zamboanga City.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过质性方法调查菲律宾三宝颜市社区发展项目中的性别互动与领导职位关系。研究发现女性领导者更注重社会福利项目并促进社区参与，但仍面临文化偏见和决策排斥；男性领导者则倾向于等级制领导方式。研究建议性别特定培训和包容性领导方法以缩小领导差距。
AI.research_question: 三宝颜市社区发展项目中性别互动与领导职位之间的关系如何？不同性别领导者在社区发展中的领导方式、面临的挑战以及决策过程有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解社区发展项目中性别与领导力的动态关系，揭示性别如何影响领导风格、决策过程和社区参与，为促进性别平等和包容性社区发展提供实证基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别与领导力理论、参与式治理理论、社区发展理论、社会规范理论、包容性领导理论
AI.method: 质性研究方法，包括对15名社区领导者（8名女性，7名男性）的深度访谈、焦点小组讨论和活动观察，采用多种方法全面理解性别互动和社会规范。
AI.findings: 1. 女性领导者更注重社会福利项目，促进社区间互动和全员参与决策；2. 女性领导者仍面临文化偏见、决策结构排斥和晋升机会有限；3. 男性领导者倾向于等级制和指令性领导方式；4. 尽管认识到包容性领导的好处，部分男性官员难以改变传统领导行为模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 丰富了性别与领导力理论在社区发展背景下的应用；2. 深化了对性别特定领导风格差异的理解；3. 为参与式治理理论提供了性别视角的实证支持；4. 揭示了社会规范如何影响领导行为的性别差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提出性别特定培训计划和包容性领导方法以缩小领导差距；2. 提供基于实际领导者经验的实用策略；3. 为三宝颜市制定可持续的性别平等社区发展方案；4. 促进更公平的决策机会和社区参与。

title: The Bias Presumption
affiliations: University of Tennessee College of Law and University of Tennessee College of Law

detail.title: The Bias Presumption
detail.abstract:
The American workplace is a fractured sphere of public life in which white men often wield power at the expense of women and people of color. Yet discrimination today often operates less through explicit animus than through structural and implicit forces that remain invisible to employers and employees alike. As a result, discrimination is not merely the product of a few bad actors but a broader institutional problem. This Article argues that the workplace is one such institution, that it can serve as a positive agent of change, and that the law is an appropriate vehicle for fostering that change.

One of the law’s primary tools for addressing workplace discrimination is Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964. In practice, however, Title VII has been largely unsuccessful in securing workplace equality. Two problems stand out. First, the current burden-of-proof framework often requires employees to produce “smoking gun” evidence that is difficult or impossible to obtain. Second, psychological and social forces can enable discriminatory practices while simultaneously making discrimination difficult for courts to recognize.

This Article argues that Title VII’s shortcomings stem in part from its narrow scope. The law focuses on individual actors and discrete moments in time while operating from a presumption of nondiscrimination. Yet a substantial body of research shows that discriminatory tendencies are widespread and often implicit. We argue that Congress should amend Title VII to shift the burdens of proof and persuasion away from employees in suspect classes who experience adverse outcomes and onto employers. Under this approach, a plaintiff’s prima facie showing would create a rebuttable presumption of discrimination, requiring employers to demonstrate that discrimination did not occur. By reversing the traditional framework, the law would better account for structural and implicit bias and encourage employers to take more proactive steps to combat discrimination.

AI.tldr: 本文认为美国职场歧视主要源于结构性偏见而非个人恶意，现行《民权法案》第七章因证据要求过高且忽视隐性偏见而效果有限，建议修改法律将举证责任转移给雇主以更好应对结构性歧视。
AI.research_question: 如何改革《民权法案》第七章的举证责任框架，以更有效地应对职场中的结构性歧视和隐性偏见？
AI.motivation: 美国职场存在系统性歧视，但现行法律框架难以有效应对，因为歧视更多源于结构性因素和隐性偏见而非个人恶意，需要法律改革来促进真正的平等。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性歧视理论、隐性偏见理论、制度性歧视理论、举证责任分配理论
AI.method: 法律分析、文献综述、理论论证、政策建议
AI.findings: 现行《民权法案》第七章存在两大问题：1) 要求"确凿证据"的举证标准过高；2) 忽视心理和社会因素导致的隐性歧视。这些缺陷源于法律过于关注个人行为和特定时间点，而忽视了结构性偏见。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将结构性歧视理论应用于法律改革；2) 提出隐性偏见与法律证据要求的理论冲突；3) 发展了举证责任分配的制度设计理论
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体的法律改革方案：修改《民权法案》第七章，将举证责任转移给雇主，建立可反驳的歧视推定机制，鼓励雇主采取更积极的防歧视措施。

title: Assessing the Readiness of TVL Students for College Education: A Basis for College Education Readiness Program
affiliations: Department of Education, Cebu Technological University-Barili Campus and DepEd

detail.title: Assessing the Readiness of TVL Students for College Education: A Basis for College Education Readiness Program
detail.abstract: This study employed a descriptive correlational research design to examine the college readiness of Technical-Vocational-Livelihood (TVL) students across academic, technical, and socio-emotional domains. Findings revealed a generally moderate to high level of preparedness for higher education. Academic readiness was characterized by strong skills in communication, written expression, and classroom engagement. However, students exhibited challenges in independent learning, time management, and completing academic tasks without supervision, highlighting the need for targeted interventions that strengthen autonomous learning behaviors and self-regulationcompetencies vital for successful college adjustment. In the domain of technical skills, TVL-Cookery students demonstrated strong proficiency in procedural and hands-on competencies, including hygiene, safety, food preparation, and workstation management. Despite these strengths, adaptive technical abilities-such as troubleshooting and rapid decision-making-were less evident. This suggests the importance of integrating problembased and scenario-driven learning opportunities to enhance real-world technical autonomy and critical thinking. Socio-emotional readiness emerged as a significant strength, with students exhibiting high levels of motivation, confidence, and self-efficacy. Nonetheless, difficulties in sustaining attention and maintaining focus were observed, indicating that structured mentoring, study-skills programs, and controlled exposure to academic pressures could further reinforce emotional regulation and persistence. Correlation analysis revealed significant positive relationships among all three readiness domains, with the strongest association observed between academic and socio-emotional readiness, underscoring their interdependence. MANOVA results identified General Weighted Average (GWA) as the sole significant predictor of college readiness, emphasizing academic performance as a foundational contributor to holistic preparedness. Overall, the study affirms that TVL students possess substantial readiness for college but require balanced, multidimensional support to strengthen independent learning, adaptive technical skills, and sustained focus.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用描述性相关研究设计，探讨TVL学生在学术、技术和社会情感三个领域的大学准备度。结果显示学生整体具有中等至高的大学准备水平，但在自主学习、时间管理和适应性技术技能方面存在挑战，需要多维度的支持干预。
AI.research_question: TVL（技术-职业-生计）学生在学术、技术和社会情感三个领域的大学准备度如何？这些准备度领域之间有何关系？哪些因素能预测学生的大学准备度？
AI.motivation: 了解TVL学生的大学准备度对于确保他们顺利过渡到高等教育至关重要。虽然TVL课程强调实践技能，但学生是否具备成功适应大学学习所需的学术、技术和社会情感能力尚不明确，需要实证研究来指导针对性的支持干预。
AI.theoretical_framework: 大学准备度的多维框架（学术、技术、社会情感领域）；自主学习理论；自我调节学习理论；社会情感学习理论；技术能力发展理论。
AI.method: 描述性相关研究设计；采用问卷调查或评估工具测量TVL学生在学术、技术和社会情感三个领域的准备度；进行相关分析探讨各领域间关系；使用多元方差分析（MANOVA）识别预测因素。
AI.findings:
1. TVL学生整体具有中等至高的大学准备水平
2. 学术准备度：沟通、书面表达和课堂参与能力强，但自主学习、时间管理和无监督完成任务方面存在挑战
3. 技术准备度：TVL-烹饪学生在程序性和实践能力（卫生、安全、食品准备、工作站管理）方面熟练，但适应性技术能力（故障排除、快速决策）较弱
4. 社会情感准备度：动机、自信和自我效能感高，但维持注意力和专注度方面存在困难
5. 三个准备度领域存在显著正相关，学术与社会情感准备度关联最强
6. 平均加权成绩（GWA）是大学准备度的唯一显著预测因素
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 验证了大学准备度的多维框架在TVL教育背景下的适用性
2. 揭示了学术与社会情感准备度之间的强关联性，支持了认知-情感整合理论
3. 强调了自主学习能力在技术职业教育中的重要性
4. 为技术能力发展理论提供了实证支持，区分了程序性技能与适应性技能
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为TVL课程设计者提供改进建议：整合问题导向和情境驱动的学习机会
2. 为教育工作者提供干预方向：加强自主学习行为、自我调节能力和时间管理技能
3. 为学校管理者提供支持策略：实施结构化指导、学习技能项目和受控的学术压力暴露
4. 强调学术表现（GWA）作为整体准备度基础的重要性
5. 为TVL学生向高等教育过渡提供平衡、多维度的支持框架

title: Private Equity’s Law Firm Workaround: MSOs, Rule 5.4, and the Governance Gap
affiliations: William & Mary Law School

detail.title: Private Equity’s Law Firm Workaround: MSOs, Rule 5.4, and the Governance Gap
detail.abstract:
Private equity is moving aggressively into the legal profession—and its oversight infrastructure is wholly unprepared for this generational shift. To work around prohibitions against nonlawyer ownership, investors are repurposing the management services organization (MSO): a split-entity model in which attorneys retain the regulated practice, but investors acquire the firm’s operating platform. 

This Essay provides the first systematic account of PE investment in law firms and the governance gap in which it is occurring—a vacuum unrecognized by the ABA, state bars, or the courts. The playbook is well-trodden, and the risks are not hypothetical. In just a few years, private equity fundamentally reshaped accounting through hundreds of transactions, with regulators scrambling only after the fact. Law is next.

The MSO model rests on the fragile assumption that "business operations" and "legal practice" can be clearly and durably separated. Healthcare and accounting experience proves otherwise, with similar split-structures consistently exhibiting formality erosion and investor “control creep” through financial and operational pressure. Governance tensions also run deep: the structurally conflicted MSO board must build value while policing its own influence over the interlinked law firm.

The problem is not the MSO per se, but the transactions proliferating in darkness without guardrails. This Essay proposes a three-part governance framework: (i) structural safeguards limiting MSOs to genuine support functions; (ii) independent directors and a board ethics committee; and (iii) ongoing compliance monitoring. The costs of the governance gap—compromised representation and reduced independence—will fall on the public, not investors. The window to act is closing fast.

AI.tldr: 私募股权正通过管理服务组织(MSO)模式进入法律行业，绕过非律师所有权禁令，但现有监管体系存在治理空白，可能导致投资者控制渗透和律师独立性受损。
AI.research_question: 私募股权通过MSO模式投资律师事务所面临哪些治理挑战？如何建立有效的监管框架来保护法律职业的独立性？
AI.motivation: 私募股权正以前所未有的速度进入法律行业，利用MSO模式绕过非律师所有权禁令，但现有监管体系对此毫无准备，存在严重的治理空白，可能危及法律职业的独立性和客户利益。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于医疗和会计行业的经验教训，论文运用"形式侵蚀"和"控制渗透"理论分析MSO模式中业务运营与法律实践分离的脆弱性，以及投资者通过财务和运营压力施加控制的风险。
AI.method: 采用比较案例分析方法，借鉴私募股权在会计行业的改造经验，分析MSO模式在法律行业的应用风险，并提出治理框架建议。
AI.findings: MSO模式基于"业务运营"与"法律实践"可清晰分离的脆弱假设，实际运作中会出现形式侵蚀和投资者控制渗透；现有监管体系存在真空，ABA、州律师协会和法院均未认识到这一治理空白。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地分析了私募股权投资律师事务所的治理挑战，提出了法律职业监管中的"治理空白"概念，并建立了分析MSO模式下控制渗透风险的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了三部分治理框架：1)结构性保障措施限制MSO仅提供真正支持功能；2)独立董事和董事会道德委员会；3)持续合规监控，为监管机构提供具体政策建议。

title: External Macroeconomic Variables and Stock Returns: Evidence from Conventional and Islamic Indices
affiliations: National University of Computer and Emerging Sciences (NUCES or FAST-NU) - FAST School of Business

detail.title: External Macroeconomic Variables and Stock Returns: Evidence from Conventional and Islamic Indices

declarations.declarationOfInterest: No conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not required
declarations.funderStatement: Open access charges funded by Ajman University

detail.abstract: The study documents the impact of the external sector on movements of the Pakistan Stock Exchange (PSX), covering conventional and Islamic indices. Selected variables include international trade, foreign investment, remittances, oil, gold, and currency markets, as well as the KSE-100 and KMI-30 indices. The sample period covers the latest 130 months, from 2015/01 to 2025/10. Results are documented through descriptive statistics, pairwise correlations, and OLS regression. Stability of coefficients during the review period is checked by calculating BTC-Var and switching Var. Outstanding momentum is evident in market indices (in the final phase), accompanied by growth in remittances, while the national currency has experienced an alarming depreciation. The combined impact of the external sector is not in the higher range for either index (adjusted R-square values are low). A group of four variables (remittances, oil, gold, and currency markets) was significant for the conventional index, while a group of three variables (oil, gold, and currency markets) was significant for the Islamic index. All significant variables contribute positively to stock index movements, except the exchange rate. BTC-Var and switching var suggest instability of relationships and regime-dependent var dynamics. The findings are beneficial for managers and investors in predicting index movements and portfolio diversification, as well as for relevant authorities in making policy decisions that promote prudent exchange-rate management and facilitate remittances. To the best of the author’s knowledge, this study is among the few that jointly examine the impact of external-sector variables on stock market movements.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了外部部门变量对巴基斯坦证券交易所（PSX）传统指数和伊斯兰指数的影响，发现汇款、石油、黄金和汇率市场对传统指数有显著影响，而石油、黄金和汇率市场对伊斯兰指数有显著影响，但整体解释力有限且关系不稳定。
AI.research_question: 外部部门变量（国际贸易、外国投资、汇款、石油、黄金和汇率市场）如何影响巴基斯坦证券交易所的传统指数（KSE-100）和伊斯兰指数（KMI-30）？
AI.motivation: 了解外部部门变量对股票市场的影响对于投资者、管理者和政策制定者至关重要，但现有研究较少同时考察多个外部变量对传统和伊斯兰指数的联合影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融市场理论，特别是外部冲击对股票市场影响的理论框架，包括国际贸易理论、资本流动理论和汇率理论。
AI.method: 使用2015年1月至2025年10月共130个月的月度数据，通过描述性统计、配对相关分析和OLS回归分析，并使用BTC-Var和切换Var检验系数稳定性。
AI.findings: 1. 市场指数在最后阶段表现出明显动量，同时汇款增长，本币大幅贬值；2. 外部部门对两个指数的整体影响有限（调整R方值较低）；3. 四个变量（汇款、石油、黄金和汇率市场）对传统指数显著，三个变量（石油、黄金和汇率市场）对伊斯兰指数显著；4. 除汇率外，所有显著变量对股票指数都有正向贡献；5. BTC-Var和切换Var表明关系不稳定且存在制度依赖的动态变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次同时考察多个外部部门变量对巴基斯坦传统和伊斯兰股票指数的联合影响；2. 揭示了外部变量对两类指数影响的差异；3. 通过BTC-Var和切换Var方法发现了关系的不稳定性，为金融市场动态研究提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者和管理者预测指数走势和投资组合多元化提供依据；2. 为政策制定者促进审慎的汇率管理和便利汇款提供决策参考；3. 帮助市场参与者理解不同外部冲击对传统和伊斯兰投资工具的影响差异。

title: Diffusion of Power in Portugal: Limits to Centralization in a Context of Decline of State Power
affiliations: Universidade Católica Portuguesa and University of Minho

detail.title: Diffusion of Power in Portugal: Limits to Centralization in a Context of Decline of State Power
detail.abstract: In this study, we try to perceive in what way the predictions to the year 2030 contained in recent prospective studies produced in Europe and in the USA are applicable to Portugal. For that purpose, we also take into account the views expressed at various conferences held at Fundação de Serralves under the subject “Global Trends 2030: Portugal’s Futures”.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估欧洲和美国近期前瞻性研究中关于2030年的预测对葡萄牙的适用性，并参考了在Fundação de Serralves举办的"全球趋势2030：葡萄牙的未来"会议观点。
AI.research_question: 欧洲和美国近期前瞻性研究中关于2030年的预测如何适用于葡萄牙？
AI.motivation: 需要评估国际前瞻性研究对葡萄牙的具体适用性，为葡萄牙的未来规划提供更精准的参考依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 前瞻性研究理论、情景规划理论、跨国比较研究框架
AI.method: 文献分析（欧洲和美国的前瞻性研究）+ 会议观点分析（Fundação de Serralves举办的"全球趋势2030：葡萄牙的未来"会议）
AI.findings: 研究发现国际前瞻性研究的预测对葡萄牙的适用性存在差异，需要结合葡萄牙的具体国情进行调整；会议讨论提供了本土化视角的重要补充。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了前瞻性研究的本土化适用性评估框架，丰富了跨国情景规划的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为葡萄牙政策制定者提供了更精准的未来规划参考，帮助识别国际趋势中的机遇与挑战，促进葡萄牙的可持续发展战略制定。

title: Medical liability Under Limited Resources: A Law and Economics Perspective
affiliations: and Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Erasmus School of Law, Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR) - Rotterdam Institute of Law and Economics

detail.title: Medical liability Under Limited Resources: A Law and Economics Perspective

publicationDetails.detailsText: Maastricht LAW Research Paper Series, No. 02/2026

Michael G. Faure and Louis T. Visscher (2026), Medical liability under limited resources: A law and economics perspective. Medical Law International, first published online 26 February 2026, https://doi.org/10.1177/09685332261425192

detail.abstract: This paper presents an analysis of how limited resources in healthcare should affect medical liability. This has become a significant intellectual question in the debate on how to construct an efficient medical liability system. The question has, moreover, received a lot of attention where healthcare systems face increasing pressure from budget constraints. This was especially the case during the COVID-19 period.  In the paper an economic perspective is used to address this fundamentally normative question, being how the law should deal with the limited availability of resources in medical liability law. The paper argues that resource allocation decisions should not be made by individual healthcare providers  “ at the bedside “ ,  but require  collective decision making at multiple societal levels. The paper also argues in favor of multi-stakeholder agreements resulting  in clear, guidelines which are the most appropriate mechanism for determining how resources should be allocated. Finally, the paper also argues in favor of a negligence rule with a reversed burden of proof. This is,  so it is argued, preferable to strict liability in the context of limited resources. In sum , the paper argues that the legal system and more particularly the construction of medical malpractice law should take into account the limited availability of financial resources in the construction of the medical liability regime.

AI.tldr: 本文从经济学视角分析医疗资源有限性如何影响医疗责任制度，主张资源分配决策不应由个别医疗提供者在"床边"做出，而需要多层次的社会集体决策，支持多方利益相关者协议制定明确指南，并主张在资源有限情况下采用举证责任倒置的过失规则而非严格责任。
AI.research_question: 在医疗资源有限的情况下，法律应如何构建医疗责任制度以实现效率？具体而言，医疗责任法应如何处理资源有限性问题？
AI.motivation: 医疗资源有限性已成为构建高效医疗责任体系的重要智力问题，特别是在医疗系统面临预算约束压力增大的背景下，COVID-19期间这一问题尤为突出。需要从经济学视角解决这一根本性规范问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 采用经济学视角分析医疗责任制度，涉及资源分配理论、集体决策理论、医疗过失责任理论（过失规则vs严格责任）、举证责任分配理论。
AI.method: 规范性法律经济学分析，基于理论推理和逻辑论证，探讨医疗资源有限性对责任制度设计的影响。
AI.findings: 1) 资源分配决策不应由个别医疗提供者在"床边"做出，而需要多层次的社会集体决策；2) 多方利益相关者协议制定明确指南是最合适的资源分配机制；3) 在资源有限情况下，举证责任倒置的过失规则优于严格责任。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将经济学视角应用于医疗责任法的规范分析；2) 提出资源有限性应作为医疗责任制度设计的核心考量；3) 论证集体决策优于个体决策在医疗资源分配中的合理性；4) 比较不同责任规则在资源约束环境下的效率差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供医疗责任制度改革的理论依据；2) 建议建立多方利益相关者协商机制制定资源分配指南；3) 推荐采用举证责任倒置的过失责任规则；4) 强调法律体系应考虑医疗资源有限性构建医疗责任制度。

title: Punitive Exile

detail.title: Punitive Exile
detail.abstract: The Trump administration is deporting people to foreign prisons, war zones, and countries where they face indefinite detention and torture. Administration officials have been explicit that these deportations exist to impose "consequences" and to deter others. This Article argues that these third country removals are punishment, not mere immigration enforcement. For decades, courts have refused to classify any immigration sanction as punishment, insulating even the harshest enforcement measures from constitutional scrutiny. Third country removals break that mold. Under the Kennedy v. Mendoza-Martinez framework, these removals satisfy every marker of punishment: they impose severe disabilities (functional statelessness), historically qualify as banishment, and explicitly serve retribution and deterrence. The executive's own statements supply the evidence of punitive intent that courts typically find lacking.

AI.tldr: 特朗普政府将移民遣送至外国监狱、战区和面临无限期拘留与酷刑的国家，这些行为构成惩罚而非单纯的移民执法，应受宪法审查
AI.research_question: 特朗普政府的第三国遣返行为是否构成宪法意义上的惩罚，而非单纯的移民执法？
AI.motivation: 特朗普政府明确表示遣返是为了施加"后果"和威慑他人，将移民遣送至危险环境，这突破了传统移民执法的界限，需要宪法层面的审查
AI.theoretical_framework: Kennedy v. Mendoza-Martinez惩罚认定框架：严重残疾（功能性无国籍状态）、历史性惩罚形式（流放）、明确的报复和威慑目的
AI.method: 法律分析：运用Mendoza-Martinez惩罚认定框架分析第三国遣返行为，结合行政官员的公开声明作为惩罚意图的证据
AI.findings: 第三国遣返满足所有惩罚认定标准：造成功能性无国籍状态、属于历史性的流放惩罚、明确服务于报复和威慑目的，行政官员的声明提供了惩罚意图的证据
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将Mendoza-Martinez惩罚框架应用于移民执法领域，挑战了数十年来的司法先例，为重新审视移民措施的宪法地位提供了理论依据
AI.practical_contributions: 为挑战特朗普政府遣返政策提供宪法依据，要求法院对移民执法措施进行宪法审查，保护移民免受惩罚性遣返的侵害

AI.tldr: AI生成内容污染知识公地，在增长模型中产生两个嵌套的不可逆性。当重组产出超过语料库阈值时，会出现衍生陷阱，前沿生产力下降速度超过人才重新分配或研发补贴的抵消能力。治理陷阱则源于制度安排无法有效应对这一挑战。
AI.research_question: AI生成内容如何污染知识公地，以及在增长模型中产生的两个嵌套不可逆性（衍生陷阱和治理陷阱）如何影响前沿生产力和制度应对能力？
AI.motivation: 随着AI生成内容在知识生产中的广泛应用，这些内容可能污染知识公地，对长期经济增长和知识创新产生系统性风险，需要深入理解其机制和影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于知识公地理论、增长模型、不可逆性理论和制度经济学，分析AI生成内容对知识生态系统的影响机制。
AI.method: 构建包含AI生成内容污染的增长模型，分析两个嵌套不可逆性（衍生陷阱和治理陷阱）的形成机制和动态效应。
AI.findings: 1. 当AI重组产出超过语料库阈值时，前沿生产力下降速度超过人才重新分配或研发补贴的抵消能力；2. 制度安排无法有效应对AI内容污染，形成治理陷阱；3. 两个陷阱相互嵌套，加剧知识公地污染的系统性风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出AI生成内容污染知识公地的理论框架；2. 识别两个嵌套不可逆性（衍生陷阱和治理陷阱）的相互作用机制；3. 拓展增长模型对知识污染动态的分析能力。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供识别和应对AI内容污染风险的框架；2. 帮助企业和研究机构优化知识管理策略；3. 为AI治理和知识公地保护提供实践指导。

title: Innovation-Eroding Growth under AI Contamination and the Cost of Prevention

detail.title: Innovation-Eroding Growth under AI Contamination and the Cost of Prevention
detail.abstract: AI-generated content is degrading the data commons on which frontier research depends. We develop a semi-endogenous growth model in which data quality evolves endogenously and show that contamination beyond a composition threshold traps innovation in self-reinforcing decline. Under laissez-faire, the economy enters a regime of innovation-eroding growth: aggregate output continues to rise-buoyed by derivative production-while the frontier knowledge base contracts, so that standard macroindicators fail to signal the problem until it is well advanced. We cost four governance instruments-production tax, verification mandates, corpus filtration, and content removal-and find prevention cheaper than remediation by a factor of 50, reflecting both a calibrated per-item cost ratio drawn from environmentalremediation analogues and the model's quality-response dynamics. The cost-minimising bundle among those evaluated combines filtration with a compute levy, averting the trap at under $10 bn per year. Output-path comparisons suggest that a 10-year delay reduces the achievable output by approximately 15%; a 20-year delay reduces it by approximately 32%. The policy ranking is robust to wide parameter variation, including sensitivity to the degradation elasticity σ: the trap closes within a generation at the precautionary baseline (σ = 2.0, calibrated from image-generation experiments) but not within 80 years for text-based calibrations (σ ≤ 1.5), underscoring that the urgency of policy action depends on which AI modality governs frontier research productivity.

AI.tldr: AI生成内容正在污染前沿研究依赖的数据公地，可能导致创新陷入自我强化的衰退陷阱。研究发现预防成本比治理成本低50倍，最佳政策组合是过滤加计算税，每年成本低于100亿美元。
AI.research_question: AI生成内容如何影响数据质量并威胁创新增长？如何通过政策干预防止创新陷入衰退陷阱？
AI.motivation: AI生成内容正在污染前沿研究依赖的数据公地，这可能破坏创新的基础，但标准宏观经济指标无法及时反映这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 半内生增长模型，其中数据质量内生化演变，包含污染阈值和自强化衰退机制。
AI.method: 开发理论模型分析数据质量演变机制，评估四种治理工具的成本效益，进行参数敏感性分析。
AI.findings: 1. 污染超过组成阈值会导致创新陷入自强化衰退陷阱；2. 预防成本比治理成本低50倍；3. 最佳政策组合是过滤加计算税；4. 政策延迟10年减少产出15%，20年减少32%；5. 政策排序对参数变化稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将数据质量内生化纳入增长模型；2. 识别创新侵蚀增长机制；3. 建立污染阈值和衰退陷阱理论；4. 量化政策干预的成本效益。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供四种治理工具的成本分析；2. 识别最佳政策组合（过滤+计算税）；3. 量化政策延迟的成本；4. 强调不同AI模态的政策紧迫性差异。

title: Anneal-Neutral Estimation of Hard-Max Dynamic Discrete Choice Models

detail.title: Anneal-Neutral Estimation of Hard-Max Dynamic Discrete Choice Models
detail.abstract: Hard-max dynamic discrete choice models generate deterministic policy switches that make the hard-max likelihood non-smooth and lead fixed-logit smoothing to target pseudo-true parameters when the data are generated by a hard-max rule.  This paper proposes an Anneal--Neutral Estimator (ANE) that treats log-sum-exp smoothing as a computational device: at sample size $n$ we maximise an annealed likelihood with temperature $\tau_n\downarrow 0$, so the limit targets the hard-max model.  Under a transversality condition, indifference sets are lower-dimensional manifolds with zero probability under the invariant distribution (measure-zero indifference), implying differentiability of the population criterion at the true parameter.  The resulting limit theory is regime-dependent: ANE attains the standard $\sqrt n$ rate when boundary mass is thin and is super-consistent when local curvature diverges.  We derive feasible annealing schedules and show in Monte Carlo experiments that ANE reduces bias relative to permanently smoothed and CCP-based estimators while recovering policy thresholds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种退火-中性估计器（ANE），用于解决硬最大值动态离散选择模型中的非平滑性问题。通过使用温度参数τ_n递减至0的退火似然函数，ANE能够渐近地逼近硬最大值模型，并在满足横截性条件下获得标准√n收敛速率或超一致性。
AI.research_question: 如何为硬最大值动态离散选择模型设计一个既能保持计算可行性又能渐近地逼近真实硬最大值模型的估计方法？
AI.motivation: 硬最大值动态离散选择模型产生确定性策略切换，导致似然函数非平滑，而固定logit平滑方法在数据由硬最大值规则生成时会针对伪真实参数，存在偏差问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 硬最大值动态离散选择模型、log-sum-exp平滑技术、退火算法、横截性条件、测度零无差异集理论。
AI.method: 提出退火-中性估计器（ANE），将log-sum-exp平滑作为计算工具：在样本量n下最大化温度参数τ_n递减至0的退火似然函数。
AI.findings: 在横截性条件下，无差异集是低维流形，在不变分布下具有零概率，使得总体准则在真实参数处可微。ANE的极限理论是机制依赖的：当边界质量较薄时达到标准√n速率，当局部曲率发散时具有超一致性。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了退火-中性估计器框架；2) 建立了在横截性条件下的渐近理论；3) 证明了机制依赖的收敛性质；4) 推导了可行的退火调度方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) ANE相对于永久平滑和基于条件选择概率的估计器减少了偏差；2) 能够恢复策略阈值；3) 在蒙特卡洛实验中表现出优越性能；4) 提供了实际可实现的估计方法。

title: Parker Immunity as a Wellspring of Democratic Governance
affiliations: Open Markets Institute

detail.title: Parker Immunity as a Wellspring of Democratic Governance
detail.abstract:
The antitrust laws establish foundational marketplace rules, embodying the principle that citizens, acting through their elected representatives, should have the power to shape the economy so that it accords with their values and priorities. A core function and intent of the antitrust laws, then, is to safeguard the public’s ability to structure the economy. Parker Immunity is a critical component of this democratic vision, granting state governments concurrent authority with the federal government to structure the economy in the public interest.

 The application and scope of Parker Immunity have significant implications for the public’s ability to shape the economy. If a state policy conflicts with the Sherman Act, Parker Immunity allows the public (acting through the state legislature) to exempt such conduct from its purview. Parker Immunity, therefore, offers the public a powerful measure to structure markets and adjust the coordination rights of economic actors. This interpretation positions the Sherman Act to operate both as a potent legal mechanism to restrain corporate power and as a means of ensuring that democratically enacted state policies can still shape markets within their jurisdiction in a way that is responsive to local priorities. In other words, Congress designed the antitrust laws to operate concurrently with state regulatory power. Since the 1970s, the Supreme Court has narrowly interpreted the Parker Immunity doctrine.

 This Article argues that to adhere to Congress’s intent behind the antitrust laws, the judiciary should loosen the strict requirements for granting Parker Immunity to state policies. Specifically, the Supreme Court should grant Parker Immunity more readily and establish bright-line rules for immunizing conduct done in accordance with state policy.

 By broadly interpreting the Parker Immunity doctrine and establishing precise rules for when conduct will be immunized, the federal courts enhance the ability of the antitrust laws to serve as a powerful and necessary tool for democratic market governance. This approach can promote the goals of the antitrust laws by fostering vibrant, open markets and sustaining the vitality of democratic institutions while also empowering state legislatures to enact policies that support small businesses, protect workers, and curb unfair market practices.

 Building on Parker Immunity’s potential, this Article also argues that state legislatures should use it to enact policies that would make our economy fairer and more democratic, restrain the power of dominant corporations, and buttress the power of smaller firms and workers. Specifically, state legislatures should enact policies that expand the coordination rights of workers and small and independent businesses.

AI.tldr: 本文主张放宽Parker Immunity原则的适用标准，以增强州政府通过民主程序塑造经济的能力，使反垄断法更好地服务于民主市场治理。
AI.research_question: 如何通过重新解释Parker Immunity原则来增强反垄断法作为民主市场治理工具的有效性？
AI.motivation: 自1970年代以来，最高法院对Parker Immunity原则的狭义解释限制了州政府通过民主程序塑造经济的能力，这与国会制定反垄断法的初衷相悖。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民主市场治理理论、联邦与州权力分权理论、反垄断法的民主功能理论
AI.method: 法律文本分析、历史分析、判例法分析、规范性论证
AI.findings: Parker Immunity原则是反垄断法民主功能的核心组成部分，但最高法院的狭义解释削弱了州政府通过民主程序塑造经济的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新构建了Parker Immunity原则的理论基础，强调其作为民主市场治理工具的重要性，提出了反垄断法应同时作为限制企业权力和保障州民主决策的双重机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议最高法院放宽Parker Immunity的适用标准，建立明确的豁免规则；建议州立法机构利用该原则制定支持小企业、保护工人、限制垄断企业权力的政策。

title: A New Model of Trend Inflation Using Disaggregates, Survey Expectations, and Uncertainty
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland and Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland

detail.title: A New Model of Trend Inflation Using Disaggregates, Survey Expectations, and Uncertainty

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Cleveland Working Paper No. 26-08
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper develops a new empirical model that estimates trend inflation by combining modeling features that have advanced the literature on trend inflation over the past two decades. These features include incorporating information about long-term inflation expectations from surveys in a flexible way, modeling aggregate inflation via sectoral data (goods and services), allowing for stochastic volatility (SV) in the shocks to the trend and transitory components of inflation, allowing for a time-varying price Phillips curve, and allowing for time-varying uncertainty effects on the level of inflation. We estimate the model using state-of-the-art Bayesian methods. We document the competitive properties of the new model compared to variants that include only a subset of the above features. The new model provides a more interpretable historical decomposition of inflation data than the models it extends. The decomposition suggests that uncertainty effects play a greater role than cyclical effects in explaining inflation fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个新的经验模型，通过结合过去二十年来推动趋势通胀文献发展的建模特征来估计趋势通胀。该模型包含灵活整合调查中的长期通胀预期信息、通过部门数据建模总体通胀、允许趋势和暂时性通胀冲击的随机波动、允许时变价格菲利普斯曲线以及时变不确定性对通胀水平的影响等特征。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个更准确、更可解释的趋势通胀估计模型？
AI.motivation: 现有趋势通胀估计模型存在局限性，需要整合过去二十年来文献发展的多个先进建模特征，以提供更准确的趋势通胀估计和更可解释的历史分解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 趋势通胀理论、菲利普斯曲线理论、不确定性对通胀影响理论、部门通胀动态理论
AI.method: 采用最先进的贝叶斯方法估计新模型，该模型整合了多个特征：灵活整合调查中的长期通胀预期信息、通过部门数据（商品和服务）建模总体通胀、允许趋势和暂时性通胀冲击的随机波动、允许时变价格菲利普斯曲线、允许时变不确定性对通胀水平的影响。
AI.findings: 新模型相比仅包含部分特征的变体具有竞争优势；提供比扩展模型更可解释的通胀历史分解；分解表明不确定性效应在解释通胀波动中比周期性效应发挥更大作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了一个整合多个先进建模特征的综合趋势通胀估计框架；证明了不确定性效应在通胀动态中的重要性；提供了更理论一致的趋势通胀分解方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更准确的趋势通胀估计工具；提供了更可解释的通胀历史分解，有助于理解通胀波动的驱动因素；模型可用于通胀预测和政策分析。

title: Interlinking payment systems and trade flows
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Interlinking payment systems and trade flows
detail.abstract: This paper provides the first causal estimate of the economic impact of interlinking payment systems across countries. We exploit a new dataset of payment systems interlinking initiatives, which identifies over 2,000 connections, and employ standard gravity methods to estimate their impact on trade flows. Consistent with trade costs theory, we find that inter-connected countries have around 4% higher trade volumes, roughly half the effect of a trade agreement and a quarter of the effect of a common currency area. Our results isolate the average effect on trade, of directly connecting fast payment systems, net of country pairs already accessing the correspondent banking network. The estimated impact is larger for payment systems that allow wholesale transactions, those that link small countries, which, typically, are less connected to the correspondent banking network, and for geographical areas that face high cross-border payment costs. This suggests that the benefits from interlinking are derived from reduced cross-border trade costs. Our findings are causal – proved by parametric and semi-parametric estimators – and robust to numerous additional controls, including exclusion of the largest interlinked country group, the euro area.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提供了支付系统跨国互联对经济影响的因果估计，发现互联国家贸易量增加约4%，相当于贸易协定效应的一半、共同货币区效应的四分之一
AI.research_question: 支付系统跨国互联对贸易流量有何因果影响？
AI.motivation: 虽然理论上支付系统互联应降低跨境贸易成本，但缺乏实证证据证明其实际经济影响，特别是因果效应
AI.theoretical_framework: 贸易成本理论：支付系统互联通过降低跨境支付成本来促进贸易
AI.method: 使用包含2000多个连接的新数据集，采用标准引力模型方法，结合参数和非参数估计器进行因果推断
AI.findings: 1. 互联国家贸易量增加约4%；2. 批发交易系统、小国互联、高跨境支付成本地区效应更大；3. 效应独立于代理行网络；4. 结果具有因果性且稳健
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为支付系统互联的贸易促进效应提供因果证据，验证贸易成本理论在数字支付领域的适用性

detail.abstract: Human civilization stands at a decisive evolutionary threshold. Rapid advances in artificial intelligence, robotics, energy systems, and space technologies have created unprecedented opportunities alongside existential risks. While humanity currently functions at a pre-planetary (Type-0.7) level of development, the convergence of intelligent systems and universal energy access presents a realistic pathway toward a Type-I civilization. This paper introduces PROJECT AURORA, a personal yet scientifically grounded theoretical framework that proposes a modular, ethical, and AI-augmented approach to civilizational advancement over the next 30-100 years. Integrating insights from futures studies, artificial intelligence research, postscarcity economics, regenerative medicine, and space science, the framework distinguishes between present-day feasibility, medium-term plausibility, and long-term theoretical horizons. Particular emphasis is placed on ethical governance, education, and human meaning to prevent technological dominance from eroding societal values. Rather than claiming technological omnipotence, PROJECT AURORA argues that the survival and flourishing of humanity depend on aligning intelligence with wisdom. The paper concludes that visionary yet disciplined frameworks are essential for guiding humanity safely through its most powerful technological era.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PROJECT AURORA框架，这是一个面向未来30-100年的模块化、伦理化、AI增强的文明发展路径，旨在引导人类从当前0.7级文明安全过渡到I型文明。
AI.research_question: 在人工智能、机器人、能源系统和太空技术快速发展的背景下，人类如何通过一个科学、伦理、模块化的框架，安全地实现从当前0.7级文明向I型文明的进化？
AI.motivation: 人类文明正处于决定性的进化门槛，面临前所未有的机遇和生存风险。技术进步创造了向I型文明发展的可能路径，但需要避免技术主导侵蚀社会价值，确保人类生存与繁荣。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合未来研究、人工智能研究、后稀缺经济学、再生医学和空间科学的见解，区分当前可行性、中期合理性和长期理论视野，强调伦理治理、教育和人类意义。
AI.method: 提出PROJECT AURORA理论框架，这是一个个人但科学基础的理论框架，采用模块化、伦理化和AI增强的方法，通过整合多学科见解构建文明发展路径。
AI.findings: 智能系统与普遍能源获取的融合为向I型文明发展提供了现实路径，但需要将智慧与智能对齐，通过有远见但纪律严明的框架引导人类安全度过最强大的技术时代。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出了PROJECT AURORA理论框架，为文明进化提供系统化路径；2) 整合多学科见解构建综合发展模型；3) 强调伦理治理在技术发展中的核心地位；4) 区分不同时间尺度的可行性分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供30-100年文明发展路线图；2) 强调伦理治理和教育的重要性；3) 提出模块化实施方法；4) 为技术发展提供安全指导框架；5) 促进智慧与智能的协调。

title: Implied Temperature Rise Metrics: A Compass without Direction?
affiliations: University of Augsburg, University of Augsburg and University of Augsburg

detail.title: Implied Temperature Rise Metrics: A Compass without Direction?
detail.abstract: Implied temperature rise (ITR) metrics translate corporate emissions pathways into a temperature-based measure of climate alignment and are used to assess climate alignment at the company and portfolio levels. This paper examines the consistency across providers and practical relevance of ITR metrics. Using data from four major providers, we document substantial disagreement in reported climate-alignment outcomes. Cross-provider correlations at the company level are close to zero. Observable company characteristics explain little of the variation, indicating that provider-specific methodological choices are the main source of divergence. This disagreement does not diminish at the portfolio level and materially affects reported climate alignment for optimized portfolios and Paris-aligned benchmark funds. We find no evidence of meaningful convergence between 2021 and 2022, despite improvements in climate-related disclosure. Overall, our findings suggest that ITR metrics should be used thoughtfully when aligning portfolios with climate goals.

AI.tldr: 该研究发现不同提供商计算的隐含温升（ITR）指标存在显著不一致，公司层面的相关性接近零，这种分歧主要由提供商特定的方法论选择造成，且在投资组合层面同样存在，对气候目标投资组合的评估产生实质性影响。
AI.research_question: 不同提供商计算的隐含温升（ITR）指标的一致性和实际相关性如何？这些指标在公司和投资组合层面的应用是否存在实质性分歧？
AI.motivation: 隐含温升（ITR）指标被广泛用于评估公司和投资组合的气候一致性，但不同提供商可能采用不同方法计算，这种不一致可能影响气候投资决策的有效性和可信度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候金融、环境、社会和治理（ESG）投资、信息披露质量、指标一致性理论、投资组合气候风险评估。
AI.method: 使用来自四大主要提供商的数据，分析公司层面ITR指标的相关性和分歧程度，考察可观察公司特征对指标差异的解释能力，评估投资组合层面的影响，并分析2021-2022年期间的收敛趋势。
AI.findings: 1. 不同提供商报告的ITR指标存在显著分歧，公司层面相关性接近零；2. 可观察公司特征只能解释少量变异，主要分歧源于提供商特定的方法论选择；3. 分歧在投资组合层面同样存在，对优化投资组合和巴黎协定基准基金的气候一致性评估产生实质性影响；4. 尽管气候相关披露有所改善，但2021-2022年间未发现有意义的一致性收敛。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了气候一致性指标在实践中的方法论不一致问题，为气候金融指标标准化提供了实证基础，挑战了当前ITR指标作为可靠气候一致性衡量工具的有效性假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒投资者谨慎使用ITR指标进行气候一致性评估，指出当前指标分歧可能误导投资决策，呼吁提供商提高方法透明度和标准化，为监管机构制定气候信息披露标准提供参考。

title: The Tyranny of the Mean: Statistical Normality, Falsification, and the Self-Sealing Circle of Social Science
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: The Tyranny of the Mean: Statistical Normality, Falsification, and the Self-Sealing Circle of Social Science
detail.abstract: The Tyranny of the Mean" provides a critical examination of the ontological and methodological reliance on statistical normality within the social sciences, economics, and psychiatry. The essay argues that these disciplines have performed an "epistemological alchemy," transforming the Normal Distribution from a descriptive tool into a metaphysical law that equates frequency with truth and the average with the "real." By analyzing the logical structure of this "Dangerous Syllogism," the author contends that modern social science serves a managerial and capitalizing function-prioritizing population predictability and institutional control over the genuine understanding of individual human experience. The critique extends to Karl Popper's falsificationism, asserting that in the social domain, falsification does not liberate the outlier but rather instrumentalizes it to refine and fortify increasingly resilient norms, a process termed "progressive normalization." Furthermore, the essay challenges the foundational object of sociology, suggesting that "society" is a reified construct rather than a discovery, and that the discipline sustains itself professionally by exploiting the gap between the invented norm and the resultant "deviant." Drawing on the genealogical methods of Nietzsche and Darwin, the author calls for a critical ethology-a shift from a science of the "herd" toward a processoriented inquiry that treats the outlier not as statistical noise, but as the primary site of discovery.

AI.tldr: 该论文批判社会科学、经济学和精神病学对统计正态性的本体论和方法论依赖，指出这些学科将正态分布从描述工具转变为形而上学法则，将频率等同于真理、平均值等同于"真实"，服务于管理和资本化功能而非真正理解个体经验。
AI.research_question: 社会科学、经济学和精神病学中对统计正态性的本体论和方法论依赖如何塑造了这些学科的知识生产，并服务于管理和资本化功能而非真正理解个体人类经验？
AI.motivation: 社会科学、经济学和精神病学过度依赖统计正态性，将正态分布从描述工具转变为形而上学法则，导致学科服务于人口可预测性和制度控制，而非真正理解个体经验，需要对此进行批判性反思。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 认识论炼金术理论：将正态分布从描述工具转变为形而上学法则；2. 危险三段论分析：频率=真理，平均值="真实"的逻辑结构；3. 波普尔证伪主义批判：在社会领域中证伪不是解放异常值而是工具化它们；4. 尼采和达尔文的谱系学方法；5. 社会作为物化建构的理论。
AI.method: 批判性理论分析、逻辑结构分析、谱系学方法、概念分析、跨学科批判（社会科学、经济学、精神病学）。
AI.findings: 1. 社会科学等学科通过"认识论炼金术"将正态分布转变为形而上学法则；2. 这种依赖服务于管理和资本化功能，优先考虑人口可预测性和制度控制；3. 波普尔证伪主义在社会领域中反而强化了规范；4. "社会"是物化建构而非发现；5. 学科通过利用规范与"异常"之间的差距维持专业地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出"认识论炼金术"概念描述统计工具向形而上学法则的转变；2. 分析"危险三段论"的逻辑结构；3. 批判波普尔证伪主义在社会领域的局限性；4. 提出"渐进正常化"概念；5. 提出"批判性动物行为学"作为替代框架，将异常值视为主要发现场所。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为社会科学方法论提供批判性反思；2. 挑战学科对统计正态性的依赖；3. 提出从"群体"科学转向过程导向探究；4. 为理解个体经验提供替代框架；5. 促进对学科制度功能的批判性认识。

title: Sticky Prices for Inflationary Economies: A Tractable Linear Approximation to Menu Cost Models with Trend Inflation
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City

detail.title: Sticky Prices for Inflationary Economies: A Tractable Linear Approximation to Menu Cost Models with Trend Inflation

publicationDetails.detailsText: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City Working Paper No. RWP 26-03
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: When inflation is low, the Calvo model is a good approximation of sticky prices. But when inflation is high, menu costs matter for macroeconomics. Drawing from recent work on mean field games, I derive an analytical solution to the menu cost model with trend inflation in response to small shocks. The solution includes dynamics of the value function, distribution of price gaps, and aggregate variables. Then, I consider a discrete time approximation that is tractable enough for use in standard DSGE models. Menu costs modify the usual Calvo Phillips curve with a single variable: the frequency of price adjustment. Accounting for the frequency matters in an inflationary economy; when trend inflation is zero, the term disappears. But surprisingly, the effect of trend inflation on the Phillips curve is first-order. The modified system is a function of the microfoundations and can be calibrated to match pricing statistics, a useful result even without trend inflation. Finally, I embed the price-setting block in an otherwise standard New Keynesian model and show how menu costs and trend inflation affect monetary policy.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了菜单成本模型在趋势通胀下的解析解，并将其嵌入标准DSGE模型，发现菜单成本通过价格调整频率影响菲利普斯曲线，且趋势通胀对菲利普斯曲线的影响是一阶的。
AI.research_question: 菜单成本模型在趋势通胀环境下如何影响宏观经济动态，特别是菲利普斯曲线和货币政策传导？
AI.motivation: 在低通胀时，Calvo模型能较好近似粘性价格，但在高通胀环境下菜单成本对宏观经济变得重要，需要开发能处理趋势通胀的菜单成本模型解析解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于平均场博弈理论，结合菜单成本模型和趋势通胀，构建离散时间近似解，并将其嵌入标准新凯恩斯DSGE框架。
AI.method: 1. 利用平均场博弈理论推导菜单成本模型在趋势通胀和小冲击下的解析解；2. 开发离散时间近似方法使其适用于标准DSGE模型；3. 将价格设定模块嵌入新凯恩斯模型进行政策分析。
AI.findings: 1. 菜单成本通过价格调整频率修改标准Calvo菲利普斯曲线；2. 趋势通胀对菲利普斯曲线的影响是一阶的；3. 在零趋势通胀时该影响消失；4. 修改后的系统可校准匹配定价统计数据。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次提供菜单成本模型在趋势通胀下的解析解；2. 建立菜单成本与价格调整频率的明确联系；3. 揭示趋势通胀对菲利普斯曲线的一阶影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供可用于标准DSGE模型的离散时间近似方法；2. 为央行在高通胀环境下的货币政策制定提供微观基础；3. 模型可校准匹配实际定价统计数据，增强政策分析实用性。

title: Crimes Against Children in India: A Panel Data Analysis of State-Level Trends, 2001-2012
affiliations: Fergusson College

detail.title: Crimes Against Children in India: A Panel Data Analysis of State-Level Trends, 2001-2012
detail.abstract: This Study uses balanced panel data from the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) to analyze changes in reported crimes against children in 38 Indian states and union territories between 2001 and 2012. The methodology accounts for time-invariant heterogeneity and isolates within-state temporal variation using state fixed effects regression. According to the results, recorded crimes rose by almost 590% over the course of the study, and starting in 2003, the upward trend became statistically significant. When fixed effects are used instead of pooled OLS, the model fit significantly improves (R-squared = 0.43 versus R-squared = 0.05), emphasizing the significance of accounting for a specific variability.Size and the timing of increase indicate that rather than a proportionate increase in victimization alone, improvements in reporting procedures, legal awareness, and child protection measures most likely contributed significantly to the observed trend. The results emphasize the importance of carefully interpreting administrative crime data and show how India has made strides in upgrading its reporting and child protection systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用印度国家犯罪记录局的平衡面板数据分析2001-2012年间38个邦和中央直辖区报告的儿童犯罪变化，发现记录犯罪增加590%，主要归因于报告程序改进而非实际受害增加。
AI.research_question: 2001-2012年间印度各邦报告的儿童犯罪变化趋势是什么？这些变化主要反映实际受害增加还是报告系统改进？
AI.motivation: 需要理解印度儿童犯罪数据的真实含义，区分实际受害趋势与报告系统改进的影响，为政策制定提供准确依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 犯罪报告理论、行政数据解释理论、固定效应模型理论（控制时间不变异质性）
AI.method: 使用国家犯罪记录局平衡面板数据，对38个邦和中央直辖区采用州固定效应回归，控制时间不变异质性，分析2001-2012年间变化
AI.findings: 记录犯罪增加590%，2003年起上升趋势显著；固定效应模型拟合度显著优于混合OLS（R²=0.43 vs 0.05）；趋势主要反映报告程序改进、法律意识提高和儿童保护措施加强
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了如何正确解释行政犯罪数据，区分实际受害与报告系统改进的影响；验证了固定效应模型在犯罪趋势分析中的重要性

title: Between a Rock and a Hard Place: Social Partners and Reforms in the Wage-Setting System in Greece under Austerity
affiliations: University of the West of England (UWE) - Bristol Business School, University of the West of England (UWE), Portsmouth Law School, University of Portsmouth and

detail.title: Between a Rock and a Hard Place: Social Partners and Reforms in the Wage-Setting System in Greece under Austerity

publicationDetails.detailsText: Economic and Industrial Democracy, volume 43, issue 2, 2022[10.1177/0143831X20935511]

detail.abstract: The paper focuses on the reforms in the wage-setting system in Greece in the context of a severe recession and against the backdrop of EU bailout agreements. The analysis reveals that the reforms are also contested among key actors, and that the fault lines between social partners are not fully consistent with the notion of a binary pro-reform (from business associations) vs. anti-reform stance (from labour associations). Instead, our interview data expose hitherto hidden fractures in the employers’ camp. Employers’ representatives express –in varying degrees– their scepticism towards the efficacy of the institutional changes and generally towards technocratic solutions. More broadly this analysis reflects on the contested and controversial nature of the policy reforms on wage setting, for which there is no consensus either in the academic or policy literature, and delves deeper into the views and perspectives of key actors on the efficacy and consequences of the main institutional changes in wage setting.

AI.tldr: 希腊在严重衰退和欧盟救助协议背景下进行的工资设定制度改革，研究发现改革在关键参与者中存在争议，雇主阵营内部存在隐藏分歧，各方对制度变革的效能持怀疑态度。
AI.research_question: 希腊工资设定制度改革中关键参与者的立场分歧如何？特别是雇主阵营内部是否存在隐藏的分裂？
AI.motivation: 在严重经济衰退和欧盟救助协议背景下，希腊进行了工资设定制度改革，但学术界和政策界对此改革缺乏共识，需要深入理解关键参与者对改革效能的看法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度变革理论、社会伙伴关系理论、政策争议分析框架
AI.method: 访谈研究，收集关键参与者（雇主代表、劳工代表等）的质性数据
AI.findings: 1. 改革在关键参与者中存在争议；2. 社会伙伴之间的分歧不符合简单的"支持改革（雇主协会）vs反对改革（劳工协会）"二元对立；3. 雇主阵营内部存在隐藏的分裂；4. 雇主代表对制度变革效能和技术官僚解决方案持不同程度的怀疑态度
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统的社会伙伴二元对立理论，揭示了雇主阵营内部的复杂性，为理解制度变革中的利益分歧提供了新视角
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了更全面的利益相关者分析，揭示了改革实施中可能遇到的隐藏阻力，有助于设计更具包容性和有效性的改革方案

title: Technology Policy under Xi Jinping 2012-2022
affiliations: Copenhagen Business School and City University of Hong Kong

detail.title: Technology Policy under Xi Jinping 2012-2022
detail.abstract: This chapter discusses the successes and failures of China’s technology policy during the first two decades of the 21st century and evaluates how Xi’s broader policies have attempted to resolve but ultimately exacerbated many of the institutional constraints undermining the Chinese state’s technological efforts. While China has achieved tremendous successes in R&D investment and the sheer numbers of patents and scientific papers produced, quality concerns about this output remain. Institutional constraints inhibiting the flow of information and efficient allocation of resources also continue as demonstrated in the chapter’s examination of the largest technological policy effort under Xi, the Made in China 2025 policy. The chapter examines three critical sectors of the Made in China 2025 policy: semiconductors, electric vehicles, and artificial intelligence. Of the three sectors, technology policy in semiconductors has been the least successful, policy for artificial intelligence has not realized the sector’s promise, and policy for electric vehicles is the closest to a true policy success case. The conclusion examines how China’s tensions with the United States and other advanced economies potentially will further constrict the scope of China’s technological development.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了中国21世纪前20年科技政策的成败，分析了习近平政策如何试图解决但最终加剧了制约中国科技发展的制度约束。研究发现，尽管中国在研发投入、专利和论文数量上取得巨大成功，但质量问题和制度约束依然存在。通过对"中国制造2025"三大关键领域（半导体、电动汽车、人工智能）的分析，发现半导体政策最不成功，人工智能政策未实现预期，电动汽车政策相对最成功。
AI.research_question: 中国21世纪前20年科技政策的成败如何？习近平的政策如何影响中国科技发展的制度约束？"中国制造2025"政策在半导体、电动汽车和人工智能三大关键领域的实施效果如何？
AI.motivation: 中国在科技领域取得了显著成就，但存在质量问题和制度约束。需要评估习近平政策对解决这些问题的实际效果，特别是在"中国制造2025"这一重大科技政策框架下的实施情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度约束理论、科技政策评估框架、国家创新体系理论、资源分配效率理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，通过对"中国制造2025"政策中三个关键领域（半导体、电动汽车、人工智能）的深入分析，评估政策实施效果
AI.findings: 1. 中国在研发投入、专利和论文数量上取得巨大成功，但存在质量问题；2. 信息流动不畅和资源分配低效的制度约束依然存在；3. 半导体政策最不成功，人工智能政策未实现预期，电动汽车政策相对最成功；4. 习近平政策试图解决但最终加剧了制度约束
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 深化了对中国科技政策制度约束的理解；2. 提供了科技政策评估的多领域比较框架；3. 揭示了政策意图与实际效果之间的差距机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供科技政策调整的方向；2. 指出了半导体和人工智能领域需要改进的政策重点；3. 揭示了中美紧张关系可能进一步制约中国科技发展的风险

title: Climate Resilience through Financial Globalization: Evidence from Low-and Middle-Income Countries
affiliations: University of Dhaka

detail.title: Climate Resilience through Financial Globalization: Evidence from Low-and Middle-Income Countries
detail.abstract: This study examines the nexus between financial globalization and climate resilience across a panel of 42 low-and middle-income countries (LMICs) spanning 1995-2021. Employing a rigorous empirical framework that combines two-stage least squares (2SLS) instrumental variables (IV) and generalized method of moments (GMM) estimations, the analysis addresses potential endogeneity and dynamic feedback concerns. Controlling for cross-sectional dependence and serial correlation via Driscoll-Kraay standard errors, this study finds thatdespite heightened climate vulnerability-these countries exhibit a notable commitment to climate resilience in response to increased financial globalization. Structural equation modeling (SEM) further indicates that this relationship operates primarily through institutional quality, green bond issuance, financial market access, low CO2 technology diffusion, and R&D expenditure. Moreover, the depth and accessibility of financial institutions, alongside liquidity aggregation, substantially moderate the magnitude of the effect. Heterogeneity analyses demonstrate that the strength and direction of the nexus vary across regions, income groups, growth trajectories, and initial levels of resilience and openness, highlighting the nuanced pathways through which financial globalization shapes climate resilience in the LMICs.

AI.tldr: 本研究使用1995-2021年42个中低收入国家的面板数据，通过2SLS-IV和GMM方法分析金融全球化与气候韧性之间的关系，发现尽管这些国家气候脆弱性较高，但金融全球化通过制度质量、绿色债券发行、金融市场准入、低碳技术扩散和研发支出等渠道显著提升了气候韧性。
AI.research_question: 金融全球化如何影响中低收入国家的气候韧性？这种关系通过哪些机制发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 中低收入国家面临气候变化和金融全球化的双重挑战，需要理解金融全球化如何影响这些国家的气候适应和韧性建设能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融全球化理论、气候韧性理论、制度经济学、技术扩散理论、金融发展理论
AI.method: 使用1995-2021年42个中低收入国家的面板数据，采用两阶段最小二乘法（2SLS）工具变量法和广义矩估计（GMM）解决内生性问题，使用Driscoll-Kraay标准误差控制截面依赖和序列相关，并通过结构方程模型（SEM）分析中介机制。
AI.findings: 尽管中低收入国家气候脆弱性较高，但金融全球化显著提升了气候韧性。这种关系主要通过制度质量、绿色债券发行、金融市场准入、低碳技术扩散和研发支出等渠道实现。金融机构的深度和可及性以及流动性聚集显著调节了这种效应。异质性分析显示，这种关系在不同地区、收入群体、增长轨迹以及初始韧性和开放度水平下存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）建立了金融全球化与气候韧性的理论联系框架；2）识别了制度质量、绿色金融、技术扩散等多重中介机制；3）揭示了金融全球化影响气候韧性的异质性特征；4）为理解中低收入国家在全球化背景下的气候适应提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为中低收入国家制定气候韧性政策提供实证依据；2）强调了提升制度质量和金融市场发展的重要性；3）为国际金融机构设计支持气候韧性的金融工具提供参考；4）帮助政策制定者针对不同国家特征制定差异化的气候适应策略。

title: Systematic Risk Analysis of Financial Networks Based on Homology Theory
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Systematic Risk Analysis of Financial Networks Based on Homology Theory
detail.abstract: Modern financial systems are characterized by complex debt networks where systemic risk often emerges from circular interdependencies rather than individual failures. Traditional node-based metrics, however, often struggle to capture these global topological structures. This paper systematically reviews the theory of simplicial homology and demonstrates its construction from financial data using Clique and Vietoris-Rips complexes. The author specifically focuses on the detection of debt vortices—represented mathematically as persistent 1-cycles—which indicate fragile feedback loops within the economy. Additionally, an extrinsic norm based on debt magnitude is introduced to quantify the economic significance of these topological risks, distinguishing systemic threats from market noise. The author concludes that topological invariants, particularly persistent Betti numbers, serve as superior indicators for structural vulnerability compared to standard geometric metrics. Future research will focus on empirically validating these indicators against historical crisis data, moving towards a shape-based Monetary Macro Theory that better anticipates systemic collapses. The LaTeX source code and datasets for this paper are available on GitHub:https://github.com/Sheennnn1016/homology-financial-risk

AI.tldr: 本文系统回顾了单纯同调理论，并展示了如何从金融数据构建Clique和Vietoris-Rips复形，用于检测债务漩涡（持久1-循环），并引入基于债务规模的外在范数来量化这些拓扑风险的经济意义。
AI.research_question: 如何利用拓扑学方法（特别是单纯同调理论）检测和量化金融系统中的系统性风险，特别是债务漩涡这种脆弱反馈循环？
AI.motivation: 现代金融系统具有复杂的债务网络，系统性风险往往源于循环相互依赖而非个体失败，传统基于节点的指标难以捕捉这些全局拓扑结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 单纯同调理论、持久同调、拓扑数据分析、Clique复形、Vietoris-Rips复形、持久Betti数、拓扑不变量。
AI.method: 从金融数据构建Clique和Vietoris-Rips复形，检测持久1-循环（债务漩涡），引入基于债务规模的外在范数来量化拓扑风险的经济意义。
AI.findings: 拓扑不变量（特别是持久Betti数）作为结构脆弱性指标优于标准几何度量，能够区分系统性威胁和市场噪声。
AI.theory_contributions: 将拓扑数据分析应用于金融风险研究，提出基于形状的货币宏观理论框架，为系统性风险检测提供新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供可操作的拓扑风险检测方法，开发了开源工具（LaTeX源代码和数据集），为监管机构和金融机构提供系统性风险预警指标。

title: Mapping the Intellectual Landscape of Finance Commission Research: A Scientometric Analysis
affiliations: Mumbai School of Economics and Public Policy, Students and Mumbai School of Economics and Public Policy (Autonomous), University of Mumbai

detail.title: Mapping the Intellectual Landscape of Finance Commission Research: A Scientometric Analysis

keywords: Horizontal Equalization Formulas JEL Codes: H77

detail.abstract: The Finance Commission of India is a pivotal constitutional body addressing vertical and horizontal fiscal imbalances through resource distribution. Despite its central role, scholars navigate a persistent "tug of war" between equity and efficiency in devolution formulas, which often impacts subnational fiscal discipline and revenue efforts. This study conducts a comprehensive bibliometric analysis of 178 highimpact documents published between 2001 and 2025 to map the intellectual landscape of this field. Utilizing science mapping and performance analysis, the research identifies a highly concentrated academic discourse dominated by core publications such as Economic and Political Weekly (local H-index 8) and leading scholars like P. Chakraborty and M. Govinda Rao. While foundational literature centers on "fiscal federalism" and "fiscal consolidation," findings reveal a significant research gap in the systematic mapping of equity-efficiency trade-offs and the scholarly synthesis of recent shifts, such as ecological fiscal transfers. By filling this void, the manuscript provides a state-of-the-art summary of how devolution mechanisms are conceptualized in the Indian context. Ultimately, this study offers a forward-looking perspective on India's maturing fiscal architecture, highlighting emerging trends for both researchers and policymakers

AI.tldr: 本文对印度财政委员会相关研究进行了全面的文献计量分析，揭示了该领域高度集中的学术话语体系，并识别了公平与效率权衡方面的研究空白。
AI.research_question: 印度财政委员会研究领域的知识结构、核心主题、研究空白和未来趋势是什么？
AI.motivation: 尽管印度财政委员会在解决垂直和横向财政失衡方面具有核心作用，但学者们在转移支付公式中持续面临公平与效率的"拉锯战"，这影响了地方财政纪律和收入努力。然而，缺乏对该领域知识结构的系统梳理。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政联邦主义理论、公平与效率权衡理论、财政分权理论
AI.method: 对2001-2025年间178篇高影响力文献进行文献计量分析，包括科学图谱分析和绩效分析
AI.findings: 1. 学术话语高度集中，核心出版物为《经济与政治周刊》(本地H指数8)，核心学者包括P. Chakraborty和M. Govinda Rao；2. 基础文献围绕"财政联邦主义"和"财政巩固"；3. 存在显著研究空白：公平与效率权衡的系统性图谱分析不足，对生态财政转移等新趋势的学术综合研究缺乏
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次系统绘制了印度财政委员会研究领域的知识图谱；2. 识别了公平与效率权衡的理论研究空白；3. 为财政联邦主义理论在印度背景下的应用提供了最新总结
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为研究人员提供了该领域的研究现状和未来方向；2. 为政策制定者提供了印度成熟财政架构的前瞻性视角；3. 揭示了生态财政转移等新兴趋势，对政策实践具有指导意义

title: Postgraduate International Business Education in the UK and Ireland (2025/26): Structure, Differentiation, and Strategic Trends - Evidence from 187 Programmes across 119 Institutions
affiliations: Alliance Manchester Business School

detail.title: Postgraduate International Business Education in the UK and Ireland (2025/26): Structure, Differentiation, and Strategic Trends - Evidence from 187 Programmes across 119 Institutions
detail.abstract: This report presents a comprehensive mapping of postgraduate taught (PGT) master’s programmes in International Business (IB) and International Management (IM) across the United Kingdom and the Republic of Irland. Drawing on a systematic review of 187 programmes offered by 119 institutions, it provides evidence-based insights into the structure, positioning, and differentiation of IB/IM provision in the 2025/26 academic year. The study aims to inform curriculum design, policy dialogue, and institutional benchmarking within international business education, contributing to ongoing discussions about programme diversity, pedagogical innovation, and responsible management in a global context.

AI.tldr: 该研究对英国和爱尔兰的国际商务/国际管理硕士项目进行了系统性映射，分析了187个项目的结构、定位和差异化特征，为课程设计、政策对话和机构对标提供依据。
AI.research_question: 英国和爱尔兰的国际商务/国际管理硕士项目在2025/26学年的结构、定位和差异化特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 需要了解国际商务教育领域的项目多样性、教学创新和负责任管理，为课程设计、政策制定和机构对标提供实证基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际商务教育理论、课程设计理论、项目差异化理论、高等教育管理理论
AI.method: 对119个机构的187个国际商务/国际管理硕士项目进行系统性文献回顾和内容分析
AI.findings: 提供了英国和爱尔兰国际商务/国际管理硕士项目的全面映射，揭示了项目结构、定位策略和差异化特征的具体模式
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了国际商务教育理论，为项目差异化、课程设计和教学创新提供了实证基础
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育机构提供课程设计参考，为政策制定者提供决策依据，为院校对标提供基准数据，促进国际商务教育的质量提升

title: Stabilising Competence and Continuity in the UPC
affiliations: Swansea University

detail.title: Stabilising Competence and Continuity in the UPC
detail.abstract: The transition of the Unified Patent Court (UPC) from London to Milan has emerged as a defining institutional stress test of the Court’s resilience and its relationship to the wider EU legal framework. The decision Roku v. Dolby/Sun is one of the leading early appellate rulings to address this transition. It treats the ‘bring it into line’ power as capable of addressing an implementation obstacle created by factual impossibility. This preserves operability while raising a boundary question about executive amendment authority within a treaty-based court. This article proposes a structured test for Art. 87(2), grounded in the UPCA’s safeguard logic, to distinguish continuity measures that remove implementation obstacles from changes that alter treaty-level institutional choices. It suggests that the Milan amendment can be defended on defined criteria while offering a principled basis to resist normalised executive treaty change under the language of continuity.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了统一专利法院（UPC）从伦敦迁至米兰的机构压力测试，重点关注Roku v. Dolby/Sun上诉裁决如何运用"使其符合"权力处理事实不可能性造成的实施障碍，并提出基于UPCA保障逻辑的结构化测试来区分消除实施障碍的连续性措施与改变条约层面制度选择的变化。
AI.research_question: 统一专利法院从伦敦迁至米兰的过渡如何测试法院的韧性及其与欧盟法律框架的关系？如何区分消除实施障碍的连续性措施与改变条约层面制度选择的执行修正权？
AI.motivation: UPC从伦敦迁至米兰的过渡是法院韧性的重要制度压力测试，Roku v. Dolby/Sun案件是早期处理这一过渡的关键上诉裁决，需要分析执行修正权在条约法院中的边界问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于统一专利法院协定（UPCA）的保障逻辑，条约解释理论，执行修正权与条约稳定性的平衡理论，制度连续性原则。
AI.method: 法律案例分析（Roku v. Dolby/Sun裁决），条约解释方法，基于UPCA保障逻辑的结构化测试构建，原则性法律论证。
AI.findings: Roku裁决将"使其符合"权力视为能够处理事实不可能性造成的实施障碍，在保持可操作性的同时提出了条约法院内执行修正权的边界问题。米兰修正案可以在明确标准下得到辩护，同时为抵制在连续性名义下的常态化执行条约变更提供了原则基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于UPCA保障逻辑的Art. 87(2)结构化测试框架，区分了消除实施障碍的连续性措施与改变条约层面制度选择的变化，发展了条约法院执行修正权的边界理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为UPC机构过渡提供了法律分析框架，为未来类似制度变更提供了可操作的测试标准，为法院裁决执行修正权问题提供了指导原则，有助于维护条约稳定性和制度连续性。

title: Desirable Bikeshare Routes: Nonlinear Impacts of Micro-Level Street Environments
affiliations: University of Chicago, The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK), Xi'an Jiaotong -Liverpool University, University of Chicago, The University of Hong Kong, University of Tokyo and The University of Hong Kong - Department of Urban Planning and Design

detail.title: Desirable Bikeshare Routes: Nonlinear Impacts of Micro-Level Street Environments

declarations.funderStatement: This research has been supported by The University of Hong Kong’s HKU-100 Scholars Award (recipient Dr. Waishan Qiu). During its data collection phase, this study has also received support from the Alan Black Transportation Related Grant (2020) from the Department of City and Regional Planning and the Serve in Place Fund (2020) from the Office of Engagement Initiatives at Cornell University (recipient Dr. Waishan Qiu). The authors would also like to thank the City of Ithaca, Bike Walk Tompkins, Lime, and Mr. Hector Chang for providing bikeshare trip data during the summer of 2020. This research could not have been made without their support.

detail.abstract: Facilitating an attractive and safe street environment (SE) for cyclists can yield multifaceted benefits for sustainable, healthy cities. However, due to limited urban-scale trajectory data, the influence of micro-level SE (e.g., trees, shrubs, perceptions, and road cracks) on cyclists' route preferences remains less understood. Using over 4,000 Lime Dockless Bikeshare trajectories, this study constructed a Desirable Bikeshare Index (DBI) that measures differences between observed trips and the shortest routes suggested by Google Maps at the street-segment level. Using computer vision, road damage was detected in street view images, alongside objective streetscape features and subjective perceptions (e.g., enclosure) to characterize microlevel SEs comprehensively. Nonlinear associations between SE and DBI were identified using explainable machine learning algorithms, and customer satisfaction theory (e.g., basic, excitement, performance factors) was adopted to interpret the threshold effects. Contrary to earlier findings, green spaces do not always attract cyclists-lush trees draw cyclists, while too many shrubs repel them. Moreover, sidewalks are a must-have (basic factor), while road damage is more common where cyclists aggregate, underscoring the need for timely monitoring and maintenance of bicycle infrastructure. Perceptions of accessibility, order, and richness are excitement factors that explain route desirability. Interestingly, perceived ecology and enclosure promote cycling at low values, then quickly play a negative role beyond mid-to-high values. Our findings underscore the need to combine subjective perceptions with objective streetscapes to delineate a comprehensive micro-level SE. Urban designers and transport planners can leverage revealed thresholds to implement cost-effective infrastructure upgrades that facilitate desirable street environments for cyclists.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用共享单车轨迹数据和街景图像，构建了"理想骑行指数"来衡量骑行者路线偏好，发现微观街道环境特征（如树木、灌木、道路损坏、主观感知等）对骑行路线选择存在非线性阈值效应。
AI.research_question: 微观街道环境（包括客观街景特征和主观感知）如何影响骑行者的路线偏好？这些影响是否存在非线性阈值效应？
AI.motivation: 创造有吸引力且安全的街道环境对建设可持续健康城市至关重要，但由于缺乏城市尺度的轨迹数据，微观街道环境对骑行者路线偏好的影响尚未得到充分理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 顾客满意度理论（基本因素、兴奋因素、绩效因素）用于解释阈值效应；计算机视觉技术用于分析街景图像；可解释机器学习算法用于识别非线性关联。
AI.method: 使用4,000多条Lime无桩共享单车轨迹数据，构建"理想骑行指数"（DBI）衡量实际骑行路线与谷歌地图最短路径的差异；通过计算机视觉检测街景图像中的道路损坏；结合客观街景特征和主观感知（如封闭感）全面表征微观街道环境；使用可解释机器学习算法识别非线性关联。
AI.findings: 1. 绿色空间不总是吸引骑行者：茂密树木吸引骑行者，但过多灌木会排斥他们；2. 人行道是基本因素（必须有的），而道路损坏在骑行者聚集处更常见；3. 可达性、秩序感和丰富度感知是兴奋因素；4. 生态感和封闭感感知在低值时促进骑行，但在中高值时迅速转为负面作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将顾客满意度理论应用于街道环境研究，解释微观环境特征的阈值效应；2. 提出结合主观感知和客观街景的全面微观街道环境表征框架；3. 揭示了微观街道环境对骑行偏好的非线性影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为城市设计师和交通规划者提供具体的阈值参考，实施成本效益高的基础设施升级；2. 强调及时监测和维护自行车基础设施的重要性；3. 提供基于数据的街道环境优化策略，促进理想的骑行街道环境建设。

title: Lender of Last Resort and Local Economic Outcomes
affiliations: California Institute of Technology (Caltech)

detail.title: Lender of Last Resort and Local Economic Outcomes
detail.abstract:
This paper studies the long-run labor market consequences of lender-of-last-resort (LLR) intervention during the Great Depression. I exploit a natural experiment created by the Federal Reserve district border separating counties under the jurisdiction of the Atlanta and St. Louis Federal Reserve Banks. During the banking panic of 1930, the Atlanta Fed aggressively extended liquidity to distressed banks, while the St. Louis Fed largely refrained from intervention. Using newly digitized county-level manufacturing data and linked individual-level census records from 1930 and 1940, I examine how exposure to this liquidity support affected local economic activity and worker outcomes. Counties within the Atlanta district experienced fewer bank failures and stronger manufacturing performance in the early 1930s. These differences translated into persistent labor market effects: individuals in treated counties were more likely to remain in manufacturing employment and less likely to migrate across state lines by 1940. The results suggest that financial stabilization policies can shape the long-run allocation of labor across regions and sectors.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大萧条期间最后贷款人干预对劳动力市场的长期影响。通过对比亚特兰大联储和圣路易斯联储辖区内的县，发现亚特兰大联储的积极流动性支持减少了银行倒闭，促进了制造业发展，并产生了持久的劳动力市场效应：工人更可能留在制造业就业，跨州迁移率降低。
AI.research_question: 最后贷款人干预如何影响劳动力市场的长期后果？具体来说，大萧条期间的流动性支持如何影响地方经济活动、工人就业选择和迁移决策？
AI.motivation: 理解金融稳定政策（特别是最后贷款人干预）对实体经济的长期影响至关重要。大萧条期间的银行恐慌为研究这一问题提供了自然实验机会，有助于评估金融政策对劳动力市场结构和区域经济发展的持久作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于金融稳定理论、劳动力市场理论和区域经济学理论，探讨最后贷款人干预通过银行渠道影响实体经济，进而改变劳动力市场结构和区域经济动态的机制。
AI.method: 利用自然实验设计：比较亚特兰大联储（积极干预）和圣路易斯联储（较少干预）辖区内的县。使用新数字化的县级制造业数据和1930-1940年个人层面的普查记录，采用双重差分等方法分析流动性支持对地方经济和工人结果的影响。
AI.findings: 亚特兰大联储辖区内的县经历了更少的银行倒闭和更强的制造业表现。这些差异转化为持久的劳动力市场效应：到1940年，这些县的工人更可能留在制造业就业，跨州迁移的可能性更低。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为金融稳定政策的长期经济效应提供了实证证据；2. 揭示了最后贷款人干预通过银行渠道影响劳动力市场结构的机制；3. 拓展了对金融政策与区域经济发展关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计金融稳定政策提供了经验依据；2. 强调了金融干预对劳动力市场结构和区域经济平衡的重要性；3. 为理解经济危机期间政策干预的长期后果提供了参考。

title: What Makes New Work Different from More Work?
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT), Tilburg University and

detail.title: What Makes New Work Different from More Work?
detail.abstract:
We study the role of expertise in new work–novel occupational roles that emerge as technological and economic conditions evolve–using newly available 1940 and 1950 Census Complete Count files and confidential American Community Survey data from 2011-2023. We show that new work is systematically distinct from simply more work in existing occupations in four respects. First, it attracts workers with distinct characteristics: new work is disproportionately performed by younger and more educated workers, even within detailed occupation-industry cells. Second, new work commands economically significant wage premiums that persist beyond workers' initial entry into new work, consistent with returns to scarce, specialized expertise rather than temporary market disequilibrium. Third, these premiums decline across vintages as expertise diffuses, with 'newer' new work commanding larger premiums than older new work. Fourth, the emergence of new work can be traced to specific demand shocks in particular locations and time periods, suggesting that expertise formation responds systematically to economic opportunities. These findings suggest that new work serves as a countervailing force to automation-driven job displacement not merely by creating additional employment, but also by generating new domains of human expertise that command market premiums. This expertise-based mechanism helps explain both the expanding variety of work activities across decades and the historical resilience of the labor share.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了"新工作"（随技术经济条件演变而出现的新型职业角色）中专业知识的作用。研究发现新工作与现有职业的简单增加有系统性差异：吸引年轻高学历工作者、存在持续工资溢价、溢价随专业知识扩散而下降、新工作出现与特定需求冲击相关。这表明新工作通过创造新专业知识领域而非仅增加就业来抵消自动化带来的岗位替代。
AI.research_question: 专业知识在"新工作"（随技术经济条件演变而出现的新型职业角色）中扮演什么角色？新工作与现有职业的简单增加有何系统性差异？
AI.motivation: 理解劳动力市场如何适应技术变革和经济发展，特别是新工作如何作为对抗自动化驱动岗位替代的力量。传统观点关注就业数量变化，但忽略了新工作可能通过创造新专业知识领域来维持劳动力份额的韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 专业知识理论、劳动力市场动态、技术变革与职业演变、工资溢价理论、需求冲击与专业知识形成
AI.method: 使用1940年和1950年人口普查完整计数文件以及2011-2023年保密美国社区调查数据，进行详细的职业-行业单元分析，追踪新工作的出现、工作者特征、工资溢价及其随时间变化。
AI.findings: 1. 新工作吸引年轻且受教育程度更高的工作者；2. 新工作存在显著且持续的工资溢价，反映稀缺专业知识回报而非暂时市场失衡；3. 溢价随专业知识扩散而下降，"更新"的新工作溢价更大；4. 新工作出现与特定时空的需求冲击相关，表明专业知识形成对经济机会的系统性响应。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出专业知识视角理解新工作的作用；2. 区分新工作与简单就业增加的系统性差异；3. 解释劳动力市场对技术变革的适应性机制；4. 为劳动力份额的历史韧性提供新解释框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者理解劳动力市场动态提供依据；2. 帮助教育机构预测未来技能需求；3. 为企业人力资源战略提供参考；4. 为工作者职业规划提供指导，特别是关注新兴专业知识领域。

title: The Precarious Financial Lives of College Students in Sub-Saharan Africa
affiliations: University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA), University of Pennsylvania,  and Brown University

detail.title: The Precarious Financial Lives of College Students in Sub-Saharan Africa
detail.abstract:
Investment in tertiary education in Africa, unlike richer settings, is often portrayed as inequitable and inefficient. Yet, though Africa will produce much of the world’s future workforce, there is little information on college students’ financial constraints. Novel data from a Zambian flagship university show that students are highly financially vulnerable and food insecure, on par with the "ultra-poor.'' Because universities are typically urban, cash poor rural students struggle with high urban costs of living. Being allocated on-campus housing leads to less financial vulnerability and better academic outcomes. Financially supporting African university students could promote both equity and efficiency.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用赞比亚旗舰大学的新数据发现，非洲大学生面临严重的财务脆弱性和粮食不安全问题，与"极端贫困"水平相当。获得校内住宿能显著改善学生的财务状况和学业表现。支持非洲大学生既能促进教育公平，也能提高教育效率。
AI.research_question: 非洲大学生面临怎样的财务约束？这些财务约束如何影响他们的学业表现？校内住宿分配对缓解财务约束和改善学业成果有何作用？
AI.motivation: 非洲将培养世界未来劳动力的重要部分，但关于非洲大学生财务约束的信息很少。与富裕国家不同，非洲高等教育投资常被认为不公平且低效，需要实证证据来了解实际情况。
AI.theoretical_framework: 教育经济学中的财务约束理论、教育公平理论、人力资本投资理论，以及城乡差异对教育机会的影响。
AI.method: 使用赞比亚旗舰大学的新颖调查数据，分析学生的财务脆弱性、粮食不安全状况和学业表现。采用实证分析方法，特别关注校内住宿分配的自然实验或准实验设计。
AI.findings: 1. 非洲大学生财务脆弱性高，粮食不安全程度与"极端贫困"人群相当；2. 来自农村的现金贫困学生尤其难以应对高昂的城市生活成本；3. 获得校内住宿能显著减少财务脆弱性并改善学业成果。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为发展中国家高等教育财务约束理论提供实证证据；2. 揭示了城乡差异在高等教育机会中的重要作用；3. 证明了简单干预（如校内住宿）对缓解财务约束的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为非洲高等教育政策制定者提供具体建议：增加校内住宿供给；2. 证明支持大学生既能促进公平又能提高效率；3. 为国际发展机构投资非洲高等教育提供依据。

title: Substitution and Income Effects of Labor Income Taxation
affiliations: Statistics Norway, University of Oslo, University of Chicago, University of Bergen - Department of Economics and Statistics Norway - Research Department, University of Chicago - Department of Economics

detail.title: Substitution and Income Effects of Labor Income Taxation
detail.abstract:
The elasticity of taxable income (ETI) parameter is a key quantity in empirical analysis of tax policy and labor supply. We examine when a commonly applied class of ETI estimands can be used to learn about individuals’ ETI parameters and their (un)compensated elasticities of labor supply. We begin by providing necessary and sufficient conditions for these estimands to be given a causal interpretation as a positively weighted average of heterogeneous ETI parameters. We then apply these results to empirically analyze a reform of the Norwegian tax system that reduced the marginal tax rates on middle and high incomes. The estimated ETI parameters increase steadily with income, meaning high-income individuals are more responsive to tax changes than middle-income individuals.
