AI.practical_contributions: 1. 呼吁制定欧盟众筹行业AI使用专门监管指南 2. 倡导欧盟金融服务框架中AI处理的一致性 3. 为政策制定者提供具体改革建议

title: Trade, Commuting and City Structure

detail.title: Trade, Commuting and City Structure
detail.abstract: Cities are places where people commute to work and where goods are traded across space. While a large literature examines how lower commuting costs reshape cities, much less is known about within-city trade costs as a distinct force. This paper studies both channels using the construction of the Petite Ceinture railroad in nineteenth-century Paris, the world's first circular transit system, designed for both freight and passengers. Using newly digitized data on firms, population, rents, and transport networks spanning 1801 to 1906, I provide causal evidence that improved access to the railroad reshaped the spatial distribution of economic activities during this period. To quantify general equilibrium effects, I develop and calibrate a quantitative urban model in which within-city freight costs generate spatial variation in tradable goods prices, creating consumption-driven forces at the residence absent from canonical models. Counterfactuals show that removing the railroad would substantially reduce total population, consumption of tradables, and spatial specialization. Ignoring within-city freight costs leads to a 17.1% underestimation of the effects of transport infrastructure on urban structure and welfare.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文研究了19世纪巴黎Petite Ceinture环形铁路系统对城市空间经济的影响，发现城际货运成本是塑造城市结构的重要力量，忽略这一因素会低估交通基础设施对城市福利的影响达17.1%。
AI.research_question: 城际货运成本作为独立力量如何影响城市空间经济结构？与通勤成本相比，货运成本对城市经济活动的空间分布有何不同影响？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注通勤成本对城市结构的影响，但对城际货运成本作为独立力量的研究不足。需要理解货运成本如何通过商品价格空间差异影响城市经济活动的空间分布。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建定量城市模型，其中城际货运成本导致可贸易商品价格的空间差异，产生传统模型中缺乏的消费驱动力量。
AI.method: 使用1801-1906年新数字化的企业、人口、租金和交通网络数据，通过Petite Ceinture铁路建设作为自然实验提供因果证据，并校准定量城市模型进行反事实分析。
AI.findings: 铁路建设显著重塑了经济活动空间分布；移除铁路会大幅减少总人口、可贸易品消费和空间专业化；忽略城际货运成本会导致对交通基础设施影响低估17.1%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将城际货运成本作为独立力量纳入城市经济模型，揭示了消费驱动机制在塑造城市空间结构中的作用，扩展了经典城市经济理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为城市规划者提供了考虑货运成本重要性的实证依据，有助于更准确地评估交通基础设施投资对城市结构和福利的影响。

title: Do Elections Moderate or Polarize Political Rhetoric?
affiliations: Bocconi University - Department of Economics, Bocconi University and Bocconi University - Department of Economics

detail.title: Do Elections Moderate or Polarize Political Rhetoric?
detail.abstract: We study the communication strategies on Twitter/X of 367 political leaders in 21 countries, focusing on electoral competition between populists and non-populists. We measure polarization by the ease with which the leader can be classified as populist or not, conditional on his tweet. We find that political rhetoric becomes more polarized before and around election dates. This happens because, in pre-electoral quarters, opposite leaders are more likely to: i) talk about different topics, and ii) frame differently the same issues. Our results are consistent with competing politicians targeting different voters, rather than appealing to the same swing voters.

AI.tldr: 研究21个国家367位政治领袖在Twitter/X上的沟通策略，发现选举前后政治言论更加极化，表现为对立领导人更可能讨论不同议题或以不同方式框架相同议题，这符合政治家针对不同选民而非争取摇摆选民的理论。
AI.research_question: 政治领袖在社交媒体上的沟通策略如何随选举周期变化？选举前后政治言论极化程度如何变化？这种变化是由于对立领导人讨论不同议题还是以不同方式框架相同议题？
AI.motivation: 理解社交媒体时代政治沟通的动态，特别是选举期间民粹主义与非民粹主义政治家如何通过言论策略争取选民，以及这些策略如何影响政治极化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于选举竞争理论，特别是关于政治家针对不同选民群体（分化策略）还是争取相同摇摆选民（趋同策略）的理论框架，分析社交媒体沟通策略。
AI.method: 收集21个国家367位政治领袖的Twitter/X数据，通过机器学习方法测量极化程度（根据推文内容将领袖分类为民粹主义或非民粹主义的难易程度），比较选举前后不同季度的沟通模式。
AI.findings: 1. 选举前后政治言论极化程度显著增加；2. 极化增加源于两个机制：对立领导人更可能讨论不同议题，以及以不同方式框架相同议题；3. 结果支持政治家针对不同选民而非争取相同摇摆选民的理论。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将选举竞争理论扩展到社交媒体环境；2. 提供了测量政治言论极化的新方法；3. 验证了选举期间政治沟通的分化策略理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政治沟通策略提供实证依据；2. 帮助理解社交媒体如何影响选举动态；3. 为政治分析师和竞选团队提供关于选举期间沟通策略的见解。

title: Trust, Finance, and Intangibles
affiliations: Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business and Central University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: Trust, Finance, and Intangibles
detail.abstract: What matters for intangible-intensive production is not credit volume but compositionthe mix of cash-flow-based versus asset-based lending. Using data from 27 countries and over 160,000 firm-year observations, we show that cash-flow-based lending drives intangible investment while overall credit depth does not, and that social trust is its deep institutional determinant. A firm-level trust measure from LLM analysis of 700,000 earnings call transcripts confirms that more transparent firms obtain more cash-flow debt. Two symmetric causal tests sharpen identification: insolvency reforms disproportionately benefit low-trust firms, while the financial crisis disproportionately hurts high-trust firms whose CF lending channel is disrupted. A model with strategic complementarity between financial and production structure generates multiple equilibria: high-trust economies reach an intangible frontier while low-trust economies remain trapped in tangible production. Eliminating cash-flow frictions raises TFP by 33 percent; composition policies generate two to three times larger gains than volume policies.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，对于无形资产密集型生产而言，重要的不是信贷总量而是信贷结构——基于现金流与基于资产的贷款组合。社会信任是现金流贷款的根本制度决定因素，高信任经济体能够达到无形资产前沿，而低信任经济体则被困在有形资产生产中。
AI.research_question: 什么因素驱动无形资产投资？信贷结构（现金流贷款vs资产贷款）和社会信任如何影响无形资产密集型生产？
AI.motivation: 无形资产在现代经济中日益重要，但传统信贷体系主要依赖有形资产抵押，这可能阻碍无形资产投资。需要理解信贷结构和社会信任如何影响无形资产生产。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略互补性理论：金融结构与生产结构之间存在战略互补性，导致多重均衡。高信任经济体达到无形资产前沿，低信任经济体被困在有形资产生产中。
AI.method: 1. 使用27个国家超过160,000个公司年度观测数据；2. 通过LLM分析700,000份财报电话会议记录构建公司层面信任度量；3. 对称因果检验：破产改革（对低信任公司影响更大）和金融危机（对高信任公司影响更大）。
AI.findings: 1. 现金流贷款驱动无形资产投资，而总体信贷深度不驱动；2. 社会信任是现金流贷款的根本制度决定因素；3. 更透明的公司获得更多现金流债务；4. 消除现金流摩擦可使TFP提高33%；5. 信贷结构政策的效果是总量政策的2-3倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出金融结构与生产结构战略互补性模型，解释多重均衡；2. 识别社会信任作为现金流贷款的根本制度决定因素；3. 区分信贷结构与信贷总量的不同作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 政策制定应关注信贷结构而非总量；2. 建立信任机制可促进无形资产投资；3. 破产改革有助于低信任公司获得现金流贷款；4. 信贷结构政策比总量政策更有效。

title: Long-Run Linkages and Parameter Instability in the Gold–Silver Relationship, 2010–2025
affiliations: Brunel University London - Department of Economics and Finance,  and University of Navarra - Department of Economics

detail.title: Long-Run Linkages and Parameter Instability in the Gold–Silver Relationship, 2010–2025
detail.abstract: This paper examines long-run linkages and possible instabilities in the gold–silver price relationship using daily futures prices over the period from 4 January 2010 to 28 November 2025. The empirical analysis includes unit-root and cointegration tests as well as endogenous structural break tests, namely the Pruned Exact Linear Time (PELT) algorithm applied to the Engle–Granger residuals and the Bai–Perron endogenous break test, both detecting a break in late 2017. Standard cointegration tests fail to detect a stable long-run equilibrium over the full sample and the pre-break subsample, while one is found in the post-break subsample. Further, the Local Whittle fractional integration method provides evidence of a high degree of persistence consistent with long-memory dynamics. The estimation of a Fractionally Cointegrated VAR (FCVAR) model corroborates the previous findings: although full-sample evidence for cointegration is limited, a stable and economically meaningful long-run relationship between gold and silver emerges clearly in the post-break period. The results are shown to be robust across frequencies.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用2010-2025年日度期货价格，通过多种计量方法分析黄金-白银价格关系的长期关联性和结构性变化，发现2017年末存在结构性断点，断点后两金属呈现稳定的长期均衡关系。
AI.research_question: 黄金与白银价格之间是否存在长期稳定的均衡关系？这种关系在样本期间是否经历了结构性变化？
AI.motivation: 贵金属市场（特别是黄金和白银）作为重要的避险资产和投资工具，其价格关系对投资者、政策制定者和市场参与者具有重要意义。理解两金属间的长期动态关系及其稳定性有助于风险管理、资产配置和市场预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 协整理论（Engle-Granger方法）、结构性断点检测理论（PELT算法、Bai-Perron检验）、长记忆过程理论（Local Whittle分数阶积分方法）、分数阶协整VAR模型（FCVAR）
AI.method: 使用2010年1月4日至2025年11月28日的日度期货价格数据，进行单位根检验、协整检验、内生结构性断点检测（PELT算法和Bai-Perron检验）、Local Whittle分数阶积分分析，以及分数阶协整VAR模型估计。
AI.findings: 1. 在2017年末检测到结构性断点；2. 全样本和断点前子样本中未发现稳定的长期均衡关系；3. 断点后子样本中黄金与白银存在稳定且经济意义显著的长期关系；4. Local Whittle方法显示高度持续性，符合长记忆动态特征；5. FCVAR模型结果与前述发现一致；6. 结果在不同频率下均稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将结构性断点检测与分数阶协整方法结合应用于贵金属市场分析；2. 证实黄金-白银关系存在时变特征，挑战了传统协整分析的稳定性假设；3. 为长记忆过程在金融时间序列中的应用提供实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为投资者提供黄金-白银套利策略的时间窗口指导；2. 帮助风险管理从业者识别关系结构性变化的风险；3. 为政策制定者理解贵金属市场联动机制提供依据；4. 市场参与者可根据断点前后不同的关系特征调整投资组合。

title: Trump Tariffs and Persistence in Crude Oil Prices: A Long-Memory Approach
affiliations: Brunel University London - Department of Economics and Finance, University of Navarra - Department of Economics and

detail.title: Trump Tariffs and Persistence in Crude Oil Prices: A Long-Memory Approach
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact on crude oil prices of the trade tariffs announced by the Trump administration on 2 April 2025 (“Liberation Day”). More specifically, it uses fractional integration methods to analyse daily data on WTI, Brent and Murban oil prices spanning the period from 3 June 2024 to 14 January 2026 for the former two and from 8 October 2024 to 15 January 2026 for the latter. Their long-memory and persistence properties are investigated initially over the full sample, and then the effects of the Trump tariff announcement are assessed by means of subsample analysis for the pre- and post-announcement period as well as recursive estimation of the fractional differencing parameter d measuring persistence. The results indicate that the unit root null cannot be rejected in any case, whether one considers the full sample or the subsamples, which implies that shocks have permanent effects. Further, the recursive estimation shows a significant impact of tariffs on the degree of persistence of oil prices only at the time of the announcement, when the wide confidence bands suggest a high degree of uncertainty - in the subsequent period no significant changes can be detected in the stochastic behaviour of the series following the downward shift in their level caused by the announcement.

AI.tldr: 本文使用分数整合方法分析特朗普政府2025年4月2日宣布的贸易关税对原油价格的影响。研究发现，无论是全样本还是子样本，都不能拒绝单位根原假设，表明冲击具有永久效应。递归估计显示关税仅在宣布时对油价持续性有显著影响，随后时期未检测到显著变化。
AI.research_question: 特朗普政府2025年4月2日宣布的贸易关税对原油价格的持续性特征有何影响？
AI.motivation: 贸易政策变化（特别是关税）对大宗商品市场（尤其是原油）的影响是重要的政策问题。特朗普政府的"解放日"关税宣布为研究此类政策冲击对油价长期记忆和持续性特征的影响提供了自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分数整合理论（Fractional Integration）和长记忆过程（Long-memory processes），使用分数差分参数d来衡量时间序列的持续性特征。
AI.method: 使用分数整合方法分析WTI、Brent和Murban原油的日度价格数据（WTI和Brent：2024年6月3日至2026年1月14日；Murban：2024年10月8日至2026年1月15日）。首先分析全样本的长记忆和持续性特征，然后通过子样本分析（宣布前后）和递归估计分数差分参数d来评估关税宣布的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 在任何情况下（全样本或子样本）都不能拒绝单位根原假设，表明冲击对原油价格具有永久效应；2. 递归估计显示关税仅在宣布时对油价持续性有显著影响，此时宽置信区间表明高度不确定性；3. 在后续时期，尽管宣布导致价格水平下降，但未检测到序列随机行为的显著变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将分数整合方法应用于贸易政策冲击对大宗商品市场影响的研究；2. 提供了关税宣布对油价持续性特征影响的实证证据；3. 展示了政策冲击在时间序列持续性方面的动态效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了贸易关税对原油市场影响的实证依据；2. 表明关税宣布主要产生一次性水平效应而非持续性结构变化；3. 为市场参与者在政策冲击下的风险管理提供参考。

title: Industrial Fentanyl Model Theory: A Political Economy Model of Structural Dependence and Asymmetric Industrial Competition
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Industrial Fentanyl Model Theory: A Political Economy Model of Structural Dependence and Asymmetric Industrial Competition
detail.abstract: This paper proposes the "Industrial Fentanyl Model Theory" to explain the phenomenon of structural economic dependence arising between two countries with significantly different institutional systems under globalization. Driven by extreme cost disparities and institutional constraint asymmetries, this relationship transcends traditional comparative advantage. The theory constructs an abstract model involving two primary actors: Country A, a highly developed liberal capitalist economy, and Country C, a highly centralized planned-control state. By systematically suppressing agricultural and labor costs, Country C achieves extremely low industrial production costs, allowing its exports to penetrate Country A's market. This influx gradually undermines Country A's industrial structure, creating path dependence and structural unemployment. Consequently, Country A develops an irreplaceable dependence on products from Country C, forming an economic lock-in effect analogous to an addiction mechanism where withdrawal (protectionism) induces severe economic pain (inflation). This paper analyzes the economic logic, institutional foundations, distributional structure, political narrative mechanisms, and long-term consequences of this model, proposing that when institutional costs become variables of competition, market mechanisms may lose their theoretical neutrality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"工业芬太尼模型理论"，解释全球化下制度差异巨大的两国间形成的结构性经济依赖现象。该理论认为，在极端成本差异和制度约束不对称驱动下，这种依赖超越传统比较优势，形成类似药物成瘾的经济锁定效应。
AI.research_question: 全球化背景下，制度体系差异巨大的国家之间如何形成结构性经济依赖关系？这种依赖关系的形成机制、经济逻辑和长期后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 解释现实世界中观察到的现象：发达国家对某些制度差异巨大的出口国形成不可替代的经济依赖，这种依赖超越传统贸易理论解释，具有类似成瘾机制的特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工业芬太尼模型理论，结合制度经济学、路径依赖理论、成瘾机制理论，挑战传统比较优势理论。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建抽象模型分析两个主要行为体（高度发达的资本主义经济体和高度集中的计划控制国家）之间的互动机制。
AI.findings: 制度成本差异成为竞争变量时，市场机制失去理论中性；通过系统性压低成本形成的出口优势会导致进口国工业结构破坏和结构性失业；形成经济锁定效应，保护主义政策会引发严重经济痛苦。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出新的理论框架解释全球化下的结构性经济依赖；挑战传统比较优势理论的局限性；将成瘾机制引入经济依赖分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供理解经济依赖形成机制的分析工具；警示制度成本竞争可能带来的长期风险；为国际贸易政策设计提供新视角。

title: Balanced Trade with Asymmetric Growth Engines
affiliations: University of Maryland

detail.title: Balanced Trade with Asymmetric Growth Engines

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None

detail.abstract: This paper develops a two-country model showing that even with perfectly balanced trade, countries exporting high value-added goods under increasing returns to scale achieve faster long-run growth than those specializing in low value-added goods. Incorporating learning-by-doing, scale economies, and knowledge spillovers, the model demonstrates that export composition—rather than trade balance or volume—drives growth divergence. The findings highlight how structural differences in production can generate persistent income gaps despite balanced trade.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个两国模型，证明即使在贸易完全平衡的情况下，出口高附加值商品（具有规模报酬递增特性）的国家比专注于低附加值商品的国家能实现更快的长期增长。模型显示出口结构（而非贸易平衡或贸易量）是增长分化的关键驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 在贸易平衡条件下，出口结构（高附加值vs低附加值商品）如何影响国家的长期经济增长？
AI.motivation: 传统贸易理论强调贸易平衡和贸易量对增长的影响，但现实中观察到即使贸易平衡，不同国家间仍存在持续的收入差距。这促使研究者探索出口商品结构（特别是价值增值水平和规模经济特性）对长期增长的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合学习效应（learning-by-doing）、规模经济（increasing returns to scale）和知识溢出（knowledge spillovers）的新贸易理论框架，强调生产结构差异对长期增长路径的影响。
AI.method: 构建理论性的两国模型，纳入学习效应、规模经济和知识溢出机制，分析不同出口结构（高附加值vs低附加值商品）在贸易平衡条件下的长期增长动态。
AI.findings: 1. 即使贸易完全平衡，出口高附加值商品（具有规模报酬递增特性）的国家比出口低附加值商品的国家增长更快；2. 出口结构（而非贸易平衡或贸易量）是增长分化的主要驱动因素；3. 生产结构差异能够解释为何贸易平衡条件下仍存在持续的收入差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 挑战了传统贸易理论对贸易平衡和贸易量的过度关注；2. 将出口结构与内生增长理论结合，提供了新的分析框架；3. 解释了贸易平衡条件下持续收入差距的理论机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了新的视角：关注出口结构升级比单纯追求贸易平衡更重要；2. 解释了发展中国家即使实现贸易平衡仍可能陷入"中等收入陷阱"的原因；3. 为产业政策提供了理论依据，支持发展高附加值、具有规模经济特性的产业。

title: Long Memory in Kenyan Commodity Prices
affiliations: Brunel University London - Department of Economics and Finance,  and University of Navarra - Department of Economics

detail.title: Long Memory in Kenyan Commodity Prices
detail.abstract: This study investigates the long-memory properties of the prices of three Kenyan commodities (tea, coffee and horticultural products) by applying fractional integration methods to monthly data spanning the period from August 1998 to December 2024. The empirical results provide evidence of different degrees of persistence in those series. More specifically, the prices of both coffee and horticultural products appear to be mean-reverting, while tea prices are found to exhibit unit root or near-unit root behaviour, some slight seasonality also being detected in all three cases. The implications of these findings for risk management, policymaking, and market analysis are then discussed.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用分数积分方法分析1998年8月至2024年12月期间肯尼亚三种商品（茶叶、咖啡和园艺产品）价格的长期记忆特性，发现咖啡和园艺产品价格具有均值回归特征，而茶叶价格呈现单位根或近似单位根行为，三种商品均存在轻微季节性。
AI.research_question: 肯尼亚三种主要商品（茶叶、咖啡和园艺产品）价格序列是否具有长期记忆特性？不同商品价格序列的持续性程度有何差异？
AI.motivation: 理解商品价格的长期记忆特性对于风险管理、政策制定和市场分析至关重要。肯尼亚作为重要的农产品出口国，其商品价格动态对经济稳定和农民收入有重要影响，但现有研究对这些商品价格的持续性特征缺乏深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分数积分理论、长期记忆过程、均值回归理论、单位根检验理论、季节性分析
AI.method: 采用分数积分方法分析月度时间序列数据（1998年8月-2024年12月），检验三种肯尼亚商品价格的长期记忆特性，包括持续性程度、均值回归行为和季节性特征。
AI.findings: 1. 咖啡和园艺产品价格呈现均值回归特征，表明冲击对这些价格的影响是暂时的；2. 茶叶价格表现出单位根或近似单位根行为，表明冲击对茶叶价格的影响是持久的；3. 所有三种商品价格均检测到轻微的季节性模式。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将分数积分方法应用于肯尼亚商品价格分析，扩展了长期记忆理论在农产品市场的应用；2. 揭示了不同商品价格持续性特征的异质性，丰富了商品价格动态理论；3. 为理解农产品价格对冲击的响应机制提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为风险管理提供依据：咖啡和园艺产品生产者可采用短期对冲策略，而茶叶生产者需要长期风险管理工具；2. 为政策制定者提供参考：针对不同商品的持续性特征制定差异化的价格稳定政策；3. 为市场参与者提供分析框架：帮助预测不同商品价格对市场冲击的响应模式。

title: State Capacity, Societal Power, and Institutional Coevolution: Estimating the Narrow Corridor

detail.title: State Capacity, Societal Power, and Institutional Coevolution: Estimating the Narrow Corridor
detail.abstract: Can the narrow corridor be identified as a dynamic institutional regime rather than a static institutional score? This paper estimates a two-dimensional law of motion for state capacity and organized societal power, solves for stationary points, and defines the empirical corridor as the basin of attraction of a balanced interior regime. In a panel of 2756 country-years for 173 countries, using annualized 5-year changes, World Bank Government Effectiveness as a contemporary administrative-capacity proxy, and V-Dem civil society participation as a proxy for organized societal power, the fitted system recovers an interior stable point at approximately (0.479, 0.653) together with two saddles. The central geometry is learned on support: the balanced attractor and lower saddle lie close to dense observed country-years, whereas the far upper-right saddle is largely an edge object. The estimated basin is highly persistent in realized five-year transitions, substantially more fragile near its estimated boundary, and informative beyond current institutional levels. An 80-replication two-stage country bootstrap shows that these implications survive propagated first-stage uncertainty, although fragility is less precisely estimated than persistence. The paper's main substantive result is measurement-centered. A corridor-like dynamic geometry is visible when societal power is measured as organized civilsociety participation, but it attenuates sharply under broader rights-based proxies. The paper therefore contributes a model-consistent empirical strategy for studying institutional coevolution and shows that the empirical visibility of the corridor depends critically on how society is measured.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将"狭窄走廊"概念化为动态制度体系而非静态制度评分，通过估计国家能力与社会组织权力的二维动态系统，识别出平衡吸引子及其吸引域，发现走廊的动态几何结构在测量社会组织参与时可见，但在更广泛的权利代理指标下减弱。
AI.research_question: 狭窄走廊能否被识别为动态制度体系而非静态制度评分？如何测量国家能力与社会组织权力的共同演化？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多将制度视为静态评分，缺乏对制度动态演化的实证分析。狭窄走廊理论强调国家能力与社会组织权力的平衡关系，但需要实证验证其动态特性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 狭窄走廊理论（narrow corridor）、制度动态演化理论、国家能力与社会组织权力的共同演化框架
AI.method: 使用173个国家2756个年度数据，估计国家能力（世行政府效能）与社会组织权力（V-Dem公民社会参与）的二维动态系统，求解稳定点，定义经验走廊为平衡内部制度的吸引域，采用80次重复的两阶段国家自助法检验稳健性。
AI.findings: 系统识别出内部稳定点(0.479, 0.653)和两个鞍点；平衡吸引子与下鞍点接近密集观测值，而上右鞍点多为边缘对象；估计的吸引域在五年转换中高度持久，边界附近更脆弱；走廊动态几何在测量公民社会参与时可见，但在更广泛权利代理指标下减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 将狭窄走廊概念化为动态制度体系而非静态评分；提供研究制度共同演化的模型一致经验策略；揭示走廊的经验可见性取决于社会测量方式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供动态制度评估框架；识别制度脆弱性区域；强调社会组织参与测量对制度分析的重要性。

title: Exclusion by Design: Immigrant Racialization and Temporary Legal Status
affiliations: UC Law, San Francisco, Stanford Law School and Cornell University - School of Industrial and Labor Relations

detail.title: Exclusion by Design: Immigrant Racialization and Temporary Legal Status
detail.abstract: Migrant workers enter the United States on temporary visas more often than on green cards that lead to U.S. citizenship, and the majority come from countries whose emigrants would be classified as non-White in the United States. Even so, immigration scholarship gives short shrift to temporary statuses and treats them as race neutral. This Article contributes to the growing body of critical migration studies by demonstrating how immigration law assigns meaning to the legal status of temporary migrants. We find that temporary legal statuses are designed in ways that unnecessarily foster social exclusion through a process of racialization and hierarchical sorting by skills. Our empirical study of the distinctive experiences of three temporary worker categories deepens existing understandings of exclusion and racial subordination in the United States.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究发现，美国临时移民身份制度通过种族化和技能等级排序的方式不必要地助长了社会排斥，挑战了移民研究中对临时身份种族中立的传统观点。
AI.research_question: 临时移民身份如何通过法律设计产生种族化和技能等级排序，从而助长社会排斥？
AI.motivation: 当前移民研究忽视临时身份的重要性，且将其视为种族中立，但现实中大多数临时移民来自非白人国家，需要揭示临时身份制度中的种族化机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判性移民研究、种族化理论、法律社会学、社会排斥理论
AI.method: 实证研究，分析三种临时工人类别的独特经历
AI.findings: 临时法律身份的设计通过种族化和技能等级排序不必要地助长了社会排斥，临时身份制度具有明显的种族化特征
AI.theory_contributions: 将批判性移民研究与临时身份分析相结合，揭示了移民法中临时身份的种族化机制，挑战了临时身份种族中立的传统观点
AI.practical_contributions: 为移民政策改革提供实证依据，揭示临时身份制度如何加剧社会不平等，促进对移民制度中种族化问题的关注

title: ScoreMatchingRiesz for Automatic Debiased Machine Learning and Policy Path Estimation with an Application to Japanese Monetary Policy Evaluation
affiliations: Mizuho-DL Financial Technology Co., Ltd.

detail.title: ScoreMatchingRiesz for Automatic Debiased Machine Learning and Policy Path Estimation with an Application to Japanese Monetary Policy Evaluation
detail.abstract: This study proposes ScoreMatchingRiesz, a score-matching-based approach for Riesz representer estimation in debiased machine learning (DML), and introduces the policy path as a causal parameter that captures continuous treatment effects. The Riesz representer is a key nuisance component in DML, enabling √ n-consistent and asymptotically efficient estimation of causal and structural targets via Neyman-orthogonal scores. We formulate Riesz representer estimation as a score-estimation problem and propose ScoreMatchingRiesz, which facilitates estimation of the average marginal effect (AME) and the average policy effect (APE). In addition, we define the policy path, a parameter that captures how policy effects evolve under continuous treatments and connects the AME and APE. Using ScoreMatchingRiesz and the policy path, we analyze how Japanese monetary policy shocks affect potential GDP over the mid-and long-term. Through this analysis, we document the time structure of monetary policy absorption across different sizes of policy shocks. Note that the AME and the policy path generalize impulse responses, and our method can be interpreted as a nonlinear, semiparametric version of the local projection method.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ScoreMatchingRiesz方法，用于去偏机器学习中的Riesz表示器估计，并引入政策路径作为捕捉连续处理效应的因果参数。该方法能够估计平均边际效应和平均政策效应，并通过日本货币政策冲击分析展示了其在实证研究中的应用。
AI.research_question: 如何通过score-matching方法有效估计去偏机器学习中的Riesz表示器，并利用政策路径参数分析连续处理效应？
AI.motivation: Riesz表示器是去偏机器学习中的关键干扰参数，能够实现√n一致且渐近有效的因果和结构目标估计。现有方法在估计连续处理效应方面存在局限，需要更灵活的非参数方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Neyman正交得分理论，Riesz表示器理论，去偏机器学习框架，以及政策路径作为连接平均边际效应和平均政策效应的连续处理效应参数。
AI.method: ScoreMatchingRiesz方法：将Riesz表示器估计转化为得分估计问题，使用得分匹配技术。应用于日本货币政策冲击对潜在GDP的中长期影响分析。
AI.findings: 1) ScoreMatchingRiesz能够有效估计平均边际效应和平均政策效应；2) 政策路径揭示了不同规模政策冲击下货币政策吸收的时间结构；3) 该方法可解释为非线性半参数版本的局部投影方法。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出基于得分匹配的Riesz表示器估计新方法；2) 引入政策路径作为连续处理效应的因果参数；3) 将平均边际效应和政策路径推广为脉冲响应的泛化形式。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提供分析连续处理效应的实用工具；2) 应用于日本货币政策冲击的实证研究；3) 为政策制定者提供量化政策效果演变的框架。

title: Beyond Climate Compliance: Procedural Fairness, Exporter Inclusion, and Dispute Prevention under the EU Carbon Border adjustment Mechanism
affiliations: University of Coimbra Institute for Legal Research

detail.title: Beyond Climate Compliance: Procedural Fairness, Exporter Inclusion, and Dispute Prevention under the EU Carbon Border adjustment Mechanism
detail.abstract: Carbon border measures—particularly emissions-based border adjustment regimes—operate in practice as hybrid instruments: while justified as climate policy, they impose compliance duties, assessments, monetary liabilities, penalties, and review processes that resemble those of tax and customs administration. This hybrid design poses governance and legitimacy challenges for “fair and free trade” agendas: if procedures are opaque, discretionary, or excessively burdensome, carbon border measures may exclude smaller exporters, deepen North–South asymmetries, and increase the likelihood of disputes in trade and investment fora. This article develops a conceptual fair-treatment framework for carbon border measures, focusing on procedural fairness and dispute prevention for exporters, with particular attention to EU–Latin America trade relations. The article makes three contributions. First, it maps the exporter’s procedural journey and identifies recurring friction points (scope and classification, emissions methodology, verification, correction windows, assessments, penalties, and review). Second, it proposes a Fair Treatment Procedural Matrix that sets minimum safeguards across stages: notice and guidance, access to evidence, an opportunity to respond and cure, reasoned decision-making, proportional enforcement, and effective appeal. Third, it offers a dispute-prevention toolkit grounded in transparency, cooperative compliance, mutual recognition of verification, phased implementation, and proportionality-based cost mitigation. The framework provides policymakers with actionable guidance to reconcile environmental ambition with governance, legitimacy, and inclusive participation in international trade.

AI.tldr: 本文提出碳边境措施的公平处理框架，关注程序公平和争端预防，特别针对欧盟-拉美贸易关系，旨在协调环境目标与贸易治理的合法性。
AI.research_question: 碳边境措施作为混合政策工具，如何通过程序公平框架解决其治理和合法性挑战，防止贸易争端并促进包容性参与？
AI.motivation: 碳边境措施在实践中作为混合工具运作，兼具气候政策和税收/海关管理特征，可能导致程序不透明、负担过重，排除小型出口商，加深南北不对称，增加贸易投资争端风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 程序公平理论、贸易治理理论、环境政策与贸易规则协调理论、南北不对称理论、争端预防机制理论。
AI.method: 概念框架开发方法：1) 映射出口商程序路径并识别摩擦点；2) 提出公平处理程序矩阵；3) 构建争端预防工具包。
AI.findings: 识别了碳边境措施的七个关键摩擦点：范围与分类、排放方法学、验证、纠正窗口、评估、处罚和审查。提出了包含六个最低保障措施的公平处理程序矩阵和基于透明度、合作合规等原则的争端预防工具包。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将程序公平理论应用于碳边境措施治理；2) 发展了混合政策工具治理框架；3) 为环境-贸易政策协调提供新理论视角；4) 丰富了南北不对称治理的理论分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供可操作的公平治理指南；2) 帮助出口商应对碳边境措施合规挑战；3) 促进欧盟-拉美贸易关系的稳定发展；4) 减少贸易投资争端风险；5) 支持小型出口商参与全球低碳贸易。

title: Artificial intelligence and medical products. The case of drug discovery in the AI domain
affiliations: Scuola Universitaria Superiore Sant'Anna

detail.title: Artificial intelligence and medical products. The case of drug discovery in the AI domain
detail.abstract: The transition from traditional to AI-driven drug discovery is reshaping pharmaceutical research, with companies increasingly relying on machine learning and deep learning systems to accelerate the identification and optimisation of therapeutic candidates. This technological shift places renewed pressure on the legal framework governing patent disclosure. Under Article 83 EPC, the patent bargain requires applicants to disclose their inventions clearly and completely enough for a skilled person to reproduce them without undue burden. In the pharmaceutical sector, this has traditionally involved providing empirical evidence that a claimed compound plausibly achieves its therapeutic effect. However, AI-driven discovery often generates candidate molecules before any wet-lab validation exists, raising the question of whether in silico data alone can satisfy the sufficiency-of-disclosure requirement. A further challenge concerns whether applicants must disclose the AI models or training data used to generate such candidates. This chapter contributes to the emerging debate by reexamining sufficiency of disclosure for AI-driven drug inventions under European patent law. It pursues two objectives: first, to clarify how current disclosure standards are interpreted and applied to AI-driven pharmaceutical inventions; and second, to assess whether these standards remain fit for purpose in an era of increasingly data-driven and computational drug discovery. The chapter offers policy-oriented reflections on how European patent law can balance incentives for innovation with safeguards against overly broad or speculative claims, and concludes with practical guidance for practitioners drafting and prosecuting patent applications in the field of AI-driven drug discovery.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨AI驱动药物发现对欧洲专利法第83条充分披露要求的挑战，分析计算机数据是否满足披露标准，以及是否需要披露AI模型和训练数据，为实践者提供指导。
AI.research_question: AI驱动的药物发明在多大程度上满足欧洲专利法第83条的充分披露要求？计算机数据是否足以满足披露标准？申请人是否需要披露AI模型和训练数据？
AI.motivation: 传统药物发现向AI驱动模式的转变对专利披露法律框架构成压力。AI系统在湿实验室验证前生成候选分子，引发计算机数据是否满足充分披露要求的问题，以及是否需要披露AI模型和训练数据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧洲专利公约第83条（充分披露要求）、专利契约理论（申请人披露发明以换取垄断权）、药物专利中的合理可信标准、AI驱动药物发现的法律框架分析。
AI.method: 法律分析、政策导向反思、案例研究、比较分析。通过重新审视欧洲专利法下的充分披露要求，分析当前标准如何解释和应用于AI驱动的药物发明。
AI.findings: AI驱动药物发现对传统充分披露标准构成挑战；计算机数据可能不足以满足第83条要求；披露AI模型和训练数据的要求存在法律不确定性；当前标准可能不适应数据驱动药物发现时代。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新审视AI驱动药物发明的充分披露理论框架；分析专利契约理论在AI时代的适用性；为欧洲专利法适应技术变革提供理论依据；探讨合理可信标准在计算机数据背景下的演变。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者起草和申请AI驱动药物发现专利提供实践指导；提出平衡创新激励与防止过度宽泛或投机性主张的政策建议；帮助申请人应对披露要求的法律挑战；促进专利制度适应AI驱动的药物研发。

title: Demand Drivers of Central Bank Liquidity: A Time-to-Exit TLTRO Analysis
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB) and Banco de España

detail.title: Demand Drivers of Central Bank Liquidity: A Time-to-Exit TLTRO Analysis

publicationDetails.detailsText: Banco de Espana Working Paper No. 2548
publicationDetails.journalName: Banco de Espana Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: We exploit banks’ early repayments of targeted longer-term refinancing operations (TLTRO) following the program’s recalibration in October 2022 as a laboratory to uncover demand drivers of central bank liquidity. We formulate and estimate a discrete-time hazard model to early exit from TLTRO to identify what bank (country) characteristics drive a sticky, prolonged demand for central bank (long-term) operations as opposed to an early exit from such facilities. We also examine whether the more liquidity-risk exposed banks during the TLTRO phasing out period had a higher probability of becoming “liquidity dependent” on the ECB when exiting (Acharya et al., 2023). Finally, we discuss the policy implications of our findings, particularly in the context of the recent review of the ECB’s operational framework.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用TLTRO计划调整后银行提前还款行为，分析央行流动性需求驱动因素，识别哪些银行特征导致对央行长期操作的粘性需求，并探讨流动性风险暴露银行是否更可能依赖ECB流动性
AI.research_question: 哪些银行（国家）特征驱动对央行长期操作的粘性需求（而非提前退出）？流动性风险暴露银行在退出TLTRO时是否更可能依赖ECB流动性？
AI.motivation: 理解央行流动性需求驱动因素对货币政策传导和金融稳定至关重要，特别是在ECB操作框架审查背景下，需要了解银行对央行长期操作的依赖行为
AI.theoretical_framework: 离散时间风险模型（discrete-time hazard model），流动性依赖理论（Acharya et al., 2023），央行流动性操作理论
AI.method: 利用2022年10月TLTRO计划调整后银行提前还款的自然实验，构建离散时间风险模型估计银行提前退出TLTRO的概率，分析银行和国家特征的影响
AI.findings: 识别了导致对央行长期操作粘性需求的银行特征；发现流动性风险暴露银行在退出TLTRO时更可能依赖ECB流动性；揭示了不同银行对央行流动性需求的异质性
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了央行流动性需求理论，为理解银行对央行长期操作的依赖行为提供新视角，丰富了流动性依赖理论的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 为ECB操作框架审查提供实证依据，帮助央行设计更有效的流动性操作工具，提高货币政策传导效率，增强金融稳定

title: Effective Families or Effective Schools? Experimental Evidence on Fostering Children's Numeracy
affiliations: ,  and Stockholm University

detail.title: Effective Families or Effective Schools? Experimental Evidence on Fostering Children's Numeracy
detail.abstract: We study the relative effectiveness, cost-effectiveness, and interaction of family- and school-based learning interventions using a randomized controlled trial in Colombia that assigns children to a parental engagement program, a teacher professional development program, both, or a control group. Both interventions are grounded in a child-centered learning approach that emphasizes active engagement and the progression from informal to formal mathematical understanding. Each intervention independently generates sizable and statistically similar gains in early numeracy (0.17SD and 0.20SD). Combining them produces no additional learning gains, suggesting that the two interventions act as substitutes over the time horizon and skill domain we study. When benefits accruing to future cohorts are taken into account, the teacher development program becomes at least as cost-effective as, and potentially more cost-effective than, the parental engagement intervention. Our results suggest that, in this setting, strategically concentrating resources on a single binding constraint -- either at home or in school -- maximizes the short-run learning gains per dollar spent.

AI.tldr: 在哥伦比亚进行的随机对照试验显示，家长参与项目和教师专业发展项目各自都能显著提升儿童早期数学能力（0.17SD和0.20SD），但两者结合没有额外增益。考虑到未来队列的收益，教师发展项目比家长参与项目更具成本效益。研究建议集中资源解决单一约束（家庭或学校）能最大化短期学习收益。
AI.research_question: 家长参与项目和教师专业发展项目在提升儿童早期数学能力方面的相对有效性、成本效益以及两者之间的交互作用是什么？
AI.motivation: 需要了解在资源有限的教育环境中，如何最有效地分配资源来提升儿童早期数学能力，以及家庭和学校干预措施之间的相互作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以儿童为中心的学习方法，强调主动参与和从非正式到正式数学理解的渐进过程。
AI.method: 在哥伦比亚进行的随机对照试验，将儿童分配到四组：家长参与项目组、教师专业发展项目组、两者结合组、对照组。
AI.findings: 1. 两个干预措施各自都能产生显著且统计上相似的早期数学能力提升（0.17SD和0.20SD）；2. 结合两种干预没有产生额外的学习增益，表明两者在研究的时间范围和技能领域内是替代关系；3. 考虑到未来队列的收益，教师发展项目至少与家长参与项目同样成本有效，甚至可能更具成本效益。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证了家庭和学校干预措施在提升儿童早期数学能力方面的替代关系；2. 提供了在资源约束下教育干预策略的理论依据；3. 强调了考虑跨队列收益对成本效益评估的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为教育决策者提供了资源分配策略：集中资源解决单一约束（家庭或学校）能最大化短期学习收益；2. 在类似环境中，教师专业发展项目可能是更具成本效益的选择；3. 避免同时投资于家庭和学校干预，除非有证据表明两者有互补效应。

title: U.S. Consumers' Financial Exposure to Fraud and Scams
affiliations: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau

detail.title: U.S. Consumers' Financial Exposure to Fraud and Scams

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The views expressed are the views of the author and not necessarily the views of the CFPB or the United States. This work was completed on a public data set without using government resources and was not reviewed by the CFPB.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no financial support for the research, authorship, or publication of this article.

detail.abstract: Losses from financial fraud and scams are among the largest financial concerns of American consumers. Using a nationally representative survey, this article estimates that 20 percent of consumers lost money to a fraud or scam in 2024. Among people who lost money, the total annual loss before any recovery was $2,790. Altogether, 51 million Americans lost $135 billion to fraud or scams in 2024 and $96 billion was unrecoverable. Experiencing a fraud or scam is associated with significantly lower financial well-being and 13 percentage points higher likelihood to report having difficulty with a bill or expense. Low-income households are particularly exposed to fraud and scams but people over age 60 are not statistically more likely to experience a fraud or scam. While most people who experience a fraud or scam report it to their financial institution, only 11 percent report to a credit bureau and 6.4 percent report to a federal agency. Because of this under-reporting, policies to prevent, deter, and detect fraud and scams are even more important than previously understood.

AI.tldr: 2024年美国消费者金融欺诈损失严重：20%消费者受害，总损失1350亿美元，其中960亿美元无法追回，导致财务福祉显著下降。
AI.research_question: 美国消费者金融欺诈与诈骗的普遍程度、经济损失规模及其对财务福祉的影响如何？不同人群（如低收入家庭、老年人）的受害风险是否存在差异？欺诈事件的报告率如何？
AI.motivation: 金融欺诈和诈骗是美国消费者最大的财务关切之一，但现有数据可能低估了问题的严重性，需要更准确的全国性评估来指导政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者金融保护、行为经济学（欺诈受害者的行为特征）、社会人口学（不同群体的受害风险差异）以及犯罪报告理论（欺诈事件报告率的影响因素）。
AI.method: 采用全国代表性调查方法，收集2024年美国消费者金融欺诈受害情况、经济损失、恢复情况、财务福祉影响及报告行为等数据。
AI.findings: 1. 20%消费者在2024年遭受金融欺诈损失；2. 总损失1350亿美元，其中960亿美元无法追回；3. 受害导致财务福祉显著下降，账单支付困难概率增加13个百分点；4. 低收入家庭风险更高，但60岁以上老年人受害率无统计显著差异；5. 报告率低：仅11%报告给征信机构，6.4%报告给联邦机构。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提供了金融欺诈受害率的准确全国性估计；2. 揭示了欺诈受害与财务福祉的因果关系；3. 挑战了"老年人更易受害"的普遍认知；4. 量化了欺诈事件的严重低报告率问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了欺诈预防、威慑和检测的实证依据；2. 强调了提高欺诈报告率的重要性；3. 指出需要特别关注低收入家庭的保护措施；4. 建议加强金融机构在欺诈预防中的作用。

title: Europe's Energy Interests and the Authoritarian Trade-off
affiliations: Economic Research Center (ERC)

detail.title: Europe's Energy Interests and the Authoritarian Trade-off
detail.abstract: In response to Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, the European Union has accelerated efforts to diversify its energy supply and reduce structural dependence on Russian gas. Within this strategy, Azerbaijan has emerged as a significant alternative supplier through the Southern Gas Corridor and the 2022 EU-Azerbaijan Memorandum of Understanding, which sets a target of increasing gas exports to 20 bcm annually by 2027. Azerbaijani pipeline gas deliveries to the EU rose from 8.2 bcm in 2021 to 12.8 bcm in 2025, elevating Azerbaijan to the position of the EU's fifth-largest external pipeline supplier. This expansion of energy cooperation has coincided with a pronounced deterioration in Azerbaijan's human rights environment. Since mid-2022, the number of political prisoners has increased substantially, while European institutions-including the European Parliament, the Parliamentary Assembly of the Council of Europe, and the European Court of Human Rightshave documented persistent violations of fundamental freedoms. The article examines the structural tension between the EU's energy security imperatives and its normative commitments to democracy, rule of law, and human rights. It advances the concept of an "authoritarian trade-off," whereby strategic diversification objectives may inadvertently reinforce authoritarian governance in supplier states. The analysis argues that the absence of enforceable conditionality in EU-Azerbaijan energy agreements risks undermining the Union's normative credibility. It concludes that embedding transparency requirements, governance reforms, and human rights conditionality into future energy frameworks is essential for aligning the EU's strategic interests with its foundational values.

AI.tldr: 欧盟为应对俄乌战争加速能源供应多元化，阿塞拜疆成为重要替代供应商。但能源合作扩张与阿塞拜疆人权状况恶化同时发生，文章探讨欧盟能源安全需求与规范性承诺之间的结构性张力，提出"威权主义权衡"概念，认为缺乏可执行的条件性条款会损害欧盟规范可信度。
AI.research_question: 欧盟能源安全需求与民主、法治、人权等规范性承诺之间的结构性张力如何影响其与阿塞拜疆的能源合作？
AI.motivation: 俄乌战争后欧盟加速能源供应多元化，阿塞拜疆成为重要替代供应商，但与此同时阿塞拜疆人权状况显著恶化，引发欧盟战略利益与规范性价值之间的冲突。
AI.theoretical_framework: "威权主义权衡"概念：战略多元化目标可能无意中强化供应国的威权治理；欧盟规范性权力理论；能源安全与民主促进之间的张力。
AI.method: 政策分析：分析欧盟-阿塞拜疆能源协议（特别是2022年谅解备忘录）；比较能源合作扩张与人权状况恶化的时间关联；评估欧盟机构（欧洲议会、欧洲人权法院等）的监督报告。
AI.findings: 阿塞拜疆对欧盟管道天然气供应从2021年82亿立方米增至2025年128亿立方米，成为欧盟第五大外部管道供应商；与此同时阿塞拜疆政治犯数量大幅增加，基本自由持续受侵犯；欧盟-阿塞拜疆能源协议缺乏可执行的人权条件性条款。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"威权主义权衡"概念框架，解释能源安全战略如何可能强化威权治理；深化对欧盟规范性权力在能源安全背景下局限性的理解；为国际关系中战略利益与规范性承诺的张力提供新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议将透明度要求、治理改革和人权条件性条款嵌入未来能源合作框架；为欧盟政策制定者提供平衡能源安全与规范性价值的实用指南；警示缺乏条件性条款可能损害欧盟规范可信度。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Personalized Learning: Opportunities and Challenges
affiliations: Hurix Digital, Andheri, India

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Personalized Learning: Opportunities and Challenges
detail.abstract: Conventional education systems are progressively becoming unsuccessful during catering to the heterogeneous learning requirements of different pupil groups, generating overall gaps in attainment, involvement, and knowledge retentions within the education systems. Artificial intelligence (AI) has proven to be a paradigm shift to providing personalized learning experiences in large scale. This literature review is a systematic review of articles and theoretical literature published throughout 2019 to 2025 and retrieved via Scopus, Web of Science, IEEE Xplore, and PubMed. Taking the method of PRISMA 2020, 1,247 records were identified and further narrowed down to 87 studies that are included after thorough evaluation of eligibility criteria. The article pinpoints the more prevalent AI methods used in personalized learning, such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, knowledge graphs, and discusses their effectiveness in a variety of learning institutions, such as K-12 institutions to post educational institutions, and business training. The main conclusions are that the AI systems lead to significant changes in the outcomes of learners, both the adaptive delivery of the content and realtime feedback, but also the highly critical issues concerning algorithmic bias, privacy, integration of teaching and learning, and fairness. The article also discusses regulatory and ethical policies of AI in learning, identifies existing gaps of implementation, and reports on the future lines of research, such as explainable AI, federated learning to support privacy, and cross-cultural adaptability. Through integrated work across the fields of computer science, cognitive science, education policy, and ethics, the authors of the reviewed article believe that the optimal way to harness the potential of AI-driven personalized learning is interdisciplinary.

AI.tldr: 这篇文献综述系统分析了2019-2025年间AI在个性化学习中的应用，总结了主要AI方法、效果、挑战及未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: AI在个性化学习中的应用现状如何？包括哪些主要方法、效果、挑战和未来发展方向？
AI.motivation: 传统教育系统难以满足学生群体的异质性学习需求，导致学业成就、参与度和知识保留方面的差距。AI为大规模个性化学习提供了范式转变的机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 个性化学习理论、自适应学习系统理论、教育技术整合理论、AI伦理与公平性理论
AI.method: 采用PRISMA 2020方法的系统性文献综述，从Scopus、Web of Science、IEEE Xplore和PubMed数据库中筛选了1,247条记录，最终纳入87项研究进行分析
AI.findings:
1. AI系统显著改善学习者成果，通过内容自适应和实时反馈
2. 主要AI方法包括机器学习、深度学习、自然语言处理、知识图谱
3. 应用范围涵盖K-12教育到高等教育及企业培训
4. 存在算法偏见、隐私、教学整合和公平性等关键问题
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 系统梳理了AI个性化学习的研究现状和理论框架
2. 识别了跨学科整合的理论需求（计算机科学、认知科学、教育政策、伦理学）
3. 提出了AI教育应用的伦理和政策理论框架
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为教育机构实施AI个性化学习提供方法指导
2. 识别了实施过程中的关键挑战和解决方案
3. 提出了未来研究方向：可解释AI、联邦学习保护隐私、跨文化适应性
4. 为政策制定者提供AI教育应用的监管和伦理建议

title: Chemo-kinematic Tomography of the Milky Way using APOGEE, GALAH, and Gaia DR3

detail.title: Chemo-kinematic Tomography of the Milky Way using APOGEE, GALAH, and Gaia DR3

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or animal subjects and did not require ethics approval. All data used are from publicly accessible astronomical surveys.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author developed this work independently.

detail.abstract:
The Milky Way provides a uniquely resolved laboratory for chemo-dynamical studies of galaxy assembly. We present chemo-kinematic tomography of 468,000 stars from APOGEE DR17, GALAH DR3, and Gaia DR3, combining four-dimensional chemical-space Gaussian mixture modelling (GMM) with independent dynamical validation in action and integral-of-motion space, and bootstrap uncertainty quantification throughout. This orthogonal classification architecture — rather than reliance on hard-coded kinematic thresholds alone — is the central methodological advance. We identify four distinct structural components and decompose the chemically anomalous population (CAP) into Gaia Sausage-Enceladus (GSE) debris (~34 ± 3%), Sequoia debris (~8 ± 2%), and in-situ 'Splash' stars (~58 ± 5%, systematic-inclusive). The Starlight Synthesis Algorithm recovers a two-episode star-formation history compatible with a quiescent interval of Δt ≈ 2–4 Gyr at z ≈ 1.5–2.0, and a thin-disc radial metallicity gradient consistent with inside-out formation (d[Fe/H]/dR = −0.065 ± 0.004 dex kpc⁻¹). These fossil constraints may be compared with future JWST observations of Milky Way analogues at comparable redshift.

Supplementary Data: Supporting figures, summary population statistics, and the Python implementation of the Starlight Synthesis Algorithm (SSA) are available via Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19202883

AI.tldr: 该研究利用APOGEE DR17、GALAH DR3和Gaia DR3的468,000颗恒星数据，通过四维化学空间高斯混合模型与动力学验证相结合的方法，识别了银河系的结构成分，并重建了银河系的恒星形成历史。
AI.research_question: 如何通过化学-运动学断层扫描技术识别银河系的结构成分，并重建其恒星形成历史？
AI.motivation: 银河系作为唯一能够进行高分辨率化学动力学研究的星系，为理解星系组装过程提供了独特实验室。现有方法多依赖硬编码的运动学阈值，需要更正交的分类架构来准确识别结构成分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于化学空间高斯混合模型(GMM)与动力学验证的正交分类架构，结合作用量和运动积分空间的独立验证，以及自举不确定性量化。
AI.method: 整合APOGEE DR17、GALAH DR3和Gaia DR3的468,000颗恒星数据，采用四维化学空间高斯混合模型，结合作用量和运动积分空间的动力学验证，使用自举法进行不确定性量化，并应用星光合成算法重建恒星形成历史。
AI.findings: 识别出四个不同的结构成分；将化学异常群体分解为Gaia香肠-恩克拉多斯碎片(~34±3%)、红杉碎片(~8±2%)和原位"Splash"恒星(~58±5%)；星光合成算法恢复了两阶段的恒星形成历史，显示在z≈1.5-2.0时存在Δt≈2-4 Gyr的静止期；薄盘径向金属丰度梯度为-0.065±0.004 dex kpc⁻¹，支持由内向外形成模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了正交分类架构方法学创新，避免了仅依赖硬编码运动学阈值；建立了化学-运动学断层扫描框架；为银河系组装历史提供了新的化石约束。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了星光合成算法的Python实现；生成了支持性图表和群体统计摘要；为未来JWST观测银河系类似星系提供了比较基准；数据和方法通过Zenodo公开可用。

title: Compliance Silence: How Healthcare Oversight Responds to Harm Without Breaking the Law

detail.title: Compliance Silence: How Healthcare Oversight Responds to Harm Without Breaking the Law

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The Author declares no known competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human subjects, clinical trials, or identifiable private data and therefore did not require institutional ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: The Author received no external financial support for this research.

detail.abstract: Despite extensive regulatory infrastructure, U.S. healthcare oversight systems con nue to tolerate significant pa ent harm without correc ve ac on. While agencies rou nely detect criminal misconduct, billing fraud, and sen nel events, they remain largely unresponsive to cumula ve, non-criminal harm arising from delayed care, dismissive treatment, documenta on minimiza on, and ins tu onal nonresponse. These harms dispropor onately affect Black pa ents but also extend broadly to other marginalized and vulnerable popula ons. This paper introduces Compliance Silence Theory, a novel compliance framework that conceptualizes regulatory non-response not as oversight failure or enforcement neglect, but as a structural outcome produced by enforcement thresholds, documenta on dependence, and ins tu onal self-monitoring. Using Black healthcare history as longitudinal evidence and a contemporary de-iden fied case study as a modern compliance specimen, the paper demonstrates how oversight systems are designed to acknowledge harm while remaining legally inert. By naming Compliance Silence as a measurable governance outcome, this work provides regulators, policymakers, and scholars with a new analy c lens for evalua ng accountability beyond formal legality.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出"合规沉默理论"，解释美国医疗监管系统如何系统性容忍非刑事伤害（如延迟治疗、歧视性对待等），特别是对黑人和其他边缘化群体的伤害，而非监管失败。
AI.research_question: 为什么美国医疗监管系统在检测到刑事不当行为的同时，却对累积性、非刑事的伤害（如延迟治疗、歧视性对待、文档最小化、机构无回应）保持沉默？
AI.motivation: 尽管有广泛的监管基础设施，美国医疗监督系统继续容忍严重的患者伤害而不采取纠正行动，这些伤害不成比例地影响黑人患者并扩展到其他边缘化群体。
AI.theoretical_framework: 合规沉默理论 - 将监管无响应概念化为结构性结果，由执行阈值、文档依赖和机构自我监控产生，而非监管失败或执法疏忽。
AI.method: 使用黑人医疗历史作为纵向证据，以及当代去识别化的案例研究作为现代合规样本。
AI.findings: 监督系统被设计为承认伤害的同时在法律上保持惰性，合规沉默是可测量的治理结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出合规沉默理论作为新的合规框架，为评估超越形式合法性的问责制提供新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者、政策制定者和学者提供评估问责制的新工具，识别系统性容忍非刑事伤害的结构性机制。

title: Engineering State and Economic Warriors: A Manifesto for a 21st-Century African Statecraft
affiliations: Desiderio Consultants Ltd.

detail.title: Engineering State and Economic Warriors: A Manifesto for a 21st-Century African Statecraft
detail.abstract: This paper provides a visionary blueprint for building the institutional capacity necessary for Africa’s long-term transformation. It explores how the functional principles of the Chinese “engineering state” can be adapted to the African developmental context to address persistent execution gaps and complex development challenges. The model focuses on building a high-performance “capability layer "within national, regional, and continental institutions by embedding technical talent—or "Economic Warriors"—at the core of their structures. This approach applies systems thinking and coordinated long-term strategic planning to master cross-border projects that are essential for regional integration and for exerting geoeconomic leverage. An Africa-adapted approach combines strong national delivery units with regional centers of excellence, fosters public–private talent circulation, and leverages digital tools to enhance strategic influence. Ultimately, this framework seeks to reconcile technocratic precision with social accountability, enabling African states to become proactive architects of an inclusive and strategically decisive growth trajectory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个将中国"工程国家"功能原则适应非洲发展背景的蓝图，通过建立"能力层"和嵌入"经济战士"技术人才，解决执行差距和复杂发展挑战，促进区域整合和地缘经济影响力。
AI.research_question: 如何将中国"工程国家"的功能原则适应非洲发展背景，以解决持续的执行差距和复杂发展挑战，建立制度能力支持非洲长期转型？
AI.motivation: 非洲面临持续的执行差距和复杂发展挑战，需要有效的制度能力来支持长期转型。中国"工程国家"模式在推动发展方面显示出成效，但需要适应非洲的具体背景。
AI.theoretical_framework: 中国"工程国家"理论、制度能力建设理论、系统思维、长期战略规划理论、区域整合理论、地缘经济学理论。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建，基于系统思维和比较制度分析，提出适应性模型设计。
AI.findings: 提出一个非洲适应的框架，包括：在国家、区域和大陆层面建立高性能"能力层"；嵌入"经济战士"技术人才；结合国家交付单位和区域卓越中心；促进公私人才流动；利用数字工具增强战略影响力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将中国"工程国家"理论扩展到非洲发展背景，提出技术官僚精确性与社会问责制相协调的理论框架，丰富了制度能力建设和区域发展理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲国家提供了具体的制度设计蓝图：建立能力层、培养技术人才、实施长期战略规划、促进区域整合项目、增强地缘经济影响力，使非洲国家能够主动塑造包容性和战略决定性的增长轨迹。

title: Reconceptualising Homelessness Legislation in England

detail.title: Reconceptualising Homelessness Legislation in England
detail.abstract: This article has two central aims. First, it problematises the long-held consensus that homelessness legislation in England operates according to the concept of need and, secondly, it advances an alternative reading and reconceptualisation of homelessness legislation according to the notion of risk. Through examination of the two major sources of current homelessness law, the Housing Act 1996 and the recently-enacted Homelessness Reduction Act 2017, this article locates and explores how risk is operationalised, the precise conceptions of risk engaged and the implications and potentiality of this risk reconceptualisation. In so doing, it is argued that risk exhibits a stronger explanatory power of the current homelessness legislation than need and presents opportunities for how we understand local authority decision-making and the shape of future reform.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了英格兰无家可归者立法基于"需求"概念的传统共识，提出应以"风险"概念重新解读和重构相关立法，并通过分析《1996年住房法》和《2017年无家可归者减少法》论证风险概念具有更强的解释力。
AI.research_question: 英格兰无家可归者立法是基于"需求"还是"风险"概念运作？风险概念如何被操作化，其具体内涵是什么，以及这种风险重构的启示和潜力是什么？
AI.motivation: 挑战长期以来认为英格兰无家可归者立法基于"需求"概念的共识，提出需要重新审视和重构立法框架，以更准确地理解当前立法实践和未来改革方向。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险理论，特别是风险操作化、风险概念的具体内涵，以及风险与需求概念的对比分析框架。
AI.method: 法律文本分析，通过检视《1996年住房法》和《2017年无家可归者减少法》这两大主要法律来源，探讨风险如何被操作化。
AI.findings: 风险概念在当前无家可归者立法中具有更强的解释力；风险被具体操作化并体现在立法中；这种风险重构有助于理解地方当局的决策过程并为未来改革提供方向。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了从"需求"到"风险"的范式转变，为理解无家可归者立法提供了新的理论视角；发展了风险操作化的分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解地方当局决策过程提供新视角；为未来立法改革提供理论依据；有助于政策制定者重新思考无家可归者政策的制定和实施。

title: Desert and Redemption: The Homelessness Masterplot

detail.title: Desert and Redemption: The Homelessness Masterplot
detail.abstract: This chapter deploys the masterplot frame to the field of homelessness law and policy in England. It locates and exposes the 'homelessness masterplot' as a super-narrative of desert and redemption that can be traced back centuries to the time of the Black Death yet survives and continues to sound in our contemporary law. The chapter isolates, elucidates and tracks this homelessness masterplot through law, policy and political rhetoric from the 14 th century to the present day revealing the longevity, durability and potency of this powerful narrative in the homelessness sphere. This is the first time the masterplot analytical lens has been engaged in the homelessness arena and, as such, offers new insights and a fascinating way of 'seeing' homelessness law differently at a time when homelessness is more prevalent and pressing than ever and, on one view, existing homelessness policy in England has, at best, stalled and, at worst, failed.

AI.tldr: 本文首次运用"主导情节"分析框架研究英格兰无家可归法律与政策，揭示了从14世纪黑死病时期延续至今的"无家可归主导情节"——一个关于应得与救赎的超级叙事，并展示了这一叙事在法律、政策和政治修辞中的持久影响力。
AI.research_question: 英格兰无家可归法律与政策中是否存在一个跨越数个世纪的"主导情节"或超级叙事？这个叙事如何塑造了当代的无家可归法律与政策？
AI.motivation: 当前英格兰无家可归问题日益严重且紧迫，现有政策停滞甚至失败，需要新的分析视角来重新审视无家可归法律，以提供新的见解和不同的"看待"方式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主导情节分析框架——将"主导情节"概念应用于无家可归研究领域，识别和追踪跨越历史时期的超级叙事结构。
AI.method: 历史文本分析——通过分析14世纪至今的法律文本、政策文件和政洽修辞，识别、阐明并追踪"无家可归主导情节"的演变轨迹。
AI.findings: 存在一个从14世纪黑死病时期延续至今的"无家可归主导情节"，这是一个关于应得与救赎的超级叙事，具有惊人的持久性、韧性和影响力，持续塑造着当代无家可归法律与政策。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将主导情节分析框架引入无家可归研究领域，为理解无家可归法律与政策提供了新的理论视角和分析工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了历史叙事如何持续影响当代政策，为政策制定者提供了重新审视和改革无家可归政策的理论基础，特别是在当前政策停滞或失败的背景下。

title: Governing 'the Homeless' in English Homelessness Legislation: Foucauldian Governmentality and the Homelessness Reduction Act 2017

detail.title: Governing 'the Homeless' in English Homelessness Legislation: Foucauldian Governmentality and the Homelessness Reduction Act 2017
detail.abstract: This article contributes to the growing body of work exploring governmentality theory in housing and homelessness law by engaging a Foucauldian neoliberal, governmentality framework to the recently-enacted Homelessness Reduction Act 2017. This is the first time this major piece of English homelessness legislation has been examined through a Foucauldian governmentality lens and this article therefore fills a gap in the literature. In so doing, this article locates the place of governmental activity to be scrutinized as the homeless population and contends that the Homelessness Reduction 2017 ('HRA 17') can be interpreted as operating according to three intersecting modes of problematization of the homeless: (1) biopolitical problematization; (2) governmental problematization; and (3) ethical problematization. Drawing on the writings of Dean (1999) , Rose (1999) and Hamann (2009) on neoliberal governmentality and building on the emerging governmentality literature in housing and homelessness law of Cowan and McDermont (2006), Cowan, Pantazis and Gilroy (2001), McKee (2009), Evans (2012) and others, this article explores the insights neoliberal governmentality provides. In so doing, this article reveals that the 2017 Act reflects a shift in neoliberal thinking on housing in constructing images of the homeless as forming a ‘risk population’, subjectified, autonomized individuals; exhorted to self-work and ethical selffashioning as responsibilized citizens taking account of their own housing precarity. This article makes a novel and unique contribution to the scholarship in this field in arguing that the new 2017 legislation can be understood as operating according to an ordering theme of risk. This article proceeds in 4 parts. Part one introduces and unpacks the concept of neoliberal governmentality and reflects on its prescience as a tool for critical understanding of contemporary forms of political and legal governance of homeless populations in England. A second part offers a brief overview of the recently-enacted Homelessness Reduction Act 2017 and its key provisions before a third section operationalizes a neoliberal governmentality framework; locates risk as the organising rationale of the new legislation and explores the three, intersecting problematizations of the homeless at play under the 2017 Act: biopolitical, governmental and ethical.

title: Housing Supply Reform and Services Inflation: Evidence from Minneapolis 2040
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Housing Supply Reform and Services Inflation: Evidence from Minneapolis 2040
detail.abstract:
This paper examines whether housing supply conditions affect the upstream cost driver of non-tradable services inflation. A companion paper (Ellis, 2026c) establishes that rent inflation systematically forecasts services inflation but not tradable goods prices in the same city under identical specifications — evidence consistent with a selective cost transmission mechanism operating through occupancy costs. The present paper asks a distinct question: what happens when the upstream rent pressure is altered by policy?

Minneapolis’s 2040 comprehensive plan, which eliminated single-family zoning citywide beginning in 2019, provides a natural experiment. Following the reform, Minneapolis rent growth slowed by approximately 0.9 percentage points relative to Midwest controls, with an average divergence of 1.8 percentage points in the post-completion period. Official BLS shelter CPI for Minneapolis rose 1.34 percentage points less than the national average over the same period. Minneapolis all-items CPI inflation of 2.51% post-reform compares to 5.26% national services inflation, a gap consistent with attenuated upstream cost pressure.

Cross-metro evidence using Saiz (2010) elasticity scores reveals a more nuanced transmission pattern than a simple constrained-versus-elastic comparison. Constrained metros transmit rent shocks into services inflation faster (6–9 months); elastic metros transmit later but more strongly (15–18 months). This lag heterogeneity explains why the aggregate 12-month lead in national time-series evidence reflects a composite of different supply regimes rather than a single transmission horizon.

The results should be interpreted as comparative statics on the upstream variable: the mechanism through which housing costs propagate into services prices is documented elsewhere; this paper establishes that reducing housing cost growth through supply reform attenuates the input into that mechanism. The contribution is not a macro policy claim but a micro identification of the upstream stage of a broader inflation process.

AI.tldr: 明尼阿波利斯市2019年取消独户住宅分区限制后，租金增长放缓约0.9个百分点，导致服务通胀压力减弱，揭示了住房供应改革如何通过影响上游租金成本来抑制服务通胀的机制。
AI.research_question: 当上游租金压力因政策改变时，住房供应条件如何影响非贸易服务通胀的成本驱动因素？
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明租金通胀能预测服务通胀而非贸易商品价格，表明存在通过占用成本的选择性成本传导机制。本文旨在探究当上游租金压力因政策干预而改变时会发生什么。
AI.theoretical_framework: 住房供应约束理论、成本传导机制理论、自然实验设计、比较静态分析框架
AI.method: 使用明尼阿波利斯市2019年取消独户住宅分区限制的自然实验，采用双重差分法比较该市与中西部对照城市的租金增长和服务通胀；跨都市区分析使用Saiz(2010)弹性得分检验不同供应约束条件下的传导模式
AI.findings: 1) 明尼阿波利斯改革后租金增长相对对照城市放缓0.9个百分点，后完成期平均差异达1.8个百分点；2) 该市官方CPI住房成本比全国平均水平低1.34个百分点；3) 约束型都市区租金冲击传导至服务通胀更快(6-9个月)，弹性都市区传导较晚但更强(15-18个月)；4) 全国时间序列中12个月领先期反映了不同供应体制的复合效应
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 识别了住房成本传导至服务通胀的上游阶段；2) 揭示了不同住房供应弹性条件下传导机制的异质性；3) 解释了宏观时间序列证据中的复合传导模式；4) 建立了住房供应改革影响通胀过程的微观识别框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为通过住房供应改革控制服务通胀提供了实证依据；2) 揭示了分区政策改革对通胀的实际影响；3) 为政策制定者提供了针对不同住房市场条件的差异化通胀管理策略；4) 展示了微观政策干预如何影响宏观经济结果

title: Land Rents and the Timing of Non-Tradable Inflation: Evidence from 1914–2026
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Land Rents and the Timing of Non-Tradable Inflation: Evidence from 1914–2026

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests

detail.abstract:
This paper documents a stable empirical regularity: housing costs systematically precede non-tradable services inflation by approximately one year across more than a century of U.S. data. Using three independent datasets—pre-war NBER cost-of-living indices (1914–1943), postwar BLS shelter CPI (1967–2026), and Zillow market rent data (2016–2025)—the analysis shows that housing cost growth leads services inflation with peak cross-correlations of 0.877, 0.812, and 0.772, respectively. The relationship holds across major macroeconomic regimes, including the Great Inflation, the Volcker disinflation, the post-GFC period, and the post-pandemic surge.

The lead-lag structure is strongly asymmetric: services inflation does not reliably predict future rent growth in modern data, inconsistent with a simple common-cycle explanation. Vector autoregression results indicate that rent innovations account for approximately 16–23% of the forecast error variance of services inflation at 12–24 month horizons, suggesting economically meaningful predictive content.

The findings are consistent with a cost-propagation mechanism in which housing costs—through occupancy expenses and reservation wages—feed into locally produced service prices with delay. Lease-reset dynamics provide a plausible transmission channel, as market rents adjust more rapidly than measured shelter costs and service-sector pricing.

The analysis is reduced-form and does not establish causal identification. Rather, it documents a persistent temporal ordering and predictive relationship that appears robust across datasets, time periods, and institutional environments. These results suggest that upstream housing costs may contribute to the persistence of services inflation, representing a channel distinct from those emphasized in standard demand-driven macroeconomic models.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文发现了一个稳定的经验规律：住房成本系统性领先非贸易服务通胀约一年时间，这一关系在美国超过一个世纪的数据中持续存在。研究使用三个独立数据集验证了这一领先-滞后关系，表明住房成本通过成本传导机制影响服务价格，可能解释了服务通胀的持续性。
AI.research_question: 住房成本是否系统性领先于非贸易服务通胀？这种领先-滞后关系的强度和稳定性如何？
AI.motivation: 理解服务通胀的驱动因素和持续性机制，特别是住房成本在其中可能扮演的角色，这对于宏观经济政策制定和通胀预测具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成本传导机制理论：住房成本通过占用费用和保留工资等渠道影响本地生产的服务价格；租赁重置动态作为可能的传导渠道。
AI.method: 使用三个独立数据集进行实证分析：战前NBER生活成本指数（1914-1943）、战后BLS住房CPI（1967-2026）和Zillow市场租金数据（2016-2025）；采用交叉相关分析和向量自回归模型。
AI.findings: 1. 住房成本增长系统性领先服务通胀约一年，交叉相关系数峰值分别为0.877、0.812和0.772；2. 这种关系在不同宏观经济体制下都成立；3. 领先-滞后结构具有强烈不对称性；4. 租金创新解释了服务通胀预测误差方差的16-23%。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了住房成本作为服务通胀领先指标的经验规律；2. 提出了成本传导机制作为标准需求驱动模型之外的补充解释；3. 强调了租赁重置动态在通胀传导中的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为央行和政策制定者提供了预测服务通胀的新工具；2. 有助于理解通胀的持续性机制；3. 对货币政策制定和通胀目标管理具有实际意义。

detail.abstract: In Abundance the authors Ezra Klein and Derek Thompson have called out the visionaries in the nation who have made future technologies present realities. The book is written to replace the scarcity with abundance of houses, clean air, lifesaving drugs and government funding for scientific research. This book is a research agenda for people who are interested in building, innovating positive change and are willing to go beyond their political affiliations. It is not for naysayers, past dwellers, and doom scrollers.

title: The Housing and Planning Act 2016: Rewarding the Aspiration of Homeownership?
affiliations: and University of Southampton - School of Law

detail.title: The Housing and Planning Act 2016: Rewarding the Aspiration of Homeownership?
detail.abstract: In May 2016, the Housing and Planning Act 2016 became law and reflects the first purely Conservative Government intervention on housing in England since the 1990s. This article examines the key provisions of the Act as they pertain to social housing and the government's stated aim of increasing rates of homeownership in Britain. The Act, through the Starter Homes Scheme, extension of the Right to Buy to Housing Association tenants and changes to security of tenure in the social sector, has been heralded as a 'landmark' piece of legislation. This article scrutinises these policy measures and assesses their effectiveness and likely impact. In so doing, it is contended that the 2016 Act exposes the government's promotion of homeownership above all other housing tenures. This article further explores the deep moralisation at the heart of the homeownership narrative and the intensification in the residualisation of social housing in England which, it is argued, is the inevitable consequence of the reforms.

AI.research_question: 2016年《住房与规划法案》的关键条款如何影响英国社会住房，以及政府提高住房自有率的目标对社会住房残余化产生什么后果？

title: Medicaid Coverage for Obesity Medications: Utilization and Net-of-Rebate Spending
affiliations: Indiana University, Indiana University, Indiana University Bloomington, Indiana University, Indiana University Bloomington, Syracuse University,  and Indiana University

detail.title: Medicaid Coverage for Obesity Medications: Utilization and Net-of-Rebate Spending
detail.abstract:
We document state variation in Medicaid coverage for obesity-indicated GLP-1 medications over time, and use a stacked difference-in-differences design to estimate the effects of coverage on utilization and net-of-rebate spending. Nine quarters out, coverage increases prescriptions for obesity-indicated GLP-1 medications by 0.82 per 100 enrollee-months (SE = 0.10). Coverage had no effect on GLP-1 prescribing for diabetes or cardiovascular indications, suggesting that off-label prescribing of diabetes formulations for obesity is not very common in the Medicaid program. The expansions do not appear to affect consumer spending at major online GLP-1 compounding firms, which suggests that the utilization response in our main analysis reflects new utilization rather than crowd-out. We find that coverage increases net-of-rebate Medicaid spending by $751.6 per 100 enrollee-months (SE = $92.0), compared to $986.9 in gross reimbursements—manufacturer rebates reduce the state’s net spending by approximately 24 percent. Across the 17 states that ever covered obesity-indicated GLP-1 medications by mid 2025, coverage increased Medicaid net spending by around $2.68 billion per year. Extending Medicaid coverage in the remaining states would generate a further $3.63 billion in annual net spending.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了医疗补助计划对肥胖适应症GLP-1药物覆盖政策的影响，发现覆盖政策显著增加了药物使用率，但对糖尿病适应症的GLP-1处方没有影响，表明标签外使用不常见。覆盖政策增加了医疗补助净支出，制造商回扣减少了约24%的净支出。

AI.findings: 1. 覆盖政策使肥胖适应症GLP-1药物处方量增加0.82/100参保人月；2. 对糖尿病适应症GLP-1处方无影响，表明标签外使用不常见；3. 覆盖政策增加医疗补助净支出751.6美元/100参保人月；4. 制造商回扣减少约24%的净支出；5. 已覆盖的17个州每年增加净支出约26.8亿美元。
