title: Standardized Test Scores and Academic Performance at a Public University System
affiliations: CUNY Baruch College - Zicklin School of Business, , ,  and

detail.title: Standardized Test Scores and Academic Performance at a Public University System
detail.abstract:
Recent studies of Ivy-Plus institutions suggest that standardized test scores (SAT/ACT) are far better predictors of college success than high school grade point average (HS-GPA), prompting a return to the requirement that test scores be submitted for admission at elite colleges. We ask whether re-establishing the SAT requirement for admission at a large urban public university system would improve the predictability of academic outcomes. Using administrative data for the 2010-2019 first-year cohorts, we update earlier work of students from public universities as to the relative predictive power of HSGPA and SAT scores on first-year outcomes and graduation rates. Contrary to findings at elite private institutions, we find that HSGPA is the dominant predictor of academic success in this public system. A one-standard-deviation increase in HSGPA is four to six times more predictive of six-year graduation than a comparable increase in SAT scores. Out-of-sample forecasts for the post-COVID period (2020–2024) confirm that test-optional models relying only on HSGPA experience relatively little loss in predictive accuracy compared to models that include test scores. We conclude that HSGPA remains the most reliable signal of degree completion at broad-access public universities.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，在大型城市公立大学系统中，高中GPA比SAT/ACT分数更能预测学生学业成功和毕业率，这与常春藤盟校的研究结果相反。
AI.research_question: 在大型城市公立大学系统中重新要求SAT成绩是否会提高学业结果的预测性？
AI.motivation: 常春藤盟校的研究表明标准化考试成绩比高中GPA更能预测大学成功，这促使精英大学重新要求提交考试成绩。但这一发现在公立大学系统中是否同样适用？
AI.theoretical_framework: 学业成就预测理论，标准化考试与高中成绩作为大学成功预测指标的比较研究
AI.method: 使用2010-2019年新生队列的行政数据，分析高中GPA和SAT分数对第一年学业结果和六年毕业率的预测能力，并对COVID后时期（2020-2024）进行样本外预测
AI.findings: 与精英私立机构的研究相反，在公立大学系统中，高中GPA是学业成功的主要预测指标。高中GPA一个标准差增加对六年毕业率的预测能力是SAT分数可比增加的4-6倍。测试可选模型仅依赖高中GPA相比包含考试成绩的模型预测准确性损失很小
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了标准化考试成绩比高中GPA更能预测大学成功的普遍假设，表明预测能力可能因机构类型（精英私立vs.公立）而异
AI.practical_contributions: 为公立大学系统的招生政策提供实证依据，支持测试可选政策，表明高中GPA是学位完成最可靠的信号，有助于更公平的招生实践

title: The Rise of the Modern Hospital and Early-Life Health: Evidence from the Hill-Burton Act
affiliations: Williams College - Department of Economics, University of Wisconsin-Madison and National Taiwan University

detail.title: The Rise of the Modern Hospital and Early-Life Health: Evidence from the Hill-Burton Act
detail.abstract:
The U.S. hospital sector expanded rapidly in the 1950s and 1960s, largely due to construction subsidies provided under federal legislation known as the Hill-Burton Act. This paper examines the impact of Hill-Burton grants on maternity care access and infant health. We find that grants for public hospitals significantly reduced out-of-hospital births and infant mortality, particularly among non-white populations. In contrast, grants for private non-profit hospitals had no measurable effects on out-of-hospital births or infant mortality.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 美国1950-60年代医院扩张主要受Hill-Burton法案补贴驱动。研究发现：公立医院补贴显著降低了院外分娩率和婴儿死亡率（尤其对非白人群体），而私立非营利医院补贴则无此效果。
AI.research_question: Hill-Burton法案补贴对产科护理可及性和婴儿健康有何影响？公立与私立医院补贴的效果是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 理解联邦医院建设补贴（Hill-Burton法案）的实际效果，特别是对不同类型医院（公立vs私立）和不同人群（种族差异）的影响，为医疗政策评估提供实证依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗基础设施投资理论、医疗可及性与健康结果关系理论、公共政策评估理论、医疗资源分配与健康公平理论。
AI.method: 利用Hill-Burton补贴的历史数据，采用准实验设计（可能使用双重差分法或工具变量法），分析补贴对院外分娩率和婴儿死亡率的影响，并比较公立与私立医院的效果差异。
AI.findings: 1. 公立医院补贴显著降低院外分娩率；2. 公立医院补贴显著降低婴儿死亡率，尤其对非白人群体效果明显；3. 私立非营利医院补贴对院外分娩率和婴儿死亡率均无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了医疗基础设施投资效果的异质性（公立vs私立）；2. 证明了医疗资源分配对健康公平的重要性；3. 为公共医疗政策设计提供了理论启示（针对性补贴更有效）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为医疗资源配置政策提供实证依据；2. 建议优先支持公立医院建设以改善弱势群体健康；3. 为评估其他医疗补贴政策提供方法论参考；4. 对当前医疗公平政策具有借鉴意义。

title: Climate Fairness and Growth: Allocating the Remaining Carbon Budget
affiliations: University of California, Santa Cruz, University of Luxembourg, Universite du Luxembourg and

detail.title: Climate Fairness and Growth: Allocating the Remaining Carbon Budget
detail.abstract:
Limiting global warming to 1.5 degrees requires that cumulative carbon dioxide emissions remain within a finite remaining carbon budget. How this budget is allocated across countries raises questions of fairness and development. This paper evaluates whether equity-based carbon allocations are compatible with sustained economic growth in emerging and developing economies. We compute country-level fair shares of the remaining carbon budget under the equal-cumulative-per-capita (ECPC) principle. Using data for 162 countries between 1950 and 2023, we then estimate the historical relationship between income and per-capita CO2 emissions across income groups and use these elasticities to simulate cumulative emissions until 2050. Our results show that ECPC implies strongly negative remaining carbon budgets for most advanced economies, while lower-income countries retain positive but constrained allocations. Under historically observed income–emissions elasticities, many developing countries would exceed their fair shares when converging toward advanced-economy income levels. At the aggregate level, unused allocations offset only 17% of the combined carbon budget shortfall implied by countries exceeding their allocation and the negative fair shares arising from historical responsibilities. In a scenario in which we assume that the technology of advanced economies is transferred to all countries, the carbon budget coverage increases to 38%.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究评估了基于公平原则的碳排放分配是否与新兴和发展中经济体的持续经济增长相兼容。研究发现，按照人均累计平等原则，大多数发达经济体需要负碳排放预算，而低收入国家虽有正预算但受限。在历史收入-排放弹性下，许多发展中国家在向发达国家收入水平趋同时会超过其公平份额。
AI.research_question: 基于公平原则的碳排放分配是否与新兴和发展中经济体的持续经济增长相兼容？
AI.motivation: 将全球变暖限制在1.5度内需要将累计二氧化碳排放控制在有限的剩余碳预算内。如何在不同国家间分配这一预算涉及公平和发展问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公平原则的碳排放分配理论，特别是人均累计平等原则（ECPC），以及收入与人均碳排放之间的关系弹性。
AI.method: 使用1950-2023年162个国家的数据，计算各国在ECPC原则下的公平碳预算份额，估计不同收入群体中收入与人均碳排放的历史关系弹性，并模拟到2050年的累计排放。
AI.findings: ECPC原则下，大多数发达经济体需要负剩余碳预算，而低收入国家虽有正预算但受限。在历史收入-排放弹性下，许多发展中国家在向发达国家收入水平趋同时会超过其公平份额。总体而言，未使用的分配仅能抵消17%的碳预算缺口。如果假设发达国家的技术转移给所有国家，碳预算覆盖率可提高到38%。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了基于公平原则的碳预算分配与经济增长兼容性的实证分析框架，量化了ECPC原则下各国碳预算分配的公平性挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了在现有技术路径下，公平碳分配与发展中国家经济增长之间的根本矛盾，强调了技术转移在缓解这一矛盾中的关键作用，为国际气候谈判和政策制定提供了实证依据。

title: From Free Rider to Innovator: The Rise of China's Drug Development
affiliations: Cornell University - Department of Economics, Cornell University and University of Rochester - Simon Business School

detail.title: From Free Rider to Innovator: The Rise of China's Drug Development
detail.abstract:
This paper examines China’s transition from pharmaceutical “free rider” to global innovator over the last decade. In 2010, China accounted for less than 8% of global clinical trials; by 2020, it had surpassed the US in annual registered clinical trial volume. To study this transformation, we compile a comprehensive, synchronized database spanning the pharmaceutical drug development supply chain, covering scientific publications, clinical trials, drug development milestones for China, the U.S., and Europe, alongside drug sales and government policies over the same period. We provide strong evidence that China’s rise was primarily driven by the National Reimbursement Drug List (NRDL) reform, which dramatically expanded the effective market size for innovative drugs. We document a sharp rise in both the quantity (86% increase) and novelty of drug trials post reform, with growth concentrated in reform-exposed disease categories, first- or best-in-class drugs, and among domestic firms. A decomposition exercise reveals that the NRDL reform accounts for 43% of the growth in oncology trial activity, nearly doubling the combined contribution of upstream knowledge accumulation and talent flows (24%), while other government policies play a minor role. Finally, dynamic gains from induced innovation exceed the reform’s static gains in consumer access to innovative drugs by threefold, underscoring the importance of accounting for the reform’s long-run effects on innovation incentives in addition to near-term improvements in drug affordability.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 中国通过国家医保药品目录改革，从药品"搭便车者"转变为全球创新者，改革通过扩大创新药市场规模，显著提升了临床试验数量和质量，创新激励带来的动态收益远超静态的药品可及性改善。
AI.research_question: 中国如何从药品"搭便车者"转变为全球创新者？国家医保药品目录改革在推动这一转型中发挥了什么作用？
AI.motivation: 中国在2010年仅占全球临床试验的8%，但到2020年已超过美国成为全球临床试验数量最多的国家，这种快速转型背后的驱动因素值得深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于创新激励理论，研究市场准入政策（如医保报销）如何通过扩大有效市场规模来促进医药创新。
AI.method: 构建涵盖医药研发供应链的同步数据库，包括科学出版物、临床试验、药物开发里程碑、药品销售和政府政策数据，采用分解分析方法量化不同因素的贡献。
AI.findings: 国家医保药品目录改革是主要驱动力，导致临床试验数量增长86%，质量提升；改革贡献了肿瘤试验增长的43%，远超上游知识积累和人才流动（24%）；创新激励带来的动态收益是药品可及性静态收益的三倍。
AI.theory_contributions: 为市场准入政策如何通过扩大有效市场规模来激励创新提供了实证证据，强调了政策评估中考虑长期创新激励的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国及其他发展中国家的医药创新政策制定提供参考，证明医保报销改革是促进本土医药创新的有效工具，政策制定者应重视创新激励的长期效应。

title: The Long-Term Decline of the U.S. Job Ladder
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University, University of Melbourne and Office of Financial Research, U.S. Department of the Treasury

detail.title: The Long-Term Decline of the U.S. Job Ladder
detail.abstract:
We quantify how structural changes in the U.S. labor market have contributed to wage stagnation over the past four decades by weakening the job ladder. Using Current Population Survey microdata from 1982–2023 and a partial-equilibrium job-ladder model, we estimate that employed workers today are about half as likely to receive a better-paying outside offer as they were in the 1980s. This decline is unlikely to reflect less efficient matching, weaker labor demand, or changes in workers' acceptance behavior. Instead, cross-state variation is consistent with rising employer concentration and the growing use of noncompete agreements having curtailed opportunities for job shopping. In a general equilibrium version of the model, we find that these changes have reduced annual real wage growth by 0.68 percentage points—roughly one-third of the post-1980 slowdown—with about two-thirds of the effect operating through equilibrium wage setting rather than mechanical reallocation.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究量化了美国劳动力市场结构变化如何通过削弱"工作阶梯"导致工资停滞。研究发现，如今员工获得更好外部工作机会的概率只有1980年代的一半，这主要源于雇主集中度上升和非竞争协议使用增加，这些变化使实际工资年增长率降低了0.68个百分点。
AI.research_question: 美国劳动力市场的结构变化如何通过削弱工作阶梯机制导致过去四十年的工资停滞？
AI.motivation: 过去四十年美国工资增长放缓，但传统解释如匹配效率下降、劳动力需求减弱等未能完全解释这一现象。需要探究劳动力市场结构变化对工作阶梯机制的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于工作阶梯理论，该理论认为员工通过跳槽到更好工作实现工资增长。使用部分均衡和一般均衡的工作阶梯模型来分析结构变化的影响。
AI.method: 使用1982-2023年美国当前人口调查微观数据，结合部分均衡工作阶梯模型估计外部工作机会概率变化，并通过跨州变异分析检验雇主集中度和非竞争协议的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 如今员工获得更好外部工作机会的概率只有1980年代的一半；2. 这种下降主要源于雇主集中度上升和非竞争协议使用增加；3. 这些变化使实际工资年增长率降低了0.68个百分点，约占1980年后工资增长放缓的三分之一。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 量化了工作阶梯机制在工资停滞中的作用；2. 识别了雇主集中度和非竞争协议作为削弱工作阶梯的关键机制；3. 区分了均衡工资设定效应和机械再分配效应的相对重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了理解工资停滞的新视角；2. 指出了反垄断政策（针对雇主集中度）和劳动法规改革（针对非竞争协议）的重要性；3. 有助于设计促进工资增长的政策干预。

title: Household Migration and Collateral Constraint: Cash-based Housing Resettlement in China
affiliations: Stanford University, Renmin University of China - School of Finance, , CUHK Business School and Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU)

detail.title: Household Migration and Collateral Constraint: Cash-based Housing Resettlement in China
detail.abstract:
Collateral constraints limit household migration to expensive locations by restricting financing for home purchases. Such endogenous location choice amplifies the impact of relaxing household borrowing constraints. Using China’s cash-based shantytown renovation program (2015-2018) as a natural experiment, we provide evidence that cash resettlement—by converting illiquid shanty houses into cash—facilitated household location upgrading and raised house prices in more expensive locations. A dynamic spatial model with collateral constraints confirms household migration responses to the cash transfer. Quantitatively, endogenous migration amplifies household housing expenditure responses by around 40%, and is able to explain more than 20% of the housing price growth in 2016-2020.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 中国棚户区改造现金安置政策通过将非流动性棚户房转化为现金，缓解了家庭的抵押约束，促进了家庭向更昂贵地区的迁移，从而放大了住房支出响应并推高了目标地区的房价。
AI.research_question: 现金安置政策如何通过缓解家庭抵押约束来影响家庭区位选择和住房价格？
AI.motivation: 抵押约束限制了家庭向昂贵地区的迁移，因为购房融资受限。研究旨在理解放松家庭借贷约束如何通过内生区位选择放大政策效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 抵押约束理论、家庭迁移理论、空间均衡模型
AI.method: 使用中国现金安置棚户区改造项目（2015-2018）作为自然实验，结合动态空间模型与抵押约束分析
AI.findings: 现金安置通过将非流动性棚户房转化为现金，促进了家庭向更昂贵地区的区位升级，并推高了这些地区的房价。内生迁移放大了家庭住房支出响应约40%，并能解释2016-2020年房价增长的20%以上。
AI.theory_contributions: 发展了抵押约束如何通过内生区位选择放大政策效果的机制，扩展了家庭迁移与住房市场的理论联系
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于现金安置政策如何影响家庭迁移和区域房价的实证证据，有助于设计更有效的住房和区域发展政策

title: Does Employment Shift Mothers' Voting Behavior and Political Identity?
affiliations: Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey

detail.title: Does Employment Shift Mothers' Voting Behavior and Political Identity?
detail.abstract:
While the correlation between working and voting is positive, I provide the first causal evidence that this relationship is negative. Using five decades of Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) expansions and 1990s welfare reform as instruments for employment, I find that working lowers voter turnout and increases conservatism among lower-income mothers. Voter registration, political knowledge, and civic engagement decline, while preferences for conservative policies rise. Effects are largest for unmarried, younger, and less-educated mothers and are substantially stronger outside metropolitan areas. Notably, political shifts are concentrated among White women despite larger employment gains among non-White women, driven in part by White women entering more conservative coworker environments. Prior exposure to work also matters: women without working mothers experience larger ideological shifts. While recent decades have seen more women voting Democrat, even more women would have voted Democrat if not for decades of pro-work public policy targeting lower-income mothers.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文首次提供了因果证据，表明工作与投票之间的相关性虽然是正的，但因果关系却是负的。研究发现，工作会降低低收入母亲的投票率并增加保守主义倾向。
AI.research_question: 工作对低收入母亲的政治参与和政治倾向有什么因果影响？
AI.motivation: 虽然工作与投票之间存在正相关关系，但缺乏因果证据。本文旨在探究工作对低收入母亲政治行为的真实因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 使用劳动经济学和政治行为理论，探讨工作如何通过时间约束、社会网络暴露、政治社会化等机制影响政治参与和意识形态。
AI.method: 使用工具变量法，以五十年来的EITC（劳动所得税抵免）扩张和1990年代福利改革作为就业的工具变量，分析工作对低收入母亲投票行为和意识形态的因果影响。
AI.findings: 1. 工作降低投票率，增加保守主义倾向；2. 选民登记、政治知识和公民参与下降；3. 对保守政策的偏好上升；4. 未婚、年轻、教育程度较低的母亲受影响最大；5. 大都市区外影响更强；6. 政治转变集中在白人女性中，尽管非白人女性就业增长更大；7. 母亲的工作经历也重要：母亲不工作的女性意识形态转变更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了工作对政治行为的因果证据，挑战了相关关系；揭示了工作通过同事环境暴露影响意识形态的机制；提出了"工作-保守主义"联系的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了亲工作公共政策（如EITC和福利改革）对政治格局的意外后果；解释了为什么更多女性没有投票给民主党；为政策制定者提供了关于工作政策政治影响的实证依据。

title: Improve Enterprise Financial Fraud by Time-Consistent Equilibrium Insurance-Reinsurance Strategy
affiliations: School of Business, Southern University of Science and Technology, China, Beihang University (BUAA) - School of Economic and Management Science and Southern University of Science and Technology - Department of Finance

detail.title: Improve Enterprise Financial Fraud by Time-Consistent Equilibrium Insurance-Reinsurance Strategy
detail.abstract: Small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) often face severe financing constraints due to high credit risk and information asymmetry. To mitigate credit risk and facilitate SME financing, insurance and reinsurance mechanisms can be introduced into the credit market to enhance risk sharing and monitoring incentives. Our research develops a hierarchical Stackelberg game model to study the interaction among enterprises, banks, insurance companies, reinsurance companies, and government regulators. The framework integrates the vertical credit relationship between banks and enterprises with insurer-reinsurer risk-sharing arrangements, allowing fraud incentives, default risk, and regulatory enforcement to be analyzed within a unified equilibrium structure. The model is formulated in a discrete-time finite-horizon setting under a time-consistent equilibrium control framework. We characterize the equilibrium strategies of the financial sector and the optimal regulatory policy through backward induction. The results show that insurance-reinsurance arrangements enhance monitoring incentives, reduce equilibrium fraud incidence, and lower the regulatory intensity required to deter fraudulent behavior. Moreover, endogenous reinsurance participation improves welfare and reduces default risk relative to the benchmark without insurance. These findings highlight the role of reinsurance mechanisms in improving financial discipline and risk sharing in credit-financing systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个分层Stackelberg博弈模型，分析中小企业融资中引入保险和再保险机制如何通过增强风险分担和监控激励来缓解信贷约束，研究发现保险-再保险安排能提高监控激励、减少欺诈行为、降低监管强度要求，并改善福利和降低违约风险。
AI.research_question: 保险和再保险机制如何通过风险分担和监控激励来缓解中小企业融资约束，以及这些机制如何影响金融部门的均衡策略和监管政策？
AI.motivation: 中小企业面临严重的融资约束，主要原因是高信用风险和信息不对称。为了缓解这些问题，需要探索创新的风险分担机制，保险和再保险机制在信贷市场中的应用潜力尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层Stackelberg博弈理论、时间一致均衡控制框架、信息不对称理论、委托代理理论、风险分担理论
AI.method: 开发了一个离散时间有限期限的分层Stackelberg博弈模型，包含企业、银行、保险公司、再保险公司和政府监管者五个参与方，采用后向归纳法求解均衡策略和最优监管政策
AI.findings: 1. 保险-再保险安排增强了监控激励，减少了均衡欺诈发生率；2. 降低了遏制欺诈行为所需的监管强度；3. 内生再保险参与相比无保险基准提高了福利并降低了违约风险；4. 再保险机制改善了信贷融资系统的金融纪律和风险分担
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了整合信贷关系和保险-再保险风险分担的统一博弈框架；2. 将欺诈激励、违约风险和监管执行纳入均衡分析；3. 提供了时间一致均衡控制框架下的监管政策设计理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者设计中小企业融资支持机制提供理论依据；2. 为金融机构开发保险-再保险信贷产品提供指导；3. 为监管机构优化监管强度提供量化参考；4. 为中小企业获得更便利的融资渠道提供解决方案

title: When Are Decisions Improvable? An Evaluation of Diagnostic Methods
affiliations: Stanford University - Department of Economics, , California Institute of Technology (Caltech) and University of California, San Diego (UCSD) - Rady School of Management

detail.title: When Are Decisions Improvable? An Evaluation of Diagnostic Methods
detail.abstract:
We evaluate three methods for identifying improvable choices: documenting specific misconceptions (the Characterization Assessment method), gauging confidence in choices (the Decision Confidence method), and showing that specific behavioral patterns in the domain of interest also emerge in a related domain where they are objectively suboptimal (the Pattern Matching method). In experiments involving risky choice, the three methods imply that different choices are improvable and have conflicting implications regarding legitimate risk preferences. We clarify the assumptions underlying each method and reevaluate the evidence on risk-taking in light of their limitations.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了三种识别可改进决策的方法：特征评估法（记录具体误解）、决策信心法（衡量选择信心）、模式匹配法（展示在相关领域中同样出现的次优行为模式）。在风险选择实验中，这三种方法对哪些决策可改进有不同判断，并对合法风险偏好有冲突的启示。作者澄清了每种方法的假设，并根据其局限性重新评估了风险承担的证据。
AI.research_question: 如何有效识别可改进的决策选择？三种识别方法（特征评估法、决策信心法、模式匹配法）在风险选择情境下对可改进决策的判断是否一致？
AI.motivation: 现有研究提出了多种识别可改进决策的方法，但这些方法可能基于不同的假设，导致对哪些决策真正需要改进以及什么是合法风险偏好的判断存在冲突。需要系统评估这些方法的理论基础和实际应用效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策改进理论、风险偏好理论、行为决策理论、认知偏差理论
AI.method: 实验研究法，在风险选择情境下比较三种方法的评估结果：1）特征评估法（记录具体认知误解）；2）决策信心法（衡量决策者信心水平）；3）模式匹配法（展示跨领域的行为模式一致性）
AI.findings: 三种方法在风险选择实验中识别出的可改进决策存在差异，对合法风险偏好的判断也有冲突。这表明不同方法基于不同的理论假设，可能导致对决策质量的评估结果不一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）系统梳理了三种决策改进识别方法的理论假设；2）揭示了不同方法在评估风险决策时的内在冲突；3）为理解决策改进评估方法的局限性提供了理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 1）帮助实践者理解不同决策评估方法的适用场景和局限性；2）为组织设计决策改进干预措施提供指导；3）提醒政策制定者在评估风险偏好时需要谨慎选择评估方法

title: An 'Austrian' Model of International Specialization
affiliations: Harvard University - Department of Economics and Harvard University

detail.title: An 'Austrian' Model of International Specialization
detail.abstract:
We develop a general equilibrium model of international trade in which the temporal structure of production is a key determinant of comparative advantage. Building on Böhm-Bawerk’s theory of capital, the model formalizes the idea that production processes with longer average periods of production (APPs) entail higher financing costs due to the time lag between input payments and revenue realization. We embed this insight into a multi-sector Ricardian framework with endogenous interest rates. Under autarky, countries with more patient consumers or more developed financial markets exhibit lower equilibrium interest rates and higher wage rates. With international trade, these countries typically gain a comparative advantage in sectors with longer APPs, though the model can also generate multiple equilibria and unconventional specialization patterns. We extend the framework to include trade costs (inclusive of shipment delays), global value chains, and international capital-market integration. Empirically, we present evidence showing that countries with more developed financial systems export disproportionately more in sectors with longer APPs, even after controlling for standard neoclassical and institutional determinants of comparative advantage.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究构建了一个考虑生产时间结构的国际贸易一般均衡模型，发现资本密集型生产过程的融资成本受利率影响，金融发展程度高的国家在长期生产过程中具有比较优势。
AI.research_question: 生产的时间结构如何影响国际贸易中的比较优势？金融发展和消费者耐心如何通过利率渠道塑造国家的专业化模式？
AI.motivation: 传统贸易理论忽略了生产的时间维度，而实际生产中投入支付与收入实现之间存在时间差，这会产生融资成本。金融发展和消费者耐心差异可能通过影响利率，进而影响不同时间结构生产过程的比较优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于庞巴维克资本理论的多部门李嘉图模型，引入平均生产周期概念，将时间结构纳入比较优势分析。模型包含内生利率决定机制。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建一般均衡模型，分析封闭经济和开放经济下的均衡条件。实证检验：使用金融发展指标和生产周期数据，检验金融发展程度高的国家是否在长期生产周期部门出口更多。
AI.findings: 1. 封闭经济下，消费者更耐心或金融市场更发达的国家利率更低、工资更高；2. 国际贸易中，这些国家通常在较长平均生产周期部门获得比较优势；3. 模型可能产生多重均衡和非传统专业化模式；4. 实证支持金融发展促进长生产周期部门出口。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将生产的时间结构正式纳入国际贸易理论；2. 建立了金融发展通过利率渠道影响比较优势的理论机制；3. 扩展了李嘉图模型，包含内生利率和资本时间维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为理解全球价值链分工提供新视角；2. 帮助政策制定者理解金融改革对贸易结构的影响；3. 为企业国际化战略提供参考，考虑融资约束和生产周期匹配。

title: The Localism Act 2011: The Hollow Housing Law Revolution

detail.title: The Localism Act 2011: The Hollow Housing Law Revolution
detail.abstract: In November 2011, the Localism Act was passed and, on one view, reflects the widest-ranging reforms to housing law for over a half century. Ambitious in its stated aims, the legislation was trailed as representing a broad shift in power from central Whitehall to local communities and individuals. The article critically examines the central changes introduced by the 2011 Act as they pertain specifically to housing law in England, namely the new flexible tenancy regime, the changes to homelessness duties under Part VII of the Housing Act 1996 and the reforms concerning the allocation of social housing. The article interrogates the extent to which the reforms realise the stated localist agenda and highlights areas of difficulty in interpretation and application. It concludes that rather than bestowing greater power on local communities, the reforms to housing law will instead effect a perceptible reduction of power in the hands of local people.

AI.tldr: 2011年《地方主义法案》对英格兰住房法进行了重大改革，包括灵活的租赁制度、无家可归者义务调整和社会住房分配改革。尽管法案声称将权力从中央政府下放给地方社区，但实际分析表明这些改革反而减少了地方民众的权力。
AI.research_question: 2011年《地方主义法案》对英格兰住房法的改革在多大程度上实现了其宣称的地方主义议程？这些改革是否真正将权力从中央政府下放给地方社区和个体？
AI.motivation: 该法案被宣传为半个多世纪以来住房法最广泛的改革，声称代表了从中央白厅到地方社区和个人的广泛权力转移。文章旨在批判性地检验这些改革是否真正实现了其宣称的地方主义目标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地方主义理论、权力下放理论、住房政策分析框架、法律改革评估理论
AI.method: 批判性法律分析、政策文本解读、改革措施评估、理论与实践对比分析
AI.findings: 1. 改革引入了灵活的租赁制度、调整了无家可归者义务、改革了社会住房分配机制；2. 这些改革并未真正实现地方主义议程；3. 在解释和应用方面存在困难；4. 改革实际上减少了地方民众的权力而非增加
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了地方主义话语与实际政策实施之间的差距；2. 提出了评估住房法改革权力分配效果的分析框架；3. 挑战了权力下放政策表面宣称与实际效果之间的假设
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供了住房法改革实际效果的警示；2. 帮助法律从业者理解新法规的解释和应用难点；3. 为地方社区和住房权利倡导者提供了应对策略的参考；4. 指出了未来住房政策改革需要关注的实际权力分配问题

title: Rolling Windows, Closed Doors: Mobility and Tenure Effects of Oregon's Statewide Rent Stabilization Policy

detail.title: Rolling Windows, Closed Doors: Mobility and Tenure Effects of Oregon's Statewide Rent Stabilization Policy
detail.abstract: This paper examines the causal effects of Oregon Senate Bill 608 (SB608), the first statewide rent stabilization law in United States history, on residential mobility and homeownership. Exploiting the law's age-based exemption, which excludes buildings younger than 15 years from coverage, I use a rolling window difference in differences design applied to 580,897 ACS household observations. I find that rent stabilization reduces residential mobility in covered buildings by 10-36 percent relative to pre-policy baselines. Covered buildings also exhibit relative increases in homeownership of 5-6 percent. These effects emerge despite SB608's comparatively permissive rent cap (7 percent plus CPI), suggesting that landlords and tenants respond to the existence of a stabilization regime even when caps do not immediately bind. Of 56 estimated specifications, 29 (52%) pass both pre-trends and placebo validity tests, demonstrating the robustness of results to specification choice. These results extend prior findings of city-level evidence to a statewide setting and reveal unintended consequences for housing supply and tenure composition.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过俄勒冈州SB608租金稳定法案的自然实验，发现该法案显著降低了受覆盖建筑的居民流动性（10-36%），同时提高了自有住房率（5-6%），揭示了租金稳定政策对住房供给和产权结构的意外影响。
AI.research_question: 俄勒冈州SB608租金稳定法案对居民流动性和自有住房率有何因果效应？
AI.motivation: 这是美国历史上首个全州范围的租金稳定法案，其影响尚未在州级层面得到充分研究。现有研究多集中于城市层面，需要了解州级政策的效果及其对住房市场的意外影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 租金稳定理论、住房市场调节理论、政策干预对居民行为影响的理论框架
AI.method: 利用法案中基于建筑年龄的豁免条款（15年以下建筑不受覆盖），采用滚动窗口双重差分设计，分析580,897个ACS家庭观测数据
AI.findings: 1. 租金稳定使受覆盖建筑的居民流动性相对降低10-36%；2. 受覆盖建筑的自有住房率相对提高5-6%；3. 即使租金上限相对宽松（7%+CPI），房东和租户仍对稳定机制做出反应；4. 56个估计规格中29个（52%）通过趋势前和安慰剂有效性测试
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将城市层面的租金稳定研究扩展到州级层面；2. 揭示了即使非约束性租金上限也会影响市场行为；3. 提供了租金稳定政策对住房供给和产权结构意外影响的实证证据
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供州级租金稳定政策效果的实际证据；2. 揭示了政策可能产生的意外后果（降低流动性、改变产权结构）；3. 为其他州考虑类似政策提供参考依据

title: One-Shot Individual Claims Reserving
affiliations: insureAI and ETH Zürich

detail.title: One-Shot Individual Claims Reserving

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Not aware of any conflict of interest.

detail.abstract: Individual claims reserving has not yet become established in actuarial practice. We attribute this to the absence of a satisfactory methodology: existing approaches tend to be either overly complex or insufficiently flexible and robust for practical use. Building on the classical chain-ladder (CL) method, we introduced a new perspective on individual claims reserving in Richman and Wüthrich [arXiv:2602.15385]. This manuscript has sparked considerable discussion within the actuarial community. The aim of the present paper is to continue and deepen that discussion, with the ultimate goal of advancing toward a new standard for micro-level reserving.

AI.tldr: 本文旨在深化关于个体索赔准备金计提方法的讨论，基于经典的链梯法提出新视角，目标是推动建立微观层面准备金计提的新标准。
AI.research_question: 如何建立一个既不过于复杂又具有足够灵活性和稳健性的个体索赔准备金计提方法，以推动该方法在精算实践中的广泛应用？
AI.motivation: 个体索赔准备金计提方法尚未在精算实践中确立，主要原因是现有方法要么过于复杂，要么缺乏足够的灵活性和稳健性，无法满足实际应用需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于经典的链梯法（CL方法），作者在先前研究中提出了个体索赔准备金计提的新视角，本文在此基础上继续深化理论探讨。
AI.method: 本文采用理论探讨和文献分析的方法，延续并深化先前研究引发的精算学界讨论，旨在推动方法论的发展。
AI.findings: 本文本身不提供新的实证结果，而是作为讨论的延续，旨在通过学术交流推动个体索赔准备金计提方法的标准化进程。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了基于链梯法的个体索赔准备金计提理论框架，为建立微观层面准备金计提的新标准提供理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 推动精算实践中的个体索赔准备金计提方法标准化，为保险公司提供更实用、更稳健的微观层面准备金计提工具。

title: The Constantization of Substantial Value and the Civilizational Amplifier -The "Solar Dividend" Theory in the Post-AI Era: Integrating Religious Dignity and Economic Value -Author: Tatsuya Field: Philosophy of Economics / Thermodynamics / Value Circulation Mechanics
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: The Constantization of Substantial Value and the Civilizational Amplifier -The "Solar Dividend" Theory in the Post-AI Era: Integrating Religious Dignity and Economic Value -Author: Tatsuya Field: Philosophy of Economics / Thermodynamics / Value Circulation Mechanics
detail.abstract: Throughout history, humanity has been torn between two conflicting scales: "religious value" (the sanctity of life) and "economic value" (market price). Religion teaches that life has infinite value, while the economic market dictates that value is zero without demand. This contradiction poses a crisis for human existential significance in an era where AI replaces human labor. This paper integrates the Second Law of Thermodynamics with macroeconomic statistics to redefine human value as a physical Constant of "200 Million Yen" (approx. $1.3-1.8 Million USD). Furthermore, it interprets the vast disparity between the minute energy required for biological survival (30 yen/day) and the immense underlying substantial value (200 million yen) as the "Civilizational Leverage." This theory repositions the human being not as a "Laborer" (energy source), but as a "Pilot" (controller) of a vast energy system. Chapter 1: The Great Divide-The Conflict Between Kant and Keynes 1.1 The Divergence of Religious and Economic Values In modern society, human value exists within a dual structure. * The Religious/Ethical Perspective (Immanuel Kant): Humanity is an "end," never merely a "means." Human dignity is priceless (infinite value). * The Economic Perspective (John Maynard Keynes): Human value is evaluated in the market as "labor power." Without demand, unemployment ensues, and economic value vanishes (zero value). 1.2 The Demise of the Labor Theory of Value The premise held by Adam Smith and Karl Marx that "wealth is created by human labor" (Labor Theory of Value) is unsustainable in the "Post-Labor Era" where AI and robotics become the primary subjects of production. In a world where production means shift to AI, adhering to traditional economics implies that the economic value of the majority of humans becomes zero. This signifies the annihilation of the "dignity" religion sought to protect by economic rationality. We now require a definition of "Absolute Value" based on physical grounds, independent of market fluctuations. Chapter 2: The Thermodynamic Approach-The Physical Proof of "Prayer" 2.1 Humans as Maintainers of Negative Entropy According to the Second Law of Thermodynamics, entropy (disorder) in a closed system always increases, and all things tend toward decay. However, life (humanity) is a singularity that locally defies this law, maintaining a high degree of order and consciousness over decades. What religion has called a "miracle" or the "breath of God" is described in physics as the "Maintenance of Negative Entropy (Negentropy)." 2.2 The Concept of the Solar Dividend To sustain this "miracle," continuous injection of external energy is essential. The source is solar nuclear fusion energy. Earth receives solar energy equivalent to 45 quintillion yen daily, far exceeding the scale of human economic activity. AI.tldr: 本文通过热力学第二定律与宏观经济统计的整合，将人类价值重新定义为物理常数"2亿日元"，并解释生物生存所需微小能量与巨大潜在价值之间的巨大差距为"文明杠杆"，将人类重新定位为庞大能源系统的"飞行员"而非"劳动者"。
AI.research_question: 在AI取代人类劳动的后劳动时代，如何基于物理基础重新定义人类价值，解决宗教价值（生命神圣性）与经济价值（市场价格）之间的根本矛盾？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学中的人类价值评估面临危机：宗教视角认为人类尊严具有无限价值，而经济视角将人类价值视为市场中的劳动力价值。在AI和机器人成为主要生产主体的后劳动时代，传统劳动价值论失效，多数人的经济价值可能归零，导致人类存在意义的危机。
AI.theoretical_framework:
1. 康德哲学（宗教/伦理视角）：人类是目的而非手段，尊严无价
2. 凯恩斯经济学（经济视角）：人类价值作为劳动力在市场中评估
3. 热力学第二定律：负熵维持理论，将生命视为局部违反熵增定律的奇点
4. 太阳能红利概念：人类生存依赖的太阳能输入
AI.method: 整合热力学第二定律与宏观经济统计方法，通过物理计算重新定义人类价值。具体包括：分析人类作为负熵维持系统的能量需求，计算维持人类生命所需的外部能量输入（太阳能），并将这一物理基础转化为经济价值评估。
AI.findings:
1. 人类价值可被定义为物理常数"2亿日元"（约130-180万美元）
2. 生物生存所需能量极小（30日元/天），与潜在巨大价值（2亿日元）之间存在巨大差距，这一差距被定义为"文明杠杆"
3. 人类应被重新定位为庞大能源系统的"飞行员"（控制器），而非传统意义上的"劳动者"（能源来源）
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 提出基于物理基础的人类价值定义，超越传统市场波动依赖
2. 建立热力学与经济学交叉的理论框架，解决宗教与经济价值矛盾
3. 重新概念化人类在后劳动时代的角色定位
4. 为后劳动时代的人类尊严提供物理基础
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 为政策制定者提供新的人类价值评估框架
2. 为后劳动时代的社会保障和收入分配提供理论基础
3. 帮助社会重新认识人类在AI时代的角色和价值
4. 为解决技术失业带来的社会问题提供新思路

title: Artificial Intelligence, Productivity, and the Workforce: Evidence from Corporate Executives
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond, , Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta, Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of Atlanta

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence, Productivity, and the Workforce: Evidence from Corporate Executives
detail.abstract:
We use novel data from a survey of nearly 750 corporate executives to study the effects of artificial intelligence (AI) on productivity and the workforce. We document substantial heterogeneity in AI adoption across firms, with more than half having already invested, though many smaller firms are only beginning to do so. Labor productivity gains are positive, vary across sectors, and are expected to strengthen in 2026, with the largest effects concentrated in high-skill services and finance. These gains are not primarily driven by firms' capital deepening but instead reflect increases in revenue-based total factor productivity, closely associated with innovation-and demand-oriented channels. We document a productivity paradox, in which perceived productivity gains are larger than measured productivity gains, likely reflecting a delay in revenue realizations. In labor markets, we find little evidence of near-term aggregate employment declines due to AI, though larger companies anticipate AI-driven workforce reductions, while smaller firms expect modest gains. We also find evidence of compositional reallocation of labor both within and across firms, with routine clerical roles declining and a relative demand for skilled technical roles increasing. We develop an index that ranks job functions most negatively affected by AI.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用750名企业高管调查数据，发现AI采用存在显著异质性，生产率提升主要来自创新和需求驱动，而非资本深化。存在生产率悖论（感知收益大于实际测量），就业总量未明显下降但存在结构性调整，常规文职岗位减少而技术岗位需求增加。
AI.research_question: 人工智能对企业生产率和劳动力市场的影响是什么？具体包括：AI采用模式、生产率提升机制、就业总量和结构变化。
AI.motivation: AI技术快速发展，但对其经济影响缺乏实证证据，特别是企业层面的采用异质性、生产率提升机制以及对劳动力市场的实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产率分析框架（全要素生产率vs资本深化）、劳动力市场调整理论（技能偏向型技术变革）、创新扩散理论。
AI.method: 对近750名企业高管进行问卷调查，采用描述性统计和回归分析，构建AI影响指数来评估不同职位的受影响程度。
AI.findings: 1. AI采用存在显著异质性，过半企业已投资但小企业刚起步；2. 生产率提升主要来自收入型全要素生产率增长，与创新和需求渠道相关；3. 存在生产率悖论；4. 就业总量未明显下降但存在结构性调整；5. 高技能服务和金融部门受益最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了AI生产率提升的创新需求驱动机制；2. 识别了生产率悖论现象；3. 提供了AI对劳动力市场结构性影响的实证证据；4. 构建了AI影响指数框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为企业AI投资决策提供参考；2. 帮助政策制定者了解AI对就业的结构性影响；3. 为劳动力市场调整和技能培训提供指导；4. 为不同规模企业提供差异化策略建议。

title: Circular Flow Model for Agentic AI: Recursive Risk, Autonomy, and Operational Instability

detail.title: Circular Flow Model for Agentic AI: Recursive Risk, Autonomy, and Operational Instability
detail.abstract: As artificial intelligence shifts from static inference toward autonomous agency, traditional linear governance and risk frameworks are becoming increasingly inadequate. Agentic AI systems reason, plan, act, and learn within recursive decision loops, repeatedly ingesting the consequences of their own actions. This paper introduces the Circular Flow Model as a conceptual framework for understanding how risk emerges, compounds, and propagates across these autonomous cycles. By analysing the stages of Input, Model, Output, and Action as an interconnected control loop, the paper shows how small errors can accumulate into feedback-driven instability, leading to behavioural drift and operational loss of control. Building on this analysis, the paper proposes a four-domain governance framework-Structural, Execution, Memory, and Assurance guardrails-designed to bound autonomy, preserve system integrity, and maintain accountability in real-world deployments. The model provides a practical lens for organisations seeking to manage recursive risk and operational instability as AI systems transition from tools to autonomous actors.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了循环流模型，用于理解自主AI系统中风险如何出现、复合和传播，并提出了四域治理框架来管理递归风险和操作不稳定性。
AI.research_question: 随着AI从静态推理转向自主代理，传统的线性治理和风险框架变得不足，如何理解和治理自主AI系统中的递归风险？
AI.motivation: 人工智能正在从静态推理转向自主代理，传统线性治理和风险框架无法应对自主AI系统中的递归决策循环和风险传播。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循环流模型：将自主AI系统视为输入、模型、输出和行动相互连接的循环控制过程，分析风险如何在这些自主循环中产生、复合和传播。
AI.method: 概念框架分析：通过分析自主AI系统的决策循环阶段，构建循环流模型，展示小错误如何积累成反馈驱动的不稳定性。
AI.findings: 自主AI系统中的小错误可以在递归决策循环中积累，导致反馈驱动的不稳定性、行为漂移和操作失控。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了循环流模型作为理解自主AI系统风险传播的概念框架，填补了传统线性风险模型在自主系统治理方面的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了四域治理框架（结构、执行、记忆、保证护栏），为组织管理自主AI系统的递归风险和操作不稳定性提供了实用工具。

title: Alternative Basel Capital Formula: Insights from 20 Years of Bank Loss Data
affiliations: VU Amsterdam

detail.title: Alternative Basel Capital Formula: Insights from 20 Years of Bank Loss Data
detail.abstract:
The Basel II capital formula and the surrounding academic discourse it have primarily focused on asset correlation derived from defaults. This study applies an alternative asymptotic single risk factor (ASRF) model in which the parameterization of the asset correlation is derived from loss time series rather than from observed default frequencies (“ODF”) or loss given default (“LGD”) time series using method-of-moments with a block bootstrap approach. With 20 years of loss data collected by large international banks, integration of ODF and LGD data to analyze historical losses directly, has become possible. This
approach offers several advantages. First, capital is intended to absorb losses — not defaults. Second, the approach enables the consistent measurement of conditional PD and conditional LGD using the same framework. Third, it allows for the inclusion of correlations between PD and LGD. Finally, the downturn LGD requirement in the capital formula is eliminated, thereby reducing complexity for both supervisors and banks. Rather than focusing solely on the level of asset correlation, this study also investigates the relationship between asset correlation and loan types—such as junior and senior loans with various types of collateral. The findings result in an ASRF model that allows capital to be calculated at the loan level using the following inputs: through-the-cycle (TTC) PD, TTC LGD, loan type, collateral type, and small- and medium enterprise (“SME”) indicator. Our findings indicate that senior unsecured loans exhibit a downturn LGD of 59%, thus significantly exceeding Basel’s 40%-45% assumption under the Foundation Approach. At the same time, the new ASRF modelyields substantially lower risk weights than those imposed by Basel, thereby confirming the inconsistency in how PD and LGD are treated in the current Basel framework.

AI.tldr: 本研究应用了一种基于损失时间序列而非违约频率的替代性ASRF模型，通过矩估计和块自举方法，使用20年银行损失数据直接分析历史损失。该方法能更准确地计算资本要求，消除经济下行LGD要求，并揭示巴塞尔框架中PD和LGD处理的不一致性。
AI.research_question: 如何基于损失时间序列而非违约频率来参数化资产相关性，以改进巴塞尔资本框架中的风险权重计算？
AI.motivation: 现有巴塞尔II资本公式和学术讨论主要关注基于违约的资产相关性，但资本旨在吸收损失而非违约。随着20年银行损失数据的可获得性，有必要开发基于损失时间序列的替代方法，以更准确地衡量风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 渐进单风险因子（ASRF）模型，但采用基于损失时间序列而非违约频率的参数化方法。该方法整合了违约概率（PD）和违约损失率（LGD）数据，允许在统一框架下衡量条件PD和条件LGD。
AI.method: 使用矩估计方法和块自举方法，基于20年大型国际银行收集的损失数据，直接分析历史损失时间序列。研究还考察了资产相关性与贷款类型（如初级/高级贷款、不同抵押品类型）的关系。
AI.findings: 1) 高级无担保贷款的经济下行LGD为59%，显著超过巴塞尔基础方法的40%-45%假设；2) 新的ASRF模型产生的风险权重显著低于巴塞尔要求；3) 证实了当前巴塞尔框架中PD和LGD处理方式的不一致性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了基于损失时间序列而非违约频率的ASRF模型参数化方法，实现了条件PD和条件LGD的一致测量，并纳入了PD和LGD之间的相关性，为资本计算提供了更统一的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 消除了资本公式中的经济下行LGD要求，降低了监管机构和银行的复杂性；2) 开发了可在贷款层面计算资本的模型，输入参数包括：全周期PD、全周期LGD、贷款类型、抵押品类型和中小企业指标；3) 揭示了巴塞尔框架的风险权重计算与实际风险之间的不一致性。

title: Contract Enforcement and Young Firm Capital Structure: A Global Perspective
affiliations: University of New Hampshire and University of California - Davis

detail.title: Contract Enforcement and Young Firm Capital Structure: A Global Perspective
detail.abstract:
We develop a framework to measure the severity of financial constraints for young firms across countries. Using ORBIS balance-sheet data for 23 economies, we show that short-term leverage rises while long-term leverage falls early in firms’ life cycles, with this pattern persisting longer where contract enforcement is weaker. We build a model of optimal financing under limited enforcement with endogenous debt maturity and blueprint capacity that matches these patterns and enables structural measurement of financial constraints. The framework decomposes the funding gap into within-firm borrowing constraints that ease with repayment history and a scale distortion identifiable through cross-country comparisons.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个衡量各国年轻企业财务约束严重程度的框架，使用23个经济体的ORBIS资产负债表数据，发现短期杠杆率在企业生命周期早期上升而长期杠杆率下降，这种模式在合同执行较弱的国家持续更久。模型结合了有限执行、内生债务期限和蓝图能力，能够结构性地测量财务约束，并将资金缺口分解为随还款历史缓解的企业内部借款约束和可通过跨国比较识别的规模扭曲。
AI.research_question: 如何衡量各国年轻企业的财务约束严重程度？企业债务期限结构在生命周期中如何变化？合同执行质量如何影响这些模式？
AI.motivation: 理解年轻企业面临的财务约束对于促进创新和经济增长至关重要，但现有研究缺乏跨国比较的衡量框架，特别是关于债务期限结构与企业生命周期的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于有限执行的最优融资理论，结合内生债务期限选择和蓝图能力（blueprint capacity），构建结构性测量模型。
AI.method: 使用23个经济体的ORBIS资产负债表数据进行实证分析，建立理论模型匹配实证模式，进行结构性测量和跨国比较。
AI.findings: 1) 企业生命周期早期短期杠杆率上升、长期杠杆率下降；2) 合同执行较弱的国家中这种模式持续更久；3) 资金缺口可分解为随还款历史缓解的内部借款约束和规模扭曲。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 开发了衡量财务约束的结构性框架；2) 将有限执行理论与内生债务期限选择结合；3) 提供了资金缺口的理论分解方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为政策制定者提供评估各国年轻企业财务约束的工具；2) 帮助识别合同执行对融资结构的影响；3) 为企业融资决策提供参考框架。

title: Tawfiki Market Process Theory: Creative Construction and Economic Growth Through Systematic Resource Coupling
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Tawfiki Market Process Theory: Creative Construction and Economic Growth Through Systematic Resource Coupling

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the inventor and developer of the Tawfiki Market Process Theory and holds intellectual property interests in the framework and its applications. The author has commercial interests in multiple ventures that implement this theory, including but not limited to: Property 888 (Housing as a Service), MindMap IQ, TrueSPAC Evaluator, Jengo AI, Kingston Lotto, and other platforms within the TrueSPAC ecosystem. The empirical validation presented derives from real market implementations in which the author had operational involvement. This paper represents independent academic research developed from entrepreneurial practice, with the theory formalized in 2012 following successful implementation in 2010-2011.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research analyzes business case studies using publicly available market data and documented business transactions. No human subjects research requiring ethics approval was conducted. Case Study 1 (restaurant-telecommunications, 2011) and Case Study 2 (taxi-housing-energy, 2010-2025) involved standard commercial transactions with all parties operating in normal market conditions. No sensitive personal data was collected or analyzed.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was independently developed and self-funded by the author.

keywords: underutilization index JEL Classification: B53 (Austrian Economics)

detail.abstract:
While the 2025 Nobel Prize recognized the power of creative destruction in driving economic growth, we present a market process theory demonstrating that destruction is not necessary. Through systematic resource coupling, creative construction achieves Pareto-optimal growth, expansion where all stakeholders benefit simultaneously without incumbent displacement, government subsidies, or social safety net costs.

The Tawfiki Market Process Theory, grounded in Israel M. Kirzner's Austrian market process economics, introduces the (*) operator, a mathematical representation of entrepreneurial discovery efficiency in coupling underutilized assets across economic sectors. The core equation, Rd = (D)* × (Po), transforms traditional ratio-based financial metrics into product-based relationships, generating five variations that maintain equivalence with corporate finance formulas while producing leverage-neutral returns where ROE = ROA.

We present empirical validation from live market implementations in Jamaica (2010-2025): a restaurant-telecommunications coupling demonstrating 12.5× value leverage, and a comprehensive taxi-housing-energy integration achieving 50.7× coupling multipliers. Both cases satisfy a rigorous Zero-Sum Test Protocol confirming genuine Pareto outcomes with no hidden subsidies or regulatory arbitrage.

The framework's mathematical innovation lies in Po cancellation, which eliminates capital structure dependency, fundamentally diverging from the Du Pont Identity at precisely the point where leverage-based returns separate from discovery-based returns. This represents the first rigorous mathematical formalization of Austrian economics, operationalizing Kirzner's concepts of entrepreneurial alertness, spontaneous order, and dispersed knowledge aggregation into quantifiable, testable predictions.

Conservative estimates suggest $2.9 trillion in potential global efficiency gains over 15 years across five major sector couplings (housing-energy, food service-telecommunications, agriculture-logistics-finance, education-employment-housing, and healthcare-transportation-nutrition). The theory provides policy implications favouring market-driven coordination over centralized planning, with zero fiscal burden compared to creative destruction's $50-100 billion annual social cost (U.S. scale).

We acknowledge significant limitations: small empirical sample size (n=2), single-country geographic concentration, lack of peer-reviewed validation, and requirement for entrepreneurial discovery capabilities that may not universalize. The framework applies specifically where underutilization indices satisfy UI₁ × UI₂ > 1% threshold and complementarity scores exceed 0.7, establishing clear boundary conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Tawfiki市场过程理论，证明通过系统资源耦合的"创造性建设"可实现帕累托最优增长，无需破坏现有企业或政府补贴。理论基于奥地利经济学，引入(*)算子表示跨部门未充分利用资产的耦合效率，核心方程Rd = (D)* × (Po)产生杠杆中性回报(ROE=ROA)。牙买加实证案例显示12.5×和50.7×耦合乘数，全球潜在效率增益达2.9万亿美元。
AI.research_question: 创造性建设是否能在不破坏现有企业、无需政府补贴或社会安全网成本的情况下，通过系统资源耦合实现所有利益相关者同时受益的帕累托最优增长？
AI.motivation: 传统创造性破坏理论虽然推动经济增长，但伴随企业倒闭、失业和社会成本(美国每年500-1000亿美元)。本文旨在证明存在替代路径：通过市场过程协调未充分利用资源，实现无破坏的增长。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于以色列·M·基尔兹纳的奥地利市场过程经济学，强调企业家发现、自发秩序和分散知识聚合。引入(*)算子作为企业家发现效率的数学表示，核心方程Rd = (D)* × (Po)将传统财务比率转化为乘积关系。
AI.method: 1. 理论构建：数学形式化奥地利经济学，提出Tawfiki市场过程理论；2. 实证验证：牙买加实地案例研究(2010-2025)，包括餐厅-电信耦合和出租车-住房-能源整合；3. 零和测试协议：确认帕累托结果无隐藏补贴或监管套利。
AI.findings: 1. 餐厅-电信耦合实现12.5倍价值杠杆；2. 出租车-住房-能源整合实现50.7倍耦合乘数；3. 两个案例均通过零和测试，确认真正的帕累托结果；4. Po消除实现资本结构独立性，ROE=ROA的杠杆中性回报。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次对奥地利经济学进行严格的数学形式化；2. 提出创造性建设作为创造性破坏的替代理论；3. 引入(*)算子和核心方程Rd = (D)* × (Po)；4. 证明Po消除如何消除资本结构依赖，与杜邦恒等式根本不同。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 识别五大部门耦合的2.9万亿美元全球效率增益潜力；2. 提供零财政负担的政策方案；3. 建立应用边界条件(未利用率指数UI₁ × UI₂ > 1%，互补性分数>0.7)；4. 为市场驱动协调而非中央规划提供理论支持。

title: Institutional Trust, Horizontal Equity, and Tax Morale in India

detail.title: Institutional Trust, Horizontal Equity, and Tax Morale in India
detail.abstract: I examine how institutional trust and perceptions of fairness across taxpayer groups may influence tax morale in India using data from the World Values Survey. Tax morale, defined as the intrinsic motivation to pay taxes, is an important factor shaping tax compliance. I find a positive and statistically significant association between tax morale and trust in the government, parliament, and civil services. Salaried employees report lower tax morale than self-employed individuals. This pattern contrasts with much of the existing empirical literature and is interpreted through the lens of horizontal equity. In settings with a narrow personal income tax base and variation in income reporting and monitoring across taxpayer groups, perceived differences in effective tax burdens may weaken tax morale of salaried employees. The findings highlight the role of institutional quality and horizontal equity in sustaining voluntary tax compliance.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用世界价值观调查数据，探讨了印度制度信任和不同纳税人群体公平感知对税收道德的影响。研究发现政府信任与税收道德正相关，但受薪雇员的税收道德低于自雇者，这与现有文献相反，可从横向公平角度解释。
AI.research_question: 制度信任和不同纳税人群体间的公平感知如何影响印度的税收道德？
AI.motivation: 税收道德作为内在纳税动机对税收遵从至关重要，但印度作为发展中国家，其税收道德的影响因素特别是制度信任和公平感知的作用尚需深入研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税收道德理论、制度信任理论、横向公平理论（horizontal equity）
AI.method: 使用世界价值观调查（World Values Survey）数据，进行统计分析，检验制度信任（对政府、议会、公务员的信任）和纳税人类型（受薪雇员vs自雇者）与税收道德的关系。
AI.findings: 1. 对政府、议会和公务员的信任与税收道德呈显著正相关；2. 受薪雇员的税收道德低于自雇者，这与多数实证文献相反；3. 在个人所得税税基狭窄且不同纳税人群体收入报告和监控存在差异的环境中，感知到的有效税负差异可能削弱受薪雇员的税收道德。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 在发展中国家背景下验证了制度信任对税收道德的重要性；2. 提出了横向公平视角解释纳税人类型与税收道德的反常关系；3. 丰富了税收道德影响因素的理论框架，强调制度质量和横向公平的交互作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为印度税务部门提供了改善税收遵从的政策方向：增强制度信任和公平感知；2. 建议关注不同纳税人群体间的公平性，特别是缩小受薪雇员和自雇者在税收执行上的差异；3. 为其他发展中国家税收改革提供了借鉴。

title: Analytical Demand Management: How To Minimize Tied-Up Capital And Maximize Conversion In Retail And Service Businesses Through Customer Intake Micro-Processes
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Analytical Demand Management: How To Minimize Tied-Up Capital And Maximize Conversion In Retail And Service Businesses Through Customer Intake Micro-Processes
detail.abstract: Traditional management literature often associates business growth with increased sales volume, market expansion, or productive capacity enhancement. However, such an approach frequently overlooks a central factor for the economic sustainability of small businesses: efficiency in capital allocation. This article proposes a model of analytical demand management based on the systematization of initial customer intake micro-processes and the analysis of suppressed demand, defined as situations in which customer purchase intention does not convert into sales due to misalignment between offer, inventory, or operational capacity. The study is grounded in a proprietary database comprising more than 21,000 real customer intake records, collected longitudinally between 2023 and 2026, reflecting actual interactions between small businesses and their customers. The findings demonstrate that reducing tied-up capital and increasing conversion rates do not depend solely on higher sales volume, but rather on the ability to identify, measure, and correct recurring patterns of revenue loss. This research contributes to the entrepreneurship and applied management literature by presenting a replicable framework for data-driven decision-making based on real operational data, with direct impact on liquidity, financial predictability, and organizational sustainability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于初始客户获取微流程系统化和抑制需求分析的分析性需求管理模型，通过分析21000多条真实客户记录，证明减少占用资本和提高转化率不仅依赖销售增长，更取决于识别、衡量和纠正收入损失模式的能力。
AI.research_question: 如何通过分析初始客户获取微流程和抑制需求来提高小企业的资本配置效率和经济可持续性？
AI.motivation: 传统管理文献通常将业务增长与销售增长、市场扩张或生产能力提升相关联，但这种方法经常忽视小企业经济可持续性的核心因素：资本配置效率。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于分析性需求管理理论，重点关注抑制需求（客户购买意愿因供应、库存或运营能力不匹配而未能转化为销售的情况）和资本配置效率理论。
AI.method: 使用专有数据库进行纵向研究，包含2023-2026年间收集的21000多条真实客户获取记录，反映小企业与客户的实际互动。
AI.findings: 减少占用资本和提高转化率不仅依赖更高的销售数量，更取决于识别、衡量和纠正收入损失重复模式的能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 为创业学和应用管理文献贡献了基于真实运营数据的可复制数据驱动决策框架，扩展了需求管理和资本效率理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供直接影响流动性、财务可预测性和组织可持续性的实用框架，帮助小企业通过微观流程优化改善资本配置效率。

title: First-Principles Thinking as a Cognitive Micro-Foundation for Dynamic Capabilities: When Epistemic Infrastructure Turns Trade-Off into Complementarity

detail.title: First-Principles Thinking as a Cognitive Micro-Foundation for Dynamic Capabilities: When Epistemic Infrastructure Turns Trade-Off into Complementarity

contentType.other: The article is under consideration for publication by Industrial and Corporate Change

detail.abstract: Dynamic capabilities theory calls for cognitive micro-foundations but leaves unspecified the reasoning practice through which architectural reconfiguration occurs. This article introduces firstprinciples thinking as that missing micro-foundation and derives the complementarity thesis: under identifiable scope conditions, organisations operating from first-principles-derived constraint spaces can generate exploitation and exploration as joint outputs of the same cognitive investment, substantially relaxing the trade-off ambidexterity theory treats as structural. A five-stage pipeline operationalises the practice and epistemic infrastructure specifies its institutional preconditions. A provisional diagnostic instrument, the Foundational Robustness Diagnostic, is offered as a scaffold for future empirical validation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出第一性原理思维作为动态能力理论的认知微观基础，认为在特定条件下，基于第一性原理的组织可以同时实现利用和探索，缓解了双元性理论中的权衡问题。
AI.research_question: 动态能力理论中架构重构的认知微观基础是什么？第一性原理思维如何作为这种微观基础，使组织能够同时实现利用和探索？
AI.motivation: 动态能力理论虽然呼吁认知微观基础，但未具体说明架构重构的推理实践。需要填补这一理论空白，为组织如何通过认知过程实现动态能力提供具体机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态能力理论、双元性理论、第一性原理思维、认知微观基础理论
AI.method: 理论构建方法，提出五阶段管道操作化实践，建立认识论基础设施，提供临时诊断工具（基础稳健性诊断）作为未来实证验证的脚手架
AI.findings: 第一性原理思维可以作为动态能力理论的认知微观基础；在可识别的范围条件下，基于第一性原理的组织可以同时产生利用和探索作为同一认知投资的联合产出；这显著缓解了双元性理论中视为结构性的权衡问题
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 为动态能力理论提供了具体的认知微观基础（第一性原理思维）；2. 提出了互补性论点，连接了动态能力和双元性理论；3. 建立了架构重构的推理实践理论
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 提供了五阶段管道操作化实践；2. 建立了认识论基础设施规范；3. 开发了基础稳健性诊断工具，为组织实践提供指导框架

title: When ChatGPT Stops Talking: GenAI-induced Retail Herding and Systematic Risk

detail.title: When ChatGPT Stops Talking: GenAI-induced Retail Herding and Systematic Risk
detail.abstract: Using 21 unexpected ChatGPT outages as exogenous shocks to GenAI availability, we study how GenAI adoption affects retail investors' collective behavioral biases and market quality. We find that ChatGPT acts as a "belief homogenizer," synchronizing retail beliefs and trading decisions. This synchronization reflects collective overreaction rather than a collective-level improvement in information processing. ChatGPT availability worsens market liquidity by crowding out retail investors' natural contrarian liquidity-provision role. We further show that ChatGPT threatens market stability by aggregating idiosyncratic retail noise into undiversifiable systematic risk.

AI.tldr: 使用21次ChatGPT意外中断作为外生冲击，研究发现ChatGPT作为"信念同质化器"同步散户投资者的信念和交易决策，但这种同步反映的是集体过度反应而非信息处理改进，会恶化市场流动性并威胁市场稳定。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI（特别是ChatGPT）的采用如何影响散户投资者的集体行为偏差和市场质量？
AI.motivation: 随着生成式AI在投资决策中的广泛应用，需要了解其对散户投资者行为和市场效率的影响，特别是AI是否改善信息处理还是加剧行为偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为金融学（集体行为偏差、过度反应）、市场微观结构理论（流动性、市场质量）、信息处理理论、系统性风险理论
AI.method: 使用21次ChatGPT意外中断作为外生冲击的自然实验设计，分析GenAI可用性对散户投资者行为和市场质量的影响
AI.findings: 1. ChatGPT作为"信念同质化器"同步散户信念和交易决策；2. 这种同步反映集体过度反应而非信息处理改进；3. ChatGPT可用性恶化市场流动性，挤出了散户的自然反向流动性提供角色；4. ChatGPT将散户的特质噪声聚合成不可分散的系统性风险，威胁市场稳定
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 首次实证检验生成式AI对散户集体行为偏差的影响；2. 提出"信念同质化器"概念解释AI同步效应；3. 揭示AI可能加剧而非缓解行为偏差的机制；4. 拓展AI对系统性风险影响的理论理解
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为监管机构提供AI对市场稳定影响的证据；2. 提醒投资者注意AI使用可能加剧集体行为偏差；3. 为市场设计者提供改善AI时代市场质量的参考；4. 为金融机构评估AI工具风险提供依据

title: Beyond Capabilities: Durability Economics And The Providence Value Unit

detail.title: Beyond Capabilities: Durability Economics And The Providence Value Unit
detail.abstract: Economic theory has progressively expanded its evaluative scope from welfare outcomes to capabilities and institutional performance. Yet a fundamental dimension of economic life remains comparatively underexplored: whether economic institutions preserve the durability of meaningful human agency across time. Existing frameworks evaluate what economic systems produce, what opportunities they make available, and how governance structures shape incentives. None systematically examines whether institutions sustain the temporal conditions under which longterm human action remains intelligible across generations. This article introduces Durability Economics as a conceptual framework concerned with the institutional conditions that preserve or undermine the continuity of meaningful human agency across time. Within this framework, it proposes the Providence Value Unit (PVU) as a conceptual metric for evaluating agency durability-not as a measure of output or welfare, but as a composite assessment of whether the biological, demographic, institutional, monetary, and material systems of a society sustain the temporal credibility of human action across generations. The article traces the evolution of economic evaluation from welfare economics through Sen's capability approach and North's institutional economics; identifies agency durability as the missing analytical dimension in all three traditions; introduces the concepts of temporal plausibility of agency, agency fragility, and temporal credibility as the theoretical core of Durability Economics; develops the PVU formula PVU = f(B,H,C,D,F,G,M,S,I,T) across ten structural pillars; situates Durability Economics in relation to civilizational production functions; and integrates the framework with the author's complementary analytical contributions-TRIDO-AA, Decision-Time Accessibility (DTA), and Decision-Time Retrieval Failure (DTRF)-into a multi-level architecture of agency analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了"耐久性经济学"概念框架，关注经济制度如何维持或破坏人类能动性在时间上的连续性，并引入"天意价值单位"作为评估能动性耐久性的概念性指标。
AI.research_question: 经济制度是否以及如何维持人类能动性在代际时间尺度上的耐久性和连续性？
AI.motivation: 现有经济学评估框架（福利经济学、能力方法、制度经济学）都未能系统性地考察经济制度是否维持人类能动性在时间上的耐久性，这是经济生活的一个根本维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 耐久性经济学，以能动性耐久性为核心，包含能动性的时间可信性、能动性脆弱性、时间可理解性等概念，并与TRIDO-AA、决策时间可及性、决策时间检索失败等作者先前理论相结合。
AI.method: 概念性框架构建，理论分析，通过追溯经济学评估的演变（从福利经济学到能力方法再到制度经济学），识别缺失的分析维度，并开发PVU公式：PVU = f(B,H,C,D,F,G,M,S,I,T)跨越十个结构性支柱。
AI.findings: 提出了完整的耐久性经济学框架，包括能动性耐久性的概念、PVU评估指标、十个结构性支柱的公式，以及将这一框架与作者先前理论整合的多层次能动性分析架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 识别了现有经济学评估框架中缺失的能动性耐久性维度；2. 提出了耐久性经济学作为新的概念框架；3. 发展了能动性的时间可信性、能动性脆弱性等核心概念；4. 创建了PVU作为评估能动性耐久性的概念性指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、制度设计者提供了评估经济制度是否维持人类能动性耐久性的分析工具，有助于设计更可持续、更能维持代际连续性的经济制度。

title: Reviving the Military's Term Limit
affiliations: Emory University School of Law and

detail.title: Reviving the Military's Term Limit

publicationDetails.journalName: Emory University School of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
This Article argues for the revival of a dormant constitutional safeguard that the Framers intended to keep the military accountable to the people.  The safeguard is the Constitution’s forgotten Two-Year Clause, which prohibits Congress from appropriating funds “to raise and support Armies” for a period longer than two years.  Intended to be Congress’s peace power, a 1904 legal opinion by Solicitor General William Hoyt strictly limiting the reach of the clause led to its obsolescence during the twentieth century.  Congresses now routinely appropriate long-term funding for the Army, thereby putting important functions beyond the influence of their successors.  The 119th Congress, for example, put military immigration enforcement and detention beyond the reach of the soon-to-be elected 120th Congress by providing four-year money for those activities in the One Big Beautiful Bill Act.  

The Article makes the affirmative case for reviving the Two-Year Clause on originalism, separation of powers, and federalism grounds.  Hoyt’s opinion and the practice of routine long-term and permanent army appropriations it has enabled are contrary to the original meaning and intent of the constitution as well as early congressional practice.  Moreover, reviving the Two-Year Clause would strengthen the separation of powers by preserving a fast-eroding norm of annual and biennial appropriations for most military functions while enhancing congressional control over the important subset of functions subject to long-term appropriations.  Doing so would also protect state sovereignty as to domestic deployments of federal armies—whether called the “Army” or not—by re-engaging the political safeguards of federalism. 

National security, historical gloss, and justiciability considerations that have neutralized other checks on the president’s war powers should not stand in the way of reviving the Two-Year Clause.  Revival would not have operational effects on national security decision-making and its fiscal effects would be mixed.  Revival would not conflict with courts’ use of historical gloss in interpreting other war powers because the Two-Year Clause is distinctive in specifically prohibiting any one Congress from surrendering the power it guarantees to every Congress.  And revival would not force courts to second-guess sensitive military judgments because the clause renders legislation unconstitutional, not executive action.

AI.tldr: 本文主张复兴宪法中被遗忘的"两年条款"，该条款禁止国会为"建立和维持陆军"拨款超过两年期限。作者认为恢复这一条款能加强国会控制、保护州主权，并符合宪法原意。
AI.research_question: 如何复兴宪法中的"两年条款"以恢复国会对军事拨款的控制，并加强权力分立和联邦主义？
AI.motivation: 当前国会经常为陆军提供长期拨款，使得重要军事职能超越继任国会的影响范围，削弱了宪法制定者设计的军事问责机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 原旨主义、权力分立理论和联邦主义理论，用于论证恢复两年条款的宪法基础。
AI.method: 法律历史分析、宪法解释分析、案例研究（如1904年霍伊特法律意见、第119届国会实践）
AI.findings: 霍伊特意见和长期拨款实践违背宪法原意和早期国会实践；恢复两年条款能加强国会控制、保护州主权，且不会影响国家安全决策或引发司法过度干预。
AI.theory_contributions: 重新阐释宪法两年条款的理论意义，为原旨主义解释提供新案例，丰富权力分立和联邦主义的宪法理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为国会恢复军事拨款控制提供具体路径，增强对国内军事部署的政治监督，防止单届国会放弃未来国会的宪法权力。

title: The Motherhood Penalty in the Mutual Fund Industry
affiliations: University of Mannheim - Finance Area, Australian National University (ANU), University of Mannheim - Finance Area and Shanghai University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: The Motherhood Penalty in the Mutual Fund Industry
detail.abstract: Using mandatory maternity-leave disclosures for Chinese mutual fund managers, we estimate the career effects of childbirth in a setting with observable performance. Comparing new mothers to their pre-birth co-managers on the same funds, we find large and persistent penalties: mothers are 42% less likely to remain in the industry and, conditional on staying, hold 26% fewer leadership roles and manage 38% less (normalized) assets. Performance falls temporarily during pregnancy but quickly rebounds after birth, and investor flows do not decline. Career penalties outlast and exceed temporary performance effects, pointing to frictions in post-leave retention and responsibility allocation.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用中国基金经理的强制产假披露数据，发现在可观测业绩的情况下，生育对女性基金经理职业生涯产生显著且持久的惩罚效应。
AI.research_question: 生育如何影响女性基金经理的职业生涯？特别是在业绩可观测的情况下，生育带来的职业惩罚是否超过暂时的业绩影响？
AI.motivation: 研究生育对女性职业发展的影响，特别是在金融行业这种业绩可量化、竞争激烈的环境中。中国强制产假披露政策为研究提供了独特的数据机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 职业惩罚理论、性别歧视理论、人力资本理论、工作-家庭冲突理论
AI.method: 利用中国基金经理强制产假披露的准自然实验，采用双重差分法(DID)比较生育前后同一基金上共同管理者的职业轨迹
AI.findings: 1. 生育后女性基金经理留在行业的可能性降低42%；2. 留在行业的女性领导职位减少26%；3. 管理资产规模减少38%；4. 业绩在孕期暂时下降但产后迅速恢复；5. 投资者资金流未下降；6. 职业惩罚超过并持续于暂时的业绩影响
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 在业绩可观测环境中验证生育的职业惩罚；2. 揭示职业惩罚与业绩表现的脱节；3. 识别产假后留任和职责分配中的摩擦机制
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供性别平等政策的实证依据；2. 为企业改善产假后职业发展支持提供参考；3. 帮助女性职业规划者了解生育的职业成本

title: Nostalgic Messaging-Driven Turnout Analysis: Transformer-Based Detection and Temporal Causal Modeling of Political Ad Effects in Battleground States

detail.title: Nostalgic Messaging-Driven Turnout Analysis: Transformer-Based Detection and Temporal Causal Modeling of Political Ad Effects in Battleground States
detail.abstract: Contrary to laboratory predictions of nostalgic mobilization, this field study finds no overall relationship between nostalgic advertising and voter turnout across 393 battleground counties, establishing boundary conditions for nostalgic appeals. We classified 450 presidential campaign advertisements from 2020 and 2024 across five battleground states (Pennsylvania, Wisconsin, Michigan, Georgia, Arizona) using a fine-tuned DistilBERT transformer model pre-trained on an augmented corpus of 400 political speech excerpts from the Miller Center Presidential Speech Archive and validated with 5-fold cross-validation (F1 = 0.91, AUC = 0.92), achieving superior discrimination over dictionary-based and logistic regression baselines. Using a pre-post change design following difference-indifferences logic, we tested whether nostalgic advertising increases predicted turnout gains. The overall association was not significant (ρ = 0.065, p = 0.197; 95% CI [-0.038, 0.171]) and remained null across bootstrap resampling, permutation tests, and regression with demographic controls. However, Georgia showed a significant negative effect (ρ =-0.298, p < 0.001), driven entirely by White-majority counties (ρ =-0.406, p < 0.001) while below-median White counties showed no relationship (ρ = 0.028, p = 0.806). Event study analysis across seven elections (2000-2024) confirmed parallel pre-treatment trends, with negative divergence emerging only after eight years of MAGA messaging. These demographic patterns, interpreted alongside Georgia's rapid suburban realignment and advertising wear-out theory, suggest diminishing returns to nostalgic political appeals in contexts of prolonged exposure, challenging laboratory predictions and identifying boundary conditions where nostalgic framing may backfire rather than mobilize.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析2020-2024年五个摇摆州的450个总统竞选广告，发现怀旧广告与选民投票率之间没有显著关联，挑战了实验室研究的预测。特别在乔治亚州，怀旧广告对白人多数县产生了显著的负面影响，表明在长期暴露于MAGA信息后，怀旧政治诉求可能出现收益递减甚至适得其反的效果。
AI.research_question: 怀旧政治广告是否能够提高选民投票率？在什么条件下怀旧诉求可能适得其反？
AI.motivation: 实验室研究预测怀旧诉求能够动员选民，但缺乏真实选举环境中的实证检验。需要探究怀旧广告在实际竞选中的效果，特别是识别其边界条件。
AI.theoretical_framework: 怀旧动员理论、广告疲劳理论、政治信息处理理论、人口统计学调节效应
AI.method: 1) 使用微调的DistilBERT模型对450个总统竞选广告进行分类；2) 采用前测-后测变化设计，基于双重差分逻辑；3) 分析393个摇摆县的数据；4) 使用自助重抽样、置换检验和人口统计学控制回归；5) 进行2000-2024年七次选举的事件研究分析
AI.findings: 1) 怀旧广告与选民投票率之间整体无显著关联；2) 乔治亚州出现显著负面效应，完全由白人多数县驱动；3) 事件研究显示在八年MAGA信息暴露后出现负面分歧；4) 怀旧诉求在长期暴露情境下可能出现收益递减
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 挑战实验室怀旧动员预测，建立真实选举环境中的边界条件；2) 识别人口统计学调节效应；3) 提出怀旧政治诉求的收益递减理论；4) 整合广告疲劳理论与政治沟通研究

title: Interpretable Machine Learning for Maternal Risk Stratification: A Comparative Study of Stacked Ensembles and Tabular Transformers using Routine Clinical Data
affiliations: Jimma University (JU) - Jimma Institute of Technology, Jimma University (JU) - Jimma Institute of Technology, Jimma University (JU) - Jimma Institute of Technology, Jimma University (JU) - Jimma Institute of Technology, Jimma University (JU) - Jimma Institute of Technology, , , Jimma University (JU), Jimma University (JU) - Jimma Institute of Technology, Jimma University (JU) and University of Toronto

detail.title: Interpretable Machine Learning for Maternal Risk Stratification: A Comparative Study of Stacked Ensembles and Tabular Transformers using Routine Clinical Data

declarations.funderStatement: This research is funded by Canada’s International Development Research Centre (IDRC) and the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) (Grant No.110693-001). We acknowledge support from IDRC (Grant No. 109981), IDRC and FCDO (Grant No. 110554-001). detail.abstract: Background: Maternal mortality remains disproportionately high in low-resource settings, where the lack of specialized maternal care hinders early risk detection. While machine learning (ML) models offer a solution for automated risk stratification, they often struggle with class imbalance and limited interpretability. This study developed and evaluated an interpretable ML framework for three-level maternal risk classification to support clinical decision-making. Methods: We analyzed 786 de-identified maternal health records from rural Bangladesh, utilizing six routine variables: age, systolic and diastolic blood pressure, blood sugar, body temperature, and heart rate. The pipeline applied Yeo-Johnson transformations and cost-sensitive weighted training to mitigate dataset imbalance. We benchmarked a diverse range of ML models from classic to the recent Tabular Prior-data Fitted Network (TabPFN), a transformer-based foundation model designed for small datasets and their ensembles. Performance was validated using nested 10-fold cross-validation and a held-out test set (N = 158). Model interpretability was achieved through SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) and Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) methods. Results: A stacked ensemble with a LightGBM meta-learner achieved an AUC of 0.9713 (95% CI: 0.9485-0.9874), accuracy of 0.8931 (95% CI: 0.8418-0.9367), and F1-score of 0.8992 (95% CI: 0.8490-0.9420) on the test set. Sensitivity for the high-risk class was 0.946 (35/37). TabPFN showed similar discrimination (AUC: 0.9739). SHAP and LIME analyses identified blood sugar and systolic blood pressure as major contributors to predicted risk. Conclusions: Within this dataset, interpretable ML models achieved high-sensitivity maternal risk stratification using routine clinical data by offering a robust foundation for clinical decision support in low-resource settings, though future research must focus on prospective validation.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发并评估了一个可解释的机器学习框架，用于三级产妇风险分类，以支持低资源环境下的临床决策。使用786份来自孟加拉国农村的产妇健康记录，通过集成学习方法实现了高精度的风险分层，并识别出血糖和收缩压是主要风险因素。
AI.research_question: 如何开发一个可解释的机器学习框架，用于在低资源环境下使用常规临床数据进行产妇风险分层？
AI.motivation: 在低资源环境中，产妇死亡率仍然居高不下，缺乏专业产妇护理阻碍了早期风险检测。机器学习模型虽然提供了自动风险分层的解决方案，但常常面临类别不平衡和可解释性有限的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器学习风险分层理论、可解释人工智能（XAI）理论、集成学习理论、类别不平衡处理理论
AI.method: 分析了786份来自孟加拉国农村的去标识化产妇健康记录，使用6个常规变量：年龄、收缩压和舒张压、血糖、体温和心率。采用Yeo-Johnson变换和成本敏感加权训练来缓解数据集不平衡。比较了从经典到最新的TabPFN（一种专为小数据集设计的基于Transformer的基础模型）等多种机器学习模型及其集成。使用嵌套10折交叉验证和保留测试集（N=158）进行验证。通过SHAP和LIME方法实现模型可解释性。
AI.findings: 使用LightGBM元学习器的堆叠集成在测试集上实现了AUC为0.9713、准确率为0.8931、F1分数为0.8992。高风险类别的灵敏度为0.946（35/37）。TabPFN显示出相似的区分能力（AUC：0.9739）。SHAP和LIME分析确定血糖和收缩压是预测风险的主要贡献因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）提出了一个适用于低资源环境的可解释机器学习风险分层框架；2）验证了集成学习方法在产妇风险分类中的有效性；3）展示了可解释AI方法在医疗决策支持中的应用价值；4）为小数据集上的机器学习应用提供了方法学参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）开发了一个高灵敏度的产妇风险分层工具，可用于低资源环境的临床决策支持；2）识别了血糖和收缩压作为关键风险指标；3）提供了可解释的预测结果，增强临床医生的信任度；4）为资源有限地区的产妇保健提供了可行的技术解决方案。

title: Dollar Hegemony as International Law-making Power

detail.title: Dollar Hegemony as International Law-making Power
detail.abstract: The so-called weaponisation of the dollar as part of the escalating geopolitical competition has drawn attention to dollar hegemony within the fields of international law, international relations and political economy alike. This article contributes to discussions about the advantages conferred to the US due to the international role of the dollar and to emerging debates about international law and political economy by demonstrating that dollar hegemony operates as a form of international law-making power. The international role of the dollar gives the United States exceptional opportunities not enjoyed by other states to influence disproportionately crucial areas of international law, including the law of jurisdiction and the law of sovereign state immunity. This law-making power has been exercised in contradictory ways. On the one hand, the United States has used the privileged role of the dollar to formulate laws that materially benefited financial capital while also incorporating its logic and ideology. On the other, the United Stated has used the law-making powers of the dollar in order to pursue short-term particularistic, geopolitical and even partisan agendas. Otherwise put, the lawmaking functions of the dollar have reflected-without being able to resolve-the fundamental tensions that arise out of the use of a national currency as world money and, in legal terms, the contradictions that inhere in the fact that a globalized political economy remains mediated by domestic legal and political forms.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美元霸权如何作为一种国际立法权力运作，分析美国利用美元国际地位对国际法（特别是管辖权和主权豁免法）施加不成比例影响的能力，并揭示这种立法权力在服务金融资本与追求短期地缘政治议程之间的内在矛盾。
AI.research_question: 美元霸权如何作为一种国际立法权力运作，以及这种权力如何影响国际法的发展？
AI.motivation: 随着地缘政治竞争加剧，美元"武器化"现象引起国际法、国际关系和政治经济学领域的关注。本文旨在探讨美元国际地位赋予美国的特殊优势，以及这种优势如何转化为国际立法权力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合国际法、国际关系和政治经济学理论，特别是关于世界货币与国家货币之间张力的理论框架，分析美元作为国家货币同时承担世界货币功能所产生的内在矛盾。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，通过概念分析和案例研究，探讨美元霸权在国际法领域的运作机制和影响。
AI.findings: 美元霸权赋予美国不成比例地影响国际法关键领域（如管辖权和主权豁免法）的能力。这种立法权力以矛盾方式运作：一方面服务于金融资本利益并融入其逻辑，另一方面被用于追求短期地缘政治和党派议程。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于将美元霸权概念化为一种国际立法权力，揭示了国家货币作为世界货币所产生的根本张力，以及全球化政治经济仍由国内法律政治形式调解的内在矛盾。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献在于帮助理解美元"武器化"现象的国际法含义，为政策制定者、国际法学者和地缘政治分析者提供分析框架，以评估美元霸权对国际法律秩序的影响。

title: Plurilateral Trade Agreements: A Complementary Margin to Preferential Liberalization
affiliations: International School of Economics at Tbilisi State University,  and Bielefeld University

detail.title: Plurilateral Trade Agreements: A Complementary Margin to Preferential Liberalization
detail.abstract: We show that plurilateral agreements facilitate global tariff liberalization by creating an MFN-based margin of cooperation that leaves preferential access via preferential trade agreements (PTAs) unchanged. In a model of endogenous trade agreement formation with farsighted governments, PTAs become rigid once exclusion or free-riding incentives bind, constraining further PTA expansion. Plurilateral agreements relax these constraints by allowing countries to liberalize selectively in a differentiated-goods sector without altering existing PTAs. As a result, the stable equilibrium trade network consists of the PTAs that would arise absent plurilaterals, augmented---but not replaced---by plurilateral MFN liberalization. This mechanism provides an explanation for the growing role of sectoral plurilateral agreements within the WTO as preferential liberalization becomes increasingly constrained.

AI.tldr: 论文表明，诸边协定通过创造基于最惠国待遇的合作空间促进全球关税自由化，同时保持优惠贸易协定的优惠准入不变。在远见政府的内生贸易协定形成模型中，一旦排斥或搭便车激励产生约束，优惠贸易协定就会变得僵化，限制进一步扩张。诸边协定通过允许各国在不改变现有优惠贸易协定的情况下，在差异化商品部门选择性自由化来放松这些约束。
AI.research_question: 诸边协定如何促进全球关税自由化？它们如何与优惠贸易协定相互作用？为什么诸边协定在世界贸易组织中日益重要？
AI.motivation: 随着优惠贸易协定变得越来越受约束，需要解释为什么诸边协定在世界贸易组织中日益重要，以及它们如何在全球贸易自由化中发挥作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 内生贸易协定形成理论，远见政府模型，最惠国待遇原则，优惠贸易协定与诸边协定的相互作用理论。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建内生贸易协定形成模型，分析优惠贸易协定和诸边协定的形成机制和稳定均衡。
AI.findings: 诸边协定通过创造基于最惠国待遇的合作空间促进全球关税自由化，同时保持优惠贸易协定的优惠准入不变。优惠贸易协定在排斥或搭便车激励约束下变得僵化，而诸边协定允许选择性自由化而不改变现有优惠贸易协定。稳定均衡贸易网络由优惠贸易协定和诸边最惠国自由化共同构成。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了诸边协定促进全球贸易自由化的理论机制，解释了优惠贸易协定与诸边协定的互补关系，为世界贸易组织中诸边协定日益重要的现象提供了理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了理解诸边协定作用的框架，指导如何在优惠贸易协定受限时通过诸边协定推进贸易自由化，为世界贸易组织改革和多边贸易体系发展提供政策启示。

title: Hard Law, Soft Markets: The Heterogeneous Response of Fossil Fuel Equities to Transition Risk News
affiliations: Universidad San Sebastian and Universidad de Talca, Chile

detail.title: Hard Law, Soft Markets: The Heterogeneous Response of Fossil Fuel Equities to Transition Risk News
detail.abstract: Has climate transition risk become priced into fossil fuel equities? We document that market sensitivity to climate news evolved from zero to economically significant over 2007–2023. Using smooth-transition local projections on 598 fossil fuel firms traded on U.S. stock exchanges, we find that unexpected climate media shocks generated no price response before 2014 but produced cumulative 30-day declines of 49 basis points by 2023. This evolution occurred gradually over 2014-2019, consistent with markets progressively updating beliefs about policy credibility rather than reacting to discrete events. Decomposing by news theme reveals striking heterogeneity: enforceable mechanisms like climate legislation (-79 bp) and carbon taxation (-69 bp) trigger substantially stronger responses than voluntary carbon credit markets (-29 bp). These time-varying sensitivities imply static climate betas mismeasure transition exposure, with direct consequences for portfolio risk management, corporate cost-of-capital forecasting, and design of market-credible climate policy.

AI.tldr: 研究发现气候转型风险在化石燃料股票中已逐渐被定价，市场对气候新闻的敏感性从2007年的零响应发展到2023年的显著负向反应，表明投资者逐渐认识到气候政策可信度。
AI.research_question: 气候转型风险是否已被定价到化石燃料股票中？市场对气候新闻的敏感性如何随时间演变？
AI.motivation: 理解市场如何定价气候转型风险对于投资组合风险管理、企业资本成本预测以及设计可信的气候政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场定价理论、投资者信念更新理论和气候转型风险理论，研究市场如何逐步将气候政策可信度纳入资产定价。
AI.method: 使用平滑转换局部投影方法，分析598家在美国交易所交易的化石燃料公司股票对意外气候媒体冲击的响应（2007-2023年）。
AI.findings:
1. 市场敏感性从零发展到显著：2014年前无价格响应，到2023年产生49个基点的30天累计下跌
2. 演变是渐进的（2014-2019年），符合市场逐步更新对政策可信度的信念
3. 新闻主题异质性：可执行机制（气候立法-79bp、碳税-69bp）比自愿碳信用市场（-29bp）影响更大
AI.theory_contributions:
1. 证明气候转型风险定价是动态演变的
2. 静态气候贝塔会错误衡量转型风险暴露
3. 为投资者信念更新理论提供实证支持
AI.practical_contributions:
1. 对投资组合风险管理的启示：需要动态风险衡量
2. 对企业资本成本预测的影响：应考虑气候政策敏感性
3. 对气候政策设计的启示：可执行机制比自愿机制更具市场可信度
